Name: For The King II
Supported languages: Once beloved by her people, Queen Rosomon has turned against her subjects, casting them into servitude in the darkness of Fahrul’s mines whilst building alliances with sinister and malevolent forces. Gather your party in four player co-op or adventure alone through Fahrul as you risk everything to fight the tyrannical queen and bring an end to her oppressive reign. From the creators of For The King, the much-loved RPG that blends roguelite and tabletop gameplay comes a new chapter in Fahrul’s history, designed on an updated engine bringing innovation and gameplay refinement for returning heroes and new adventurers alike. For The King II is easy for anyone to pick up and play, but takes skill, patience, and strategic excellence to master whilst remaining infinitely replayable with a procedurally generated map that ensures no two playthroughs will ever be the same. Unique yet familiar dice roll inspired movement, encounter and combat mechanics add even more spontaneity and variety as your fortunes rise and fall on the roll of the dice. For The King II provides a complete campaign with over 30 hours of gameplay, split into 5 separate adventures, each narratively linked. The journey is long and the path is treacherous but fear not, if your party fails you will start stronger and wiser on your next playthrough with better starting items to draft into your loadout. Roll up, roll up! Put your skills to the ultimate test with the infinite dungeon mode - Dark Carnival. Led by the devious Ringmaster, your goal is to conquer as many floors as possible before you meet your inevitable demise. Collect carnival tickets to explore new paths, discover a host of themed rooms and spin the Wheel of Death as you try to escape your fate. How far will you make it through the Dark Carnival? Traverse Fahrul solo or with up-to three friends in four-player co-op. As a solo player you can control all characters in your party, giving you complete ownership of the campaign map and combat strategy whilst in four-player co-op you must coordinate and negotiate with your party members. Play online multiplayer with your friends controlling your own character(s) or play offline co-op on the same PC. Offline co-op supports multiple controllers; each controller will have input control on everyone’s turn. Inspired by turn-based classics, For The King II adds strategic depth to much-loved combat mechanics with the new Battle Grid, where movement and position provide you and your enemies with strategic buffs and penalties. Defend the back row by equipping a mighty Tower Shield, push enemies into lethal pools of burning fire, or entangle melee troops with dark magic cast with weapons looted from vanquished foes. The choice is yours! Fahrul is both beautiful and deadly in equal measure. On your journey you will encounter a wealth of diverse biome environments brought to life in a breathtaking art style. From lush forests, toxic swamps and lava-filled wastelands to pirate (no scratch that!) Merling-infested tropical seas, For The King II transports you deep into the wonders of Fahrul, leading you further than ever before into this stunningly-imagined land of adventure.

Name: Iron Soul
Supported languages: Discovery of a new Goldilocks planet has led to the creation of a new type of army: One that is made of metal and steel. One that can’t feel pain or fear. One that is said to be our only hope against a possible alien invasion. Sadly, even with all the technological advancements available to future governments, they are not fully in control of the machines… The bot-mageddon is coming and it will be up to one our brightest scientists to help us against the inevitable. The robo-tastic but slightly longer description: Iron Soul is the unpredictable fusion of 3rd person shooting and fast platforming in a story driven, 3D action game. To make it happen, the team drew inspiration from various old school 3rd person titles we all know and love (Name dropping MDK!). Such elements are reinvigorated within an industrial setting full of mad robots, unknown voices and mysterious compounds. It has been a long, two year journey for both the project and its protagonist, H-25 but we are finally there. Now we must stand united to withstand the force of upcoming threat, commenly known as bot-mageddon! Features list for list fans: * Mechanical Tales: Two story-focused campaigns (Though more like 1.5) that tell the tale of one robot invasion as well as the strange interferences our hero and his mentor suffer from during their journey. * Machine Perfect Controls : Fluid action and movement controls for intense robot battles and tight air jumps. This is one bot-mageddon that’s full of shooting, platforming and of course, mild puzzle-solving challenges. * Cunning Enemies: Uniquely designed enemies that can come from the sky, ground or even underground in the most robo-tacular fashion, forcing you to choose your weapon (And tactics) wisely. * Fallen World: Various environments from outdoor valleys to underground military bases have come to life thanks to the power of UDK. The levers are fully optimized and hold many challenges and secrets. * Crazy Voices: Full voice acting for all characters... excluding our main hero of course. After all, he is (allegedly) supposed to be a silent protagonist.

Name: Combined Arms Operations Series
Supported languages: The Combined Arms Operations Series (CAOS) uses simultaneous turns to simulate operational level combat between World War II armies across national boundaries and years. Ever wanted to see Soviet and US forces face off in 1945? Or Germany 1939 versus Italy 1942? Here’s your shot. Follow historical doctrines or rewrite them entirely as you reorganize historical armies to match your command style. See for yourself how the Soviet army could perform in 1941 outside the confines of Operation Barbarossa. Mix and match units from across the German army to create the ultimate combined arms kampfgruppe in 1944. Mass enough American artillery to blot out the sun. Whatever your playstyle, CAOS is happy to provide, with more than 4000 unique units and 580 historically accurate division and brigade formations. Scenarios in CAOS are fast paced and self-contained. Players can choose between anything from small battles between a couple divisions that can be played in under and hour, to sprawling army level battles involving dozens of divisions and hundreds of units that can be played across several days. Multiplayer scenarios are synchronous, allowing you to see your ally issue orders in real time, easily coordinate your battleplans, and even transfer control of units between players. Simulate Operational Combat: CAOS uses simultaneous turn resolution and highly mobile combat to recreate the chaotic nature of combined arms warfare in a turn-based strategy game. Use armored spearheads to smash through enemy lines and create deep encirclements. Infiltrate commandos through rugged mountains to cut off hostile lines of supply. Pound enemies into submission from afar with artillery and aircraft. Destroy bridges, build fortifications, and construct minefields to force your rivals to fight on your terms. Conduct daring paratroop drops and stage amphibious invasions. But remember, no plan of battle survives contact with the enemy. Be prepared to adapt quickly to an evolving battlefield and outmaneuver your opponents. Customize Your Army: Reorganize entire divisions to suit your playstyle or combine units across divisional lines to create specialized battlegroups custom-tailored to your mission. Feel free to recreate historical battlegroups or experiment with alternative force structures. But don’t stop there, necessity is the mother of invention. As your army is bloodied, compensate for diminishing reserves by creating even more novel battlegroups from the battered remnants of your forces. Key Features: Command German, Soviet, American, British, Italian, and French forces from 1939-1945. Simultaneous (WeGo) turn resolution. Customize historical forces by retraining and reorganizing units and merging them into custom battlegroups. 4468 Units detailed down to every tank, artillery piece, and rifle squad. Combined arms warfare: deploy tanks, infantry, artillery, and aircraft to wage blitzkrieg against your opponents or grind them into the dust through attrition. Long range artillery: Provide fire support or pound your enemies from many hexes away. Fog of war and reconnaissance: Use recon units and aircraft to watch your flanks and track your enemy’s maneuvers. Four game types, ranging from small meeting engagements to full-scale amphibious invasions. Randomized objective selection and starting zones to enhance replayability. Single player, synchronous head-to-head PvP and 2 player co-op.

Supported languages: Gladio Mori is a physics-driven fighting game that redefines the gladiator arena. Whether playing solo or challenging others in multiplayer battles, you’ll wield razor-sharp weapons and unleash unique moves in brutal, tactical combat. Damage to muscles, arteries, and vitals directly impacts your ability to fight: Injured Muscles weaken your strikes. Severed Arteries cause you to bleed out. Pierced Vitals mean instant death. Precision and strategy are your greatest weapons. Authentic Weapons and Armor No magical gear here—just realistic weapons and armor that behave as they should. Plate armor blocks strikes, but exposes weak points. Find openings in your opponent’s defenses or risk being outmatched. In-Game Move Editor Unleash your creativity with a fully customizable move editor. Control your character’s physical body to craft unique animations: Design efficient and devastating attacks. Recreate iconic moves from your favorite films or games. Experiment with wild, unpredictable maneuvers—it's up to you. Community-Created Moves Not an animator? No problem. Explore movesets shared by other players or mix and match individual moves to create a style that’s entirely yours. The community fuels the creativity in Gladio Mori. Enter the Arena Every battle in Gladio Mori is a test of strategy, skill, and ingenuity. Forge your fighting style, exploit weaknesses, and prove your worth in the ultimate arena. The gladiator's path awaits—are you ready?

Name: DEMoCap (Drag[en]gine Motion Capture)
Supported languages: DEMoCap allows to do Motion Capture using VR equipment for example for Game Development. There are various advantages to this technique compared to other MoCap techniques: Less expensive equipment Quick to equip actor for performing. Does not require large rooms build especially for MoCap. Allows actors to see the scene in which they have to perform. Capture motion in real time without post processing. Capture any count of characters and interactions between them no matter doing motion capture as single person or a group. Easily re-take captures of individual characters without re-taking all. Allows capturing complex characters (body, tails, wings, additional arms, u.s.f.) DEMoCap is build using the Drag[en]gine Game Engine. The resulting captured animations are usable directly in the Drag[en]gine Game Engine or can be imported into Blender3D for editing. Using Blender the captured animations can be used for everything Blender3D can be used for. DEMoCap uses the original armature/skeleton without modification. The captured animation is directly usable in-game. Using Motion Transfers DEMoCap supports various kinds of armatures/skeletons. You can capture humanoid characters, beastly characters, tails, wings, extra arms, and more. You can also capture First Person Hands for first person view oriented games. Using VR you can recreate the relevant parts of your game scene. This allows your actor to perform more natural and animations are better fitting to your game scene. Define precisely where your animation origins are located in-game. This ensures captured animations are properly positioned and oriented without the need to post-process them to fit into your game. In short DEMoCap accelerates the animation production allowing for higher quality animations to be done in less time. DEMoCap is Open Source. The GitHub repository link can be found at the home page. To use DEMoCap you need SteamVR and Drag[en]gine version 1.10 or higher. Links to tutorials and documentation can be found at the 'Online Manual' link in information box.

Name: Land Run
Supported languages: LandRun is a one-man strategy card game with a motif of the land scramble 'landrun' from the western frontier era. Players, as black slaves, participate in 'Land Run Tournament' because of their owners' greed, and if they win, they will get the freedom they promised and the land they want. This piece is a personalized title developed for PCs, using Unity. Unlike the typical Trump game, except for five special cards, it is designed so that the impact of number size does not appear significantly. When a player hands one card, his or her horse advances one space in the opponent's direction, and when the horse crosses the opponent's boundary, the attack succeeds. Successful three times in this attack will result in victory in that round. The key strategy is to plan in which order to use the card and move the horse, with items that reverse the opponent's advance, move several spaces at once, or adjust the timing of crossing the boundary line. In addition, if the boundary breakthrough does not occur three times until the deck is exhausted, the score is calculated by adding the sum of the number of cards left in the hand and the sum of the unused physical strength cards, and the sum is used to determine victory or defeat. As a result, there are two winning plans: a direct attack victory that breaks through the opponent's boundaries three times and finishes quickly, and a score victory that is aimed at managing hand and physical strength while looking at the deck run out. It is up to the player to decide which plan to choose, and it is important to strategically adjust the timing of using the item, the consumption of the physical card, and how much handwriting you will leave. Another feature of the game is that there is still room for a turnaround even in unfavorable situations due to various items. Matches are played in a tournament format. Players will face several contestants in a row under the direction of their owners, each with a different disposition: 'the type who pushes aggressively from the beginning' and 'the type who saves items and special cards and then flips them all at once in the second half.' The rules are the same, but they are designed to vary depending on who you face, whether you are aiming for an attack victory or a point victory. A round can take approximately 10 to 15 minutes, and the game is designed to allow you to find your own winning pattern by re-attempting several times in a short period of time. It uses a simple mouse-only interface. The game is played by simply selecting a card, but the weight of the judgment varies depending on how you read the horse's location, the number of cards left, and the remaining physical strength of the card. We aim to design it as intuitive as possible so that even players who are not confident in numerical calculation can strategize with the image of 'move forward, step back, push away.' In terms of visuals and world views, in order to give an epic reason to the rule of 'why fight each other to move forward first,' we tried to superimpose Landrun in real history with the situation of 'who runs first and takes the land.' The board and UI are motifs of desolate land maps, old gambling tables, and bulletin boards in bars, and we tried to direct the main character to feel like he is getting closer to freedom and the ground whenever the horse advances one by one. It is a game created by black slaves who are forced to fight for their owners, conscious of twisting the contradictions and madness of the Western Pioneering Era and Landrun through the structure that they try to win their freedom in the end within the same rules and tournament.

Name: Gods Of Defense
Supported languages: Gods of Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense set on a procedurally generated map. Every run is new The God stands at the center of the map on top of a Temple. Enemies spawned from the gates will attack the temple. You will build towers to kill the enemies. After every wave you will push the enemy gate farther into the unknown revealing more of the map. Deck building Every few waves you will receive Boon cards from the Goddess of Fortune. These cards will give you new towers or extra perks that boost your defense.While you want to collect as many Boon cards, you want to avoid Curse cards. These are invoked by the Evil through the Corruption mechanic. Some enemies carry corruption trails that infect the towers on the way. When Corruption exceeds certain limit, the evil will invoke Curses. You must learn to avoid corruption or to mitigate the consequences of Curse cards. This aspect brings a novel variation to a typical tower defense strategy. Roguelite Progression When enough enemies have breached the temple, it will fall. Whether you win or loose, you can keep the Faith you've earned during the run. You can use it to unlock new towers and boost their abilities. Gate Bosses In each run you will face a number of bosses, once you have pushed the enemy gate far enough. As you reveal the Gate Boss , it will go berserk and spawn a torrent of enemies. Each gate comes with its unique challenge. You can choose to engage immediately or postpone it if your defense is not ready for it. Resource Management The gameplay also involves production and management of resources which aid your defense - Gold, Mana, Prayers, Matter. Each feeds into a different strategic device and opens up numerous possibilities. After you've mastered the art of defense, you will learn to build beautiful Monuments. This will exercise your resource management skills. Variety There are 40 battles to play. Each battle happens on a new map every time you play it. You can replay each battle to earn extra rewards and win Trophies by completing challenges. At any point, you have multiple options to make progress. This eliminates the typical grinding. Extra fun GoD also features two fun mini-games. A physics based mini-game lets you earn extra faith by using the surplus resources you collected during the run. A jigsaw puzzle that helps you compose the final vision.

Name: Late for School
Supported languages: Late for School is a cozy, kid-friendly driving game where you play as a brand-new school bus driver trying to get every student to class on time. Each day presents a new challenges, collectibles, and surprises. Your goal is to  pick up kids, avoid obstacles, collect lost items, and make it to school before the bell rings . But the suburbs, farms, downtown streets and special event days all introduce new twists. Core Gameplay Drive the Bus Arcade-style driving designed for all ages. Pick up students at marked stops and get them to school safely. Avoid road hazards such as puddles, construction, farm animals, and more. Earn a “Bus Badge” for completing each day's route. Collect Lost Items Each level hides a set of lost student items like books, backpacks and homework. Finding everything earns the “Finder Badge”. At the end of the game, these can be returned to students in a special finale round. Master Special Challenges Rain level  with slippery roads. Windy level where you fight push-back forces. Night level with limited visibility. UFO, Ghost and Robot encounters where strange events happen on the road and you still need to bring the kids to school safely Some levels have a “Master Badge” by completing bonus objectives or finishing levels quickly. Progression and Goals Play through a 4-week school calendar containing 20 handcrafted levels. Unlock new environments: suburbs, farms, downtown and special event days. Earn badges for completion, collecting items, and bonus achievements. Finish the journey to receive your Bus Driver Certificate

Supported languages: Balloon Blast is an arcade style third person PvP game. You play as a robotic vacuum with a knife on the front and a balloon on the back. Pop your enemies balloons to secure victory.

Our hero, despite the fact that he doesn't want to be a 'Hero', is forced to start this journey by receiving a quest from the King - to save the Princess, who was kidnapped by a mighty and Terrifying Dragon. But, as it turns out, the Dragon is not as 'Terrifying' as everyone described her; instead, she is actually just a beautiful girl who saved the Princess from a magical curse. Our hero decides to stay a little longer with the her, and slowly their affection towards each other grows.. My Furry Dragon is a short novel about love, self-discovery, family, and having fun with a dragon! Name: Teslagrad 2
Supported languages: Discover another tower In the Magnetic North! Lumina, a young Teslamancer, finds herself stranded after her airship crashes in Wyrmheim, a remote and treacherous land to the North. Embark on a dangerous adventure, exploring a gigantic, abandoned tower looming over a fjordside valley, on a quest to get Lumina home and back to her family. Use electromagnetic powers to survive the dangers of a wild and untamed land. Defend yourself against Viking raiders, face gruesome beasts inspired by Nordic mythology, and triumph against epic bosses! As your journey progresses, you’ll discover new skills and equipment needed to uncover the secrets of the land and delve into the dark past of Lumina’s ancestors. Teslagrad 2 is the follow-up to the hugely popular physics-based game where electromagnetic powers are at the heart of survival. With improved visuals, a bigger world, and new puzzle-solving tools, Teslagrad 2 delivers a fresh and immersive puzzle-platform experience! Key Features Scandinavia Meets Metroidvania . The world’s first ‘Scandivania’ – a grandiose Steampunk-meets-Norse adventure accompanied by an orchestral soundtrack inspired by Nordic folk tones and electronic tracks. Magnetic Gameplay . Test your logic skills with perplexing puzzles based on real electromagnetic physics and enjoy a new twist with curved magnets! Master Fluid Motion . Perfect new and returning skills and use them to move quickly and skillfully through the world, combining Lumina’s abilities such as blinking, sliding, and magnetizing to build extra momentum. Epic Boss Battles . Use your skills to overcome boss fights which unlock new abilities and additional areas to explore. Visual Storytelling . Teslagrad 2 unfolds through what you see, with no text, voiceover or loading screens to interrupt gameplay. Explore an Abundant World . Discover rich and beautiful 2D hand-painted environments set in a wild and ravaged world full of hidden collectibles, secrets, and lore.

Name: The wild darkness
Supported languages: You have been summoned to this world against your will. You know nothing, and everything here is utterly strange. You must find your own food, and monsters emerge at night. A moment of carelessness could send you to the next world. However, if you persevere and challenge yourself, you will accumulate knowledge, and the totems and crafting recipes you collect will allow you to progress through the game more smoothly. It will likely require a great deal of patience and focus, but there will be an equal amount of excitement and thrill in the adventure. Now, be brave. Destiny awaits. A Survival Story in an Unknown World This world contains countless regions, such as cool plains, cold tundras, and sultry jungles. There are various interactions with nature, such as lighting a fire when cold or cooling down in water when hot. Learning about the ecology and nature of this world will make it easier to survive. You can experience various stories as you progress through the game. Diverse Classes with Unique Abilities You can choose one of various classes to explore this world. Initially, only the Adventurer is selectable, but you can unlock new classes by meeting specific conditions. Gather, Craft, and Build This world is filled with various gatherable resources. You can use these to craft various items like delicious dishes, potions, and equipment. You can unlock new functions by constructing various facilities. For example, you can craft potions with an Alchemist's Cauldron, and building a Human Cannon will allow you to travel to distant regions. If you are short on materials, try finding a merchant and attempting a trade. Into a New Adventure with Good Equipment and Magic Equipment can come with outlandish modifiers, including beneficial options or harmful ones. Different skills are used depending on the weapon and gear equipped. There are spell scrolls and castable magic, and magic becomes more powerful when enhanced.

Name: The Wizards Who Fell In A Hole
Supported languages: The Wizards Who Fell In A Hole When two of the most magically gifted wizards on this (or any other) planet set out on a quiet stroll one evening, neither of them are aware of the terrifying adventure that awaits them. They only have themselves to blame for bringing it on, however, as they fail to see a giant hole in the ground and take an absent-minded wander straight into it, leading them to a cave of unspeakably horrible monsters. Their only way out is to navigate through 100 deviously dangerous levels... ...which is where you come in! The Wizards Who Fell In A Hole is a one- or two-player platform game in which each player controls a wizard who can jump and shoot at a variety of monsters, with the aim being to kill all monsters on a level before progressing. There are special items to give you various power-ups and help you along the way, and lots of tasty food to be eaten to rack up the high scores and extra lives.

Name: Battle Bandits
Supported languages: Battle Bandits is a top down tank shooter with customisable tanks and 30 levels to complete! Different tank builds can be used to suit your playstyle. Tanks are made of two parts. The Chassis and the Mount. Both are available in the garage. While the chassis is responsible for the health, primary weapon, tank speed, etc, different mounts have unique secondary weapons to deal with the enemies.

Name: Hostile Takeover
Supported languages: Take control of a small team of contractors, hired by mysterious suits for impossible jobs against powerful corporations. Your contractors each have custom cybernetics that allow them to use a host of abilities, represented by cards. These cards are used in turn-based combat for actions such as movement, attacking, defending, and special abilities. Along with combat, you'll also encounter events, character upgrades, and black market shops as you explore each corporation. It's Called Power, Not Mana Playing cards costs power, and the bad news is each round your team's power is reset to zero. The good news is that each card not only has a cost, but a gain as well, which can be converted into power when discarded. Do you keep each team member balanced and focus your power on the character with the best draws each round? Or do you turn one of your characters into a recycler to fuel their killing machine companion? Unique Character Classes Each player character is represented by a different class, and each class has their own unique cards to build a deck from. One may rely on shields to reduce incoming damage, while another may instead disappear, forcing enemies to attack another target. Character Defining Upgrades Along with adding new cards to character decks, characters can also be modified through cybernetic upgrades that you occasionally come across. Unlike abilities, these upgrades are always active and can greatly change how a character plays. Discover synergies between upgrades to become even stronger! Random-ish Levels Hand-made environments and encounters are pieced together through procedural generation to build each unique level. Changing layouts, hazards, and events keep each run fresh, while enemy encounters and combat maps are designed for fun and challenge.

Name: Lefty
Supported languages: Step into the Whimsical World Of Lefty! Welcome to Lefty, a cozy 3D puzzle game set in a colorful, whimsical, and strange world. Join Lefty, a unique left-handed character, on a journey to find the way home—one step at a time. But there’s a twist: in this world, Lefty can only move to the right! Key Features Culturally Inspired Gameplay Experience gameplay inspired by the Arabic cultural tradition of preferring to use the right hand in everyday life. Navigate through fun, satisfying puzzles that challenge your mind in delightful ways. Unique Movement Mechanics Control Lefty as he moves exclusively to the right. Shift your perspective, rotating each level to the right, adding layers of complexity and strategy to each puzzle, and ensuring every move counts. Whimsical Art Style Immerse yourself in Lefty’s simple, whimsical, and colorful art style. Quirky otherworldly visuals that delight and disorient in equal measure! Increasing Complexity Tackle mazes that become progressively more complex, featuring obstacles like moving walls, rising walls, moving goals, locked paths, and flipping mazes. Plan your path carefully to overcome each challenge. Puzzle Variety Encounter a wide variety of puzzles that require active planning and quick thinking. Navigate through mazes with minimal rotations and master the unique mechanics of this right-turning world. Accessible Controls Enjoy super accessible and easy-to-use controls, whether you prefer a controller or mouse and keyboard. Lefty is designed to be approachable for all players. Why You'll Love Lefty Lefty is perfect for fans of cozy games, puzzle games, and casual games. Its unique blend of cultural inspiration, whimsical art, and simply-yet-satisfying mechanics hopes to offer a charming experience. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or seeking a stimulating challenge, Lefty will give you a delightful escape into a world where every turn matters. So, what are you waiting for? Embark on Lefty's journey and see the world from a new perspective—one right turn at a time!

Name: Hunteroids

Our sophisticated weapon will make them disappear but we cannot use it because of our fragile legs! Luckly, you are here to help! But... You can only hunt one kind of meteorite with specific shape, color and rotation ... No worries! Create bubbles in the sky to transform all meteorites into the pattern given by the weapon and hunt them! Change their shape, color and rotation and save the city! The Basic Mechanics are shown in the picture below. Meteorites will come from the sky to destroy the city. Your goal is to create bubbles to transform them into the pattern given by your weapon. There are 3 types of bubbles: Red Bubbles: They will change the shape of the meteorites (square, circle, triangle). Blue Bubbles: They will change the colour of the meteorites (green, pink, blue). Yellow Bubbles: They will change the rotation of the meteorites. And remember! The bigger the bubble is, the more transformations the meteorite will suffer! CAMPAIGN You have been chosen to protect all our cities from meteorites! There are 5 levels per city (meteor showers). Will each city survive the attack? It depends on you! Each city will bring new mechanisms ! The number of cities available will depend on the version you have. See 'Versions' section for more detailed information. For certain cities, if you get 3 stars , you will get an achievement . For certain cities, if you save them, you will unblock new challenges . If you save the first 3 cities, you will unblock the Survival Mode. Online Leaderboard : Compite with other players and be part of the Hall Of Fame! CHALLENGES Different types of challenges: Life, Bubbles, Time or combination of all of them. Per challenge, you will have limited Life, number of Bubbles and Time to survive! The challenges will be linked to the campaign mode and the city (and mechanics) learnt! Steam Achievements if you manage to success and get 3 stars! Online Leaderboard : Compite with other players and be part of the Hall Of Fame! SURVIVAL Survive as many levels as possible and transform the maximum number of meteorites among other players. Online Leaderboard : Compite with other players and be part of the Hall Of Fame! Hunteroids will be delivered in two releases : DEMO The Demo has the following features: 3 basic cities with 9 levels + 3 improved tutorials explaining the basis Gamepad support English/Spanish support Steam in the Cloud Local Scores (Stars, Life, Bubbles, Time) FULL VERSION ROADMAP The following features will be included in the Full Version: 8 cities (+40 levels) in the Campaign Mode. Imbued with access to super computers and quantum state manipulation as a failsafe prototype, you are in a data center laboratory, the Crystal Corruption is expanding. The Forbidden City is full of fun to visit through the real picture, so that players can feel the solemnity and majesty of the Forbidden City without leaving home. There are also some mini games designed based on cultural and historical events, through which players can have a better understanding of the cultural knowledge of the Forbidden City. This will increase players' interest in the Forbidden City and even Chinese culture.

Name: SOMNIFUGE
Supported languages: A cryptic note draws you to an old mansion on a stormy night. Inside, the halls stretch and twist in ways they shouldn't, and the air is thick with something unseen. As you explore, you must solve cryptic puzzles , confront the residents , and unravel the past . SOMNIFUGE is a first-person psychological horror game blending exploration, puzzle-solving, and surreal horror . Inspired by the haunting atmospheres of Silent Hill and Alone in the Dark , it embraces PSX-era visuals to create a world that feels both nostalgic and deeply unsettling. From the creator of the popular indie horror shorts Burger & Frights and Dreader , SOMNIFUGE delivers a tense, atmospheric horror experience where nothing is as it seems. Features: The World : Explore the haunted mansion , a maze-like library , a twisted hospital ward , and more cursed locations. Puzzle Solving : Crack the many cryptic puzzles . Survival : Meet and escape the host of horrors . Controller Support : The game has full 360 controller support .

Name: 我獨自升級英文(1)
Supported languages: ===一套遊戲二套玩法=== (1)劇情冒限模式(適合一邊玩一邊學習)  以傳統RPG遊戲的方式冒險、打怪、闖關救人，如果遇到過不去的小關卡就查字典，當然，闖關時找朋友或同學一起來腦力激蕩會更有趣。 (2)地產建設模式:(適合一邊複習,同時建設城城市遊玩)  相同的世界故事線, 幾百年後, 魔王不甘平凡, 開始起了抄地皮的壞心思。 於是一場 勇者 VS 魔王 相互搶錢的之爭就此展開。  ===更多介紹=== (一)這是一部怎樣的作品(雙重設定) (1)要冒險也要學習 這是一部自由開放式的RPG冒險遊戲,想冒險就冒險,想學習就學習。 這也是一部故事內容有趣、劇情感人的遊戲。 當然,這一定是一部充滿美少女、美少男的遊戲。(12+限定) (2)是遊戲也是英文單字學習工具 這也是一部『輔助背單字』的工具遊戲。 內容包含雅思(IELTS) 以及 託福(TOEFL)共用中階英文單字1200個。 這也是『轉生打怪學英文系列』的系列作,其餘『我獨自升級系列』作品將陸續發售。 無論您是國高中學生還是在職場工作...; 這絕對是一部能『提升英文技能』的最佳工具，更是一部能收藏一輩子的遊戲。 (二)如何開始玩這部作品 進入遊戲後，決定好主角的性別及職業，之後就能開始自由冒險。 攻略方法有二種 (1)想獲得最佳的遊戲體驗 : 以傳統RPG遊戲的方式冒險、打怪、闖關救人，如果遇到過不去的小關卡就查字典，當然，闖關時找朋友或同學一起來腦力激蕩會更有趣。 (2)想獲得最佳的學習體驗 : 這部作品收集了雅思(IELTS) 以及 託福(TOEFL) 常考的1200個中階單字，按照遊戲設定的引導，一邊背英文單字一邊解世界任務(即使不學習也能通關)。 (三)遊戲結束您會獲得什麼 (1)您將獲得玩遊戲的樂趣。 (2)你將熟悉1200個中階單字。 (3)完成所有系列六部作品之後,如果您有8000+以上的單字量,就相當於: -專業英語4級(TEM-4) -全民英檢中高級(臺灣) -雅思(IELTS) 以及 託福(TOEFL)可以一腳踏入高分的門檻了。

The game is perfect for relaxing and having great fun. Incredible Atmosphere , Great Music , lots of fun with dragons and sharks. The game is great for relaxing after a hard day. This is an infinity run game in which the main character riding a dragon and flying over fields and villages has to dodge enemies-sharks. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. Features Riding the Dragon. Beautiful animations Nice graphics Relaxing gameplay Sharks Pleasant atmosphere.

Name: Été
Supported languages: Été [pronounced /ay·tay/, French for 'summer'] is a relaxing painting game made for people who love exploration and creativity. Step into the shoes of a budding painter who travels abroad to Montreal for a summer. Unleash color with your paintbrush to freely explore the city and capture its everyday wonders on canvas. Befriend locals by fulfilling their inspiring commissions or prepare an original expo in your very own art studio. Features: Explore Montreal in the summer Use gorgeous watercolor to paint the world in 3D and reveal its wonders. Roam around peaceful open city scenes and bring them to life by filling them with color. Collect ideas for your album Everything you discover while exploring — from flowers to birds — is added to your album, an ever-growing compendium of stamps that you can then mix and match in your artworks. Create artworks on canvas Create gorgeous 2D watercolor artworks effortlessly with Été's unique canvas system. Any stamp collected in your album can be added to your composition, moved, resized, recolored, and even spun around in 3D! Show off your talent Some NPCs will commission you with inspiring requests for specific artworks, but you're also free to paint as many unrestricted creative artworks as you like. Those artworks can then be hung on your walls or auctioned at the local café... and maybe, if you get famous enough, be exhibited in your very own exposition. Decorate your studio and your apartment Build your ideal creative nook by collecting furniture and arranging it your way with Été's flexible decoration system. Decorations can be placed precisely where you want them, combined into complex set pieces, and even recolored! Mix your own colors Find rare pigment collectibles hidden throughout the city to mix new dyes for your artworks and decorations. Befriend the neighbours Meet dozens of locals with colorful personalities as you get acquainted with your new city. Some of your neighbours will have paid commissions for you to fulfill, while others will tend to unique shops that let you spend your hard-earned money on decorations. Relax and smell the flowers Été is a deeply relaxing game with no failure and no pressure. There is no time limit, no wrong way to paint and no order in which to explore or complete quests. Take things at your own pace and let your worries go as you immerse in your new life as the friendly neighborhood painter. Été is a labor of love from Impossible, a small & diverse team of indies based in Montréal.
Header image: “Été is a sincere, optimistic game that reminds us that it’s never too late to start again. Even when it seems impossible to uproot ourselves from our current situations, we can always find a way to make a new home anywhere we land. A blank canvas doesn’t have to be intimidating; it’s an opportunity.” Giovanni Colantonio, Digital Trends “Été is less about the process of making art on a canvas, and more about making players feel as if they are making the world more beautiful. It lets you make art without any of the friction.” Vincent Acovino, The Guardian “Été [is] an experience that celebrates the beauty in everyday life. A chance to pause, reflect and savor the quiet moments. The developers at Impossible strived to immerse players into the game, and they hit the ball out of the park.” 10/10 – Bright Mylar, Gamer Social Club

Name: 勇者之灾 Calamity from the Yongzhe
Supported languages: This is a unique experimental RPG game built upon a fantastical imaginary worldview. This work is created based on an imaginary worldview, where all characters, plots, locations, and events are purely fictional. Any coincidences are purely accidental. At the core of this game lies an epic adventure story filled with both laughter and tears, narrating the roller-coaster experiences between the king who unified the world and the brave team that sets out to defeat the king. The entire game consists of ten chapters, cleverly incorporating numerous internet meme-inspired plots. Although limited production costs may result in some minor bugs, the game's overall unique style and rich gameplay are sure to offer players a distinctive gaming experience. Detailed Introduction: In the year 572 of the New Calendar, a human hero slew the Demon King. In the year 653 of the New Calendar, the Demon King resurrected, and the brave warriors and adventurers jointly defeated him, an event known as the 'Calamity of the Demon King.' In the year 673 of the New Calendar, the world was unified, marking the first time in recorded human history that such an achievement was made. Eventually, that adventurer became the king of all humanity. In the year 715 of the New Calendar, a young brave warrior emerged, embarking on a journey of destiny... In this world plagued by monsters and villains, players can assume the role of the king who unified the world, governing with authority and leading the people; or they can transform into members of the brave team set out to defeat the king, using their courage to defeat villains and help others. During the adventure, players will gradually uncover the hidden sorrows and truths behind this absurd world, ultimately facing the final boss and ushering in a happy and fulfilling ending. The game features a wide variety of meticulously designed scenes. ranging from bustling towns to eerie caves, from mysterious forests to treacherous mountains, each filled with exploration opportunities. Additionally, the game is equipped with a diverse range of special items and skills, allowing players to flexibly combine and utilize them according to different combat scenarios and enemy characteristics, formulating their own exclusive combat strategies. The game boasts a rich and diverse array of gameplay mechanics and unique systems. Among them, the item crafting system provides players with in-depth exploration and creative enjoyment. Players can collect various basic materials throughout the game world and, through careful research of crafting recipes, skillfully combine these materials to create powerful weapons, armor, and items with special effects. These self-made items not only play a crucial role in combat, helping players defeat formidable enemies, but also satisfy players' pursuit of personalized equipment, making each character unique. In terms of combat, the game adopts a real-time turn-based combat mode that relies on speed bars. In combat scenarios, each character and enemy possesses an independent speed bar, with the filling speed determined by the character's own speed attribute. When a speed bar is filled, the character can take action, with the order of actions arranged according to the completion sequence of the speed bars. This combat mode retains the strategic nature of turn-based combat, requiring players to carefully consider each move and plan skill releases and attack targets reasonably; at the same time, it incorporates the tension of real-time elements, with the dynamic changes of the speed bars constantly tugging at players' heartstrings, demanding quick decision-making at critical moments to grasp the rhythm of combat. Characters with high speed can attack more frequently, seizing the initiative in combat, while those with slow speed must rely on powerful skills or defensive abilities to turn the tide in limited action opportunities. And the name of this tale is 'Calamity from the Yongzhe.'   In addition, the game may contain content that is uncomfortable for some, such as adult themes and graphic violence. Players are advised to choose to play the game with caution based on their own levels of acceptance. The game is still under development and is completely free. Thank you all for playing.

In strategy mode the player can choose from three major races: treacherous Humans, vicious Foresters and merciless Darklings. In addition to these primary races, the player can subjugate and develop some of the five smaller independent nations: Shades, Nomads, Dragons, Trolls, and Elves. Combined with the player’s main race they provide a valuable asset when clashing with their opponents. In adventure mode the player controls a group of heroes and a small squad of troops uncovering dark secrets and surprising twists as the adventure unfolds. The story spans over several generations, portraying powerful ancient artifacts, the rise and fall of mighty leaders and glorious kingdoms, and the birth of new mystic creatures and races. Name: Tribute of Minos
Supported languages: The idea of the game is quite simple. You're in a maze, you have a key, and you want to escape. Obstacles lay within the Labyrinth such as traps, starvation, those alive inside, and of course the Minotaur.  The game features turn based movement for strategic use of consumables, a difficult to navigate map, limited visibility, and the pressure of needed to satiate hunger to stay alive.  Combat is not turn based, instead both combatants have a variety of actions which can be used to attack, defend, hinder the enemy, or buff oneself. Combat is done in a sort of rhythm game style bars which contain these actions. Collectables within the Labyrinth can be used strategically to help you survive. Name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
Supported languages: Following a horrific incident, Blood Wizard ends up trapped within the Mind Prison of a dangerous entity. With his powers crippled, he is forced to resort to fickle and unreliable sleep magic to attempt his escape. To earn freedom, he must fight his way through perilous dungeons of Dream, seek advice from mysterious locals and discover secrets. Gameplay: Dungeons of Blood and Dream is a randomly generated dungeon crawler with roguelike elements in which the player will wield an array of bladed weapons and harness wondrous spells to fight through hordes of skeletons, zombies, slimes and other disgusting creatures that dwell in the dungeons. No two playthroughs are the same! Features: Procedurally generated dungeons filled with enemies, treasures, traps and secrets; Many cursed rings with unique powers. Their effects change depending on what finger the ring is on; Great many unique weapons, each with different effects; Several NPCs to talk to; Meta progression unlocks that remain inbetween playthroughs; Randomly generated potions with effects varying from one playthrough to another; Many enemies and bosses to discover; Multiple endings; Secret rooms, levels and areas with their own enemies and boss fights; Lots of items, levels and features to unlock in game.

Name: ShellMobile: Titan Rampart
Supported languages: Core Concept: Mechs as shells, guarding civilization. ShellMobile takes its name from the idea that tech—like a nut protecting its pulp—sees mechs, warships, and stations as life's shields. Upholding 'Machines for humanity,' the company developed the Titanium Rampart Defense System after titanium refining breakthroughs, forming the unbreakable Titanium Rampart Line against aliens. Core Element: Titanium Titanium Lifeline : Extraterrestrial titanium is humanity’s tech foundation. Players send miners to extract it for defense upgrades and mech production. Titanium Rampart Line : 5th-gen alloy walls blend alien materials with quantum lattice tech, equipped with self-adaptive nano-repairs that instantly rebuild plasma-damaged structures and deploy antimatter against 'Ether-Eater' flyers. Core Gameplay: Civilizational Clash, Tech Counterattack After a decade’s hibernation, aliens return with 'Venomfang' ground mechs (plasma drills) and 'Ether-Eater' swarms (gravitational maneuvering). As commander, players must: Deploy Defenses : Install pulse EM cannons between titanium walls to intercept flyers. Mech Strikes : Lead Nut Shell forces in 'Dawnbreaker' mechs with antimatter missiles. Unlock weapons like Titanium Railguns and Dimensional Shields to fend off the horde.

Name: Skybound Colonies
Supported languages: High above the clouds, where the surface of the world lies lost and forgotten, a new era of kingdoms is about to begin. You are the ruler of a fledgling realm, building across floating islands to forge a thriving empire among the skies. Gather grain from fertile fields, harvest wood from towering groves, seek knowledge under clear horizons, and nurture the faith of your people. Each choice you make strengthens your realm and shapes its destiny. Expand to new islands, connect them with trade, and take advantage of unique bonuses hidden within the land. From humble beginnings, you will raise a kingdom that defies gravity itself. Start small with a single island, gather resources, and unlock new buildings. As you progress, expand to other islands, balance production, and trade resources between them. Every decision brings your realm closer to greatness. Build Among the Clouds Raise villages, temples, and workshops across floating islands, shaping a kingdom in the skies. Manage the Four Pillars of Prosperity Food, Resources, Research, and Faith are the foundation of your realm. Balance them wisely to keep your kingdom thriving. Expand Across the Isles Claim new islands and uncover unique bonuses that boost your production and open new paths for growth. Trade and Connect Link your islands and exchange resources to create a strong, interconnected realm. Skybound Colonies is currently in Early Access While the experience is fully playable, some features are still in development. The current version includes the complete tutorial campaign, Endless Mode, and the core building mechanics. However, there are still a few limitations: Progress saving in Endless Mode is not yet available. Expanded settings for fine-tuned sound adjustments and graphic quality controls are planned but not implemented. Your feedback will help guide future updates and shape the growth of the kingdom!

Name: Hard, Fast, & Flashy
Supported languages: WARNING: THIS GAME IS HARD AS F***!! Run, jump, and blast your way through an unforgiving cyberscape at breakneck speeds, pushing your mind and body to their limits in the never ending pursuit of perfection. Studies show that nearly 15% of people enjoy being punished...Do you like it hard and fast? FEATURES: Precise, first-person shooter meets fast-paced platformer to create a unique speedrunning challenge. 10 levels with difficulties ranging from “It took 15 tries but I finally got it!” to “THIS S*** IS F****** IMPOSSIBLE!!” (though we promise every level is beatable) A pulse-pounding, electronic soundtrack that’s guaranteed to keep your heart pumping. Blaze through a synthwave cyberscape with high-octane, momentum-based movement. Non-linear level design allows for creative strategies to achieve maximum speed - this game is meant to be broken! It’s free! This is a passion project that we want to share with you, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do! INSPIRATIONS: Inspired by challenging, fair, and fast-paced games like Dark Souls, Quake, and Celeste, we sought out to develop a game that combined our favorite parts from each. The result was Hard, Fast, and Flashy: a momentum-based platformer with retro aesthetics and a definitively modern gameplay feel. UPCOMING FIXES: Improved performance through animation rendering. Improved camera angle (modified FOV, visible feet, centered model). Additional settings for key rebinds, VSYNC, and mouse sensitivity. Reworked physics to allow for greater conservation of momentum and better aerial control. Reworked instructions and menus. Voice acting for player character and main menu.

Name: Kapital: Sparks of Revolution
Supported languages: Kapital: Sparks of Revolution is a sandbox city-builder focused on crisis management. It is a game about crisis and permanent conflict in human society. You will run out of vital resources in times you need them the most. People will protest and riot despite your best efforts to help them. Not everyone will survive. There is no way to avoid the crisis, you have to live through it. You’ll have to run a city with limited resources. To balance between people's needs and city development. To deal with angry crowds on the streets. You are the one to shape the future of your people. Just remember - you can't make everyone happy. The population of your city consists of 3 classes: nobles, bourgeois and workers. Each class has a unique role in the city economy. Nobles serve as officials and policemen, bourgeois pay taxes while workers provide the labor force. Their vision of the future is very different and they are ready to fight for it. Running the city is not an easy task. Your resources are limited while people’s demands are high. You have to decide who will get food and shelter first. Be prepared to face new threats on a regular basis. Epidemics, accidents, sabotages, hostage situations - the city will fall apart unless you make a difference. People whose needs go unsatisfied will hold a grudge against your rule. Some of them will become dissidents and radicals. They will form secret societies to overthrow you. Protests on the streets will turn into massacres and riots. You have to make a tough choice of which class to support and which to suppress. You will research new technologies and adopt new laws to improve the lives of your citizens. You will fight crime, tackle corruption and maintain order on the streets. As a ruler of the city, you have the ultimate power to shape the future of your society. The question is how far will you go to reach that goal?

The close relationship between developers and players is central to what makes Old School so magical. So, you want to be a master cook? Or a powerful mage? Whether you’re here for the rich story and lore, the challenging combat, to fight alongside others or against them, to journey alone or simply to experience the magical world of Gielinor, Old School can be any adventure you want. Master 23 diverse skills across a huge array of play styles Take on over 140 quests spanning the fascinating and varied game world Confront dozens and dozens of bosses Risk everything in an assortment of PvP encounters Profit from a thriving and dynamic in-game economy Some people just want to hang out with friends. And you’ll find plenty of folk to do that with in Gielinor. But those who want seek a different kind of adventure have plenty of choices, too. No matter what you’re specializing in, the quest for the best loot will have skillers and perfectionists obsessing over their character builds. The strongest wand, the mightiest bow, the most *fabulous* hat – there’s always something to aim for. And if you’re among the most ardent adventurers, be sure to let people know by donning one of the many Capes of Accomplishment. Who knows, maybe one day the fabled Max Cape can be yours? A rich story and deep well of lore await those whose interests are more cerebral, too. From the dastardly dealings of corrupt rulers to the day-to-day musings of the village baker, tales of both... world-shattering urgency and casual procrastination abound. Over two dozen major quest-lines allow players to delve into Gielinor’s past and future, and the pages are still being written, waiting for you to witness their unfolding. With major game updates every week, the experience never stops evolving and improving. This world goes where you go, too, with full cross-compatibility across PC and mobile versions! The key to Old School’s success is both special and unique – it’s you! Name: 幻想三国志4外传
Supported languages: 角色扮演游戏《幻想三国志》的最终回。采用了双主角路线，补完《幻想三国志4》在剧情中没有交代的情结，以及以楼澈为主的全新剧情故事，包括他如何来到人间，如何与紫丞相遇及其与紫丞分开后的故事。 特色 ·新的双主角系统 ·新增战斗人物，可以自行设定战斗阵形 ·保留了战斗事件 ·新增宝袋系统及原创剧情 ·绝妙的神化系统 ·包含资料片“三界秘闻录” 双主角系统 紫丞篇 紫丞，魔君紫狩之子，身为魔族少主，同事拥有人类和魔族的血统，这样特殊的身世使得紫丞能自由使用人类及魔界的力量，但这样不凡的身世也养成紫丞内敛、不轻易泄露自己情感的个性，在紫丞篇中，将以紫丞，即魔族的角度来发展剧情走向。 楼澈篇 楼澈，仙人相丹之徒，善良纯真，心胸宽阔，因缘际会下合紫丞成为莫逆之交，却也因此成为其他仙人眼中离经叛道之徒，在楼澈篇中，将以楼澈，即仙人的角度来发展剧情走向。 战斗系统 阵形系统 本作在战斗人物上，由原本的五位新增了璎珞、苏袖与南宫毓这三个角色可参与战斗，总数增为八位。玩家可于阵形界面自行编辑自己的战斗阵容，组队变化性大增。此外，还能自行设定战斗阵形，由玩家们自行决定主角站立的阵形位置。攻击模式不再一成不变，玩家们必须依不同人物能力、属性来谋定战略才能出奇制胜。 战斗事件 战斗事件是在战斗中会出现的剧情事件，会依战斗难度出现不同的事件变化，玩家可以依据战斗事件的完成成功与否，获得等级不同的宝箱奖励当作报酬。 化神系统：腾蛇的技能 腾蛇的技能分为神性发动与攻击两大系，可说是攻击与防守兼具。神性发动系之下可产生各式各样的辅助技能，以利战斗的进行；而攻击系的腾蛇，可怕的程度是不下鹰涯、苏袖两人，加上类似雷咒、火咒的常态性大范围攻击技能，腾蛇绝对是你可以依赖的好伙伴。 神性系 看似攻击强悍的腾蛇，如果肯在神性系下工夫，将有机会培养成攻守兼具的特殊化神。不论是减慢敌方全体速度、增加我方出手速度，甚至是我方每次动作时回复一定比例的体力，虽然血量偏低，但是神性发动后直接减少我方15%的伤势，更可让我方队伍立于不败之地。 黑色火焰攻击系 腾蛇以优异的战斗能力出名，凭借的就是无往不利魔界黑火。腾蛇曾说过：“要用黑火烧尽九州！”如果你能正确认识他的能力，就知道这不是信口开河。黑火释放后的堕灵形态可以让出手时的攻击范围以及攻击威力加强，再加上堕灵蓄劲提供的招式威力加成，对我方可说是一大助力！特殊技“燃尽”，在特殊的战斗中可以破除BOSS难缠的状态，更是不可不点的技能。 宝袋系统 玩家中获得的物品，包括武器、装备、晶魄、暗器等等，可以借由宝袋系统，加以打碎回收成为宝沙，再利用消费宝袋累积的宝沙值，让目前已经拥有的装备加以强化，成为灵气系、宝光系等不同种类的新武器装备。灵气系、宝光系的武器装备也各自代表拥有不同的威力加乘以及附加属性等强化状态。在游戏进行中，玩家要善用宝袋的能力，才能够在诸多BOSS战斗以及多元的战斗事件里旗开得胜。

Name: Vaca Bullet
Supported languages: In 'Vaca Bullet' you will step into the shoes of a cowboy in the Wild West, who must defend his vacas(cows) from the dreaded bullets of bandits trying to steal them. This game is a tribute to those 'Western' movies, full of shootouts and chases, all achieved through beautiful pixel art that seeks to give it a raw and unique essence like a true western. 'Vaca Bullet' is easy and simple to learn to play, but that doesn't take away from how challenging the game can be, as it seeks to recreate shootouts and frenetic battles where bullets cross the screen in a matter of seconds, and a single bullet can kill both you and your enemies. The game offers you a wide range of weapons inspired by the Old West, with a six-shooter revolver being the most iconic weapon in the game, a shotgun that fires multiple bullets at once, and a bow that can shoot across the sky without exposing you to enemy fire. Finally, if you thought that was all, there's another layer of depth, as you must be careful where you shoot. In his fury, he unleashed a curse bound to an heirloom doll—a keepsake that fuels the land’s restless spirits to this day. Name: A walk in Hwaseong Temporary Palace at night
Supported languages: As the last light of sunset fades and night begins to settle in, the player slowly walks through Hwaseong Temporary Palace from a first-person perspective, experiencing the space directly. The game contains no complex controls, combat, or puzzles—its structure consists solely of walking. This simplicity allows players to carefully observe their surroundings and absorb the atmosphere at their own pace. The architecture, ambient sounds, and shifting light of the real Hwaseong Palace have been recreated to naturally guide the player’s emotions as they move through the environment. The core of the experience lies in time and atmosphere . The soft glow just before the sunset disappears, the gradual descent of evening darkness, and the unique blend between the two create a distinctive mood each time you play. Rather than relying on elaborate mechanics, the game focuses on subtle visual and auditory changes—shifts in color temperature, the length of shadows, the sound of wind brushing against structures—inviting players to experience each moment with heightened awareness. Because walking is the only interaction, the game’s flow is entirely shaped by how much the player looks around and which paths they choose to follow. There are no guides, missions, or objectives within Hwaseong Temporary Palace. You are free to linger in one spot for as long as you wish or move on quickly without constraint. The first-person perspective amplifies the sense of scale, texture, and directional sound, making the walk feel like a genuine nighttime visit to the palace grounds. With intentionally minimal elements, the game encourages the player to interpret the space on their own, leading to a different emotional experience each time. This title aims to create immersion solely through environment and perspective, without dramatic events or external stimulation. The quiet sound of footsteps, the faint echo of the distant city, and the rustling of leaves blend together subtly, while the shifting colors of the screen guide the tone of the experience. You can never fully predict what scenery will appear in the next moment, yet the transitions focus on calmness and contemplation rather than tension. Warning: This game contains dark areas and occasional abrupt changes in brightness. Individuals with a history of photosensitive epilepsy or related conditions should consult a doctor before playing. If you experience dizziness, eye strain, or discomfort, stop playing immediately and rest. Maintaining an appropriate distance from your screen and playing in a sufficiently lit environment is recommended.

Name: Subsurface Circular
Supported languages: MEET THE LOCALS, PICK UP THE LINGO A detective stationed on the Subsurface Circular investigates a series of disappearances among the city’s robotic working class. Collect words and phrases, then use them in dialogue puzzles to uncover the world's secrets and determine its future. This self-contained short story takes around two hours to complete and is split into several chapters. You can play the game in one sitting or, if you prefer, unfold the story in smaller pieces that can fit into a busier schedule. Subsurface Circular is inspired by classic adventure games and modern dialogue systems, and developed by the award-winning team behind Thomas Was Alone and Volume.  Key Features A polished, one-sitting game. A graphical twist on the classic text-based adventure. Uses 'Focus Points', a unique vocabulary-based inventory system. Original soundtrack by Dan Le Sac.  Comprehensive art gallery featuring the detailed work that went into this world.  Unlockable ‘BithellBot’, our interactive take on a developer’s commentary. FAQs If this game is ‘short’, what’s to stop me getting a refund when I’m done? You’re browsing Steam, which means you understand the work that goes into games, and are in principle up for paying for ones that entertain you. We hope that after a bit of time with Subsurface Circular, you’ll feel good about the price you paid. Why is the game only available in English? As you can imagine, a text adventure game contains a terrifying amount of text, but more importantly, throughout the game we use the particular quirks of word ordering and double meaning in English to support the combination and recombination of threads. Put simply, other languages are going to be more than a straight translation: They’re going to need rewrites and changed design. Not impossible, but more than we could get done this time around.

Name: Yet Another Jumping Game
Supported languages: Yet Another Jumping Game is about one very simple idea: jumping up. You are a small character in a tall place, and your goal is to reach the top to find fun. There is no fighting, and no running from danger. Each platform is something you can stand on, even if it looks like you can't. Some platforms are close together, and some are far apart. This game is played with the mouse (mostly). There are no enemies at all. Gravity is obviously present, but doesn’t work on everything, just you. Falling is really the only punishment in the game. If you miss a platform, you fall until you land somewhere (no fall damage though). You are free to try to get to the top as many times as you'd like. Learning how long you stay in the air, and how high and far you go is critical. However, after you get upgrades, your jumps will change, both farther and/or higher, and you will have to learn again. As you climb higher, the platforms will change in nature as well. You must jump from the right precise position, or may need to go get upgrades and return to progress. Without enemies, the biggest challenge is patience. Rushing will usually make you fall. Every fall teaches you something new: maybe you jumped too early, maybe you jumped too late. There is a bar that appears over your head when you hold down the jump button; use it wisely. The game is just your character, the platforms, gravity, and upgrades, (and a single song, if you want to play it). The game also features a jump counter, a height counter, and makes text comments on the situation and gameplay. Yet Another Jumping Game isn’t about winning fast, but it could be if you're really good. TL;DR The story is that you must jump to find fun. Character progression includes upgrades and jumping. Game mechanics include jumping and a single, looping song (if you choose to listen to it). Playtime depends on skill, but could be up to 40 hours or more of jumping. This is a 2D Precision Platformer where you jump and likely, fall. Jump Counter, Height Counter, and Text-Based Comments from the Character included.

Name: Texplore
Supported languages: Texplore is a roguelite digging-and-combat game where every run challenges you to go deeper. Drill through a collapsing Earth, fight what lives below, haul valuables back to the surface, and spend your winnings to push farther next attempt—until you can build the rocket and escape to a harsher world. Each run is a fast loop of descend → mine & fight → cash out → upgrade → dive again , with risky choices that can supercharge you or end the run early. THE CORE LOOP Start each run with only a drill and a weak jetpack. Mine resources, fight enemies for XP, and sell loot at the Shop for per-run upgrades (drill power, jetpack fuel, hull armor, weapons). When you die or get stuck, you earn Skill Points based on performance to invest in permanent meta-progression that makes every new run start stronger. KEY FEATURES Procedurally generated worlds : randomized caves, ore veins, enemy placements, and boss positions every run Cash-out economy : sell what you mine to upgrade drill, jetpack, hull, inventory, and weapons (per-run) Performance-based meta progression : earn Skill Points by how well you do and invest them in permanent upgrades between runs Lucky Roll upgrade wheel : spend XP (100 per roll) to gamble for powerful run-changing boosts—from Common to Legendary rarity Teleporters (rare finds) : discover and collect teleport items to reposition quickly or escape dangerous situations Autominer & Factory buildings : unlock passive mining and craft rocket parts from resources (goal: 50 parts to launch) Bosses & milestones : depth achievements and a boss per world with massive coin/XP rewards Moon endgame : rarer resources, tougher enemies, and a brutal boss waiting at the bottom Built for controller play : full gamepad navigation across all menus and gameplay ⚠️ Important : Shop upgrades reset each run—this is why building permanent upgrades in the Skill Tree matters. Start each new run stronger than before

As you settle in, Anh Hai gradually uncovers a dark and unsettling mystery shrouding the village. Name: 8AM: The Swimming Pool
Supported languages: ' 8AM: The Swimming Pool ' plunges the player into a tense and enigmatic experience of observation and judgment, set beneath the dim lights of an empty public pool. The night has fallen, and the facility is about to close. Only a few late swimmers remain — tired, silent, and seemingly ordinary. You are stationed in the control room, surrounded by flickering monitors, hearing the distant echo of water and the hum of fluorescent lights. You don’t know why you are there, nor who asked you to watch. Your only task: observe. Yet, as the clock approaches midnight, the calm surface of the pool begins to conceal something far less tranquil. From that moment, the surveillance feed begins to reveal strange anomalies — shadows moving where no one should be, reflections that don’t match their owners, and swimmers whose gestures grow more erratic as the hours pass. Are they just exhausted? Or is something beneath the water pulling them closer to madness? Your mission is deceptively simple: decide what is real. Each scene, each fragment of footage, forces you to question whether you’re witnessing coincidence, paranoia, or something that defies explanation. You cannot intervene — only judge. The truth remains submerged, and your perception is your only instrument. Every decision brings you closer to dawn — and to understanding your role in this silent vigil. But as 8:00 a.m. approaches, you begin to wonder: are you observing the swimmers… or are they, somehow, observing you? ' 8AM: The Swimming Pool ' is a psychological mystery about isolation, perception, and the thin boundary between reason and fear. Through the still water and the sleepless night, it invites you to confront not only what lies beneath the surface, but also the unease of seeing — and being seen.

Name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
Supported languages: Since then, countless moons have passed... As people wove generations together, she quietly continued to fulfill her duty. But at last, the time came, and the silence was broken. Old and weary, she gathered her last strength and spread her wings to find out the hero... About Dungeon Antiqua 2 Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a 2D dungeon hack-and-slash RPG featuring SNES-style pixel art and sound. A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system. § Exploration Players will explore six dungeons , navigating with a unique system where visibility of corridors and enemies depends on the character’s “vision' . Dungeon Antiqua 2 uses a symbol encounter system —you can avoid battles by dodging enemies, or strike first and take the initiative. The path forward is yours to carve through skill and decision-making! § System In addition to the eight jobs from the previous game, two new classes—Monk and Archer— have been added, bringing the total to ten . Earn skill points from victorious battles; once they reach the required threshold, you’ll unlock job-specific skills . Since changing jobs does not reset level , you can freely experiment with multiple jobs to create your own ultimate party! note: Five jobs are available at the start of the game. The remaining five types will become available as you progress through the game. § Concept Sometimes, why not take a step back and return to the cartridge era of gaming ? By stripping away excessive story cutscenes and focusing on short, simple dialogue and text, the world is designed to spark your imagination—inviting you to create your own personal adventure. § Playtime For a first playthrough, we estimate a playtime of approximately 10-12 hours. Dungeon Antiqua This game takes place hundreds of years after the story of Dungeon Antiqua. You may even come across some familiar characters from the previous game… Transferring Save Data from the Demo to the Full Version Save data from the demo can be transferred to the full version. On standard PCs (Windows/Mac), the save data files themselves are shared. Therefore, if you launch the full version after playing the demo, you can continue playing from where you left off in the demo. For certain environments like Steam Deck, after launching the game, select “Inherit Data” > “Backup Save data” from the menu in the upper-right corner. Choose the data from after clearing the trial version to obtain a 6-digit code. Then, in the full version, select “Inherit Data” > “Restore Save data” and enter the obtained 6-digit code to transfer the save data. Playing on Handheld Devices Your download also includes an executable file for certain handheld consoles (see the official website for details). From Settings > Manage > Browse Local Files , locate dungeon-antiqua2.pyxapp and transfer it to your device.

Minor Phase: At the beginning of each turn, players enter the Minor Phase, where a Minor Arcana card is played to generate the cost needed for the Major Phase. Major Phase: In the Major Phase, players use the cost gathered during the Minor Phase to play Major Arcana cards. The goal is to strategically form sets of matching colored cards, as these sets generate points. The player who forms the strongest sets across 10 rounds will outscore their opponent and win the game. In the Major Phase, players have the option to place their Major Arcana cards in one of two fields: the Knock Field or the Support Field. Placing a card in the Knock Field allows players to work toward forming a set of Major Arcana cards. These sets are crucial, as they determine the player’s final score at the end of the 10 turns. Only the Major Arcana placed in the Knock Field will contribute to these scoring sets. Alternatively, players can place Major Arcana cards in the Support Field, where they can activate one of two available effects, called 'contracts.' These contracts offer unique advantages, such as manipulating the game state, disrupting the opponent’s strategy, or providing immediate benefits to the player. However, cards played in the Support Field won’t contribute to the endgame scoring sets, so players must carefully weigh the decision of when to pursue powerful short-term effects versus long-term strategy. Name: AiliA
Supported languages: Have you ever imagined stepping through a mirror to encounter your 'Reflection'? To rescue her twin sister, Lia, who is trapped within the mirrors, a young girl named Ail embarks on a perilous adventure across mirrored dimensions. Her sole ability is to phase through mirror surfaces and traverse the mirrored space—a realm where every reflection is tangible. Here, paths within the mirrors can be trodden upon, mechanics in the mirror can be triggered, and the entire mirrored world is fully interactive. By moving and rotating mirrors, you will manipulate your surroundings and use your imagination to forge new paths, solving intricate puzzles where reality and illusion intertwine as you journey toward the end.                                                                                                                                                                                                         Developed by a team from the NYU Game Center, AiliA is a 3D visual puzzle game with a unique Chinese aesthetic. It has garnered multiple awards and nominations internationally within US, China, and Japan, including the '2023 China Game Innovation Awards - Best Innovative Design.' The game has earned recognition from various institutions both at home and abroad. It is heavily influenced by the independent game design philosophy of New York University and combines a profound passion for the puzzle genre with the creators' personal experiences and reflections on life. Its accolades include: 2020 Intel University Games Showcase Nominee 2020 AT&T Unlocked Games Nominee 2020 NYU Game Center Incubator Selected Project 2022 Draknek New Voices Puzzle Grant Recipient 2023 15th Xiamen International Animation Festival 'Golden Dolphin Award' - Best Game Planning Nominee 2023 China Game Innovation Awards - Best Innovative Design 2023 China Game Innovation Awards - Best Innovative Game Grand Prize Nominee 2025 TGS(Tokyo Game Show) Selected Indie80   Composer Mark Benis brings together top-tier musicians who have performed for renowned titles such as Elden Ring, Street Fighter V, and Final Fantasy XV: Assassin's Festival. Centered on the core concept of 'Reflection,' the soundtrack fuses traditional Chinese instruments like the Erhu, Dizi, and Xiao with the Western violin to create an 'East-meets-West mirrored sonic domain.' The main theme weaves through the score using techniques such as note inversion, melody reversal, and reverse audio. These techniques serve as a musical metaphor for the mirror reflecting the myriad forms of the world and deeply immerse you in the emotional bond between Ail and Lia. Innovative Mirror Mechanics Break the boundaries between reality and illusion. The reflection is no longer a simple projection but a tangible space that you can explore and interact with. Every passage through the mirror provides a brand-new perspective for puzzle-solving. Immersive Aesthetic Exploration Traverse seven distinct scenes inspired by traditional Chinese art. From ink-wash bamboo forests to glazed mirror palaces, you can unlock side quests, secret rooms, and hidden surprises within this Oriental artistic landscape. Hardcore Puzzle Challenges Conquer over 100 meticulously designed puzzles and unlock seemingly impossible challenges within hidden areas. Collect Mirror Fragments to awaken the long-lost memories of the bond between Ail and Lia. Experience diverse types of spatial puzzles centered entirely around mirrors. The game innovatively integrates various reflection-based mechanics including water reflections, mirror recursion, and even mirror-puzzle boss battles. This design creates an exceptionally rich experience in both visuals and gameplay. The story features three interwoven threads. The main thread follows your adventure in the mirror world. The subtle thread consists of real-world memories triggered after breaking each Magic Mirror. A hidden thread follows the twin sister and unlocks by collecting Mirror Fragments in challenging stages. Fragmented storytelling through soul shards scattered across in-game scenes provides gameplay hints while enriching the world with poetic philosophy. Both the theme song and narrative stem from the creators' real-life experiences. They explore how to reconcile with the world and oneself after the loss of a loved one. AiliA is a 3D visual puzzle game featuring Chinese aesthetics. To rescue her twin sister trapped within the mirrors, the young girl Ail embarks on a journey.
