Name: Star Fleet Deluxe
Supported languages: Command the mightiest vessel in the United Galactic Alliance (UGA) fleet - an advanced heavy cruiser designed to be the last line of defense against the ruthless Krellan Empire. As a captain, you'll navigate treacherous quadrants of space, managing critical resources and coordinating strategies to defend your regions, plot tactical jumps through contested territories, and engage in intense ship-to-ship combat against the Krellans and their Zaldron allies. With the aid of your starbases and planetary outposts, defend against the relentless Krellan invasion force to protect your vulnerable colonies. Your strategic decisions will determine the fate of entire sectors in this deep space military simulation from Interstel Technologies.  Quick Description:  Star Fleet Deluxe (SFD) is a strategic space war game. At the helm of a United Galactic Alliance (UGA) Invincible class heavy cruiser, you are tasked with defending the UGA colonies against advancing Krellan forces, and driving them out within a given time. Though the task is formidable, you are not completely alone. The surviving UGA starbases and outposts on unconquered planets will assist you in providing shelter in orbit, resupplying your cruiser, and providing real-time updates on Krellan movement Though the concept of a timed space defense war simulation may seem simple on paper there is much depth to Star Fleet Deluxe . Missions are randomly generated with Krellan battlecruisers, supply ships, and destroyers programmed to support one another in their invasion. Though they can be unpredictable, they maintain the same mission: conquer planets, attack UGA starbases, and ambush your cruiser at every turn.  A bit of background/things to keep in mind: Star Fleet Deluxe (SFD) , developed by Trevor Sorensen and published by Interstel Technologies, has had a lengthy development history that spans several decades. While the game never saw a conventional commercial release, its development nearly reached completion in 2002 with the Beta version. The project's journey began in 1998 when Brett Keeton approached Sorensen about creating an updated Windows version of Star Fleet I - The War Begins! for internet distribution as shareware. Keeton, along with programmer Mike Hartman, initially focused on improving the graphics and sound of SFI. However, after realizing the original gameplay might not meet modern gaming standards, they decided to revisit Dr. Sorensen's archived X Version, leading to the creation of Star Fleet Deluxe (SFD) . This new iteration, while sharing DNA with Star Fleet I through their common Starfleet ancestry, was specifically developed as an enhanced version for the MS Windows.  The game went through three iterations: the X Version from 1981, which was a FORTRAN-based rewrite that never saw public release; an Alpha Version in 1999 that received limited playtesting distribution; and the Star Fleet Deluxe Beta Version from 2002, which was nearly complete but needed final polishing and a few minor bug fixes. There was also a mobile version of Star Fleet Deluxe released, Star Fleet Deluxe for Android, available on the google play store from 2014 to 2021 which was derived from the SFD Beta Version. Unfortunately, the chief programmer, Brett Keeton, passed away in 2002 and his code was lost. What we are releasing here is the Beta version (now designated Version 1.0) which, although it has some known minor bugs, it is fully playable to completion.   To help players unfamiliar to the Star Fleet franchise navigate this complex simulation, the game offers two learning paths: an in-depth officers manual for those who want to understand every detail, or a quick-start guide for those eager to jump into action. Venture forth with the new capabilities within Star Fleet Deluxe under the MS Windows OS, with this call to action, engaging in battle with the Krellans should be much more entertaining and gratifying.   About this game: Star Fleet Deluxe takes place during Galactic War II, where the vengeful Krellan Empire (allied with Zaldron Empire) seeks to destroy the United Galactic Alliance (UGA), led by Earth. The game puts you in command of an Invincible class Heavy Cruiser as humanity's last hope against the Krellan invasion.  As the fourth installment in the acclaimed Star Fleet series, set between Star Fleet I - The War Begins ! and Star Fleet II: Krellan Commander in the Star Fleet series, which also includes the planetary invasion game Star Legions . The Krellans have progressed from using single destroyers to deploying battle fleets including battlecruisers, destroyers, and supply ships. Players must protect colonies and starbases until UGA reinforcements arrive, while facing both Krellan ships and cloaked Zaldron vessels. The game represents the second wave of a three-phase Krellan invasion, bridging the gap between initial scout encounters and the full-scale invasion depicted in later games. As commander, you'll patrol a massive region spanning 100 quadrants in a 10x10 grid sector system, for precise navigation and tactical combat.  UGA Vessel arriving to defend a UGA Starbase from a Krellan Destroyer Your mission is critical: Defend United Galactic Alliance starbases and colonies while eliminating the Krellan threat using an arsenal of advanced weaponry including phasers, homing torpedoes, and acquire support resources from UGA outposts throughout the region. Your starship can interact uniquely with various stellar objects - maintaining a safe but offensive simultaneous presence when docked at starbases, orbiting planets/colonies, or utilizing minefields for defending against Krellan starships.  KEY FEATURES: Real-time movement and combat simulation with stop-action gameplay  Management of 14 critical ship systems Complex logistics management for your ship and the region Strategic starbase support with orbital mine defense and resource replenishment Progressive difficulty across 10 ranks  Award system including medals and commendations  The game features significant improvements over its predecessor, Star Fleet I - The War Begins! , including the addition of both colonized and uninhabited planets, and persistent strategic locations for stars, starbases, and colonies. Your heavy cruiser comes equipped with 25 standard torpedoes and a maximum overload of 35, with5 salvo capacity, a tractor beam, 6 phasers with variable shot input power. Your ship is manned by your crew of 500; consisting of 430 regular personnel and 70 elite space marines for boarding and capturing enemy ships and establishing planetary outposts. NEW FEATURES: UGA planets occupied by Krellans can be liberated for expanded surveillance Dock in UGA Starbases and orbit planets for protection    Improved Shield distribution  Faster-paced combat and gameplay compared to its predecessor, Star Fleet I: The War Begins Challenging enemy reinforcement system that deploys battlecruisers, destroyers, and support ships Completely redesigned command interface with mouse control Automated long-range sensors with real-time reporting from Alliance assets Docked in UGA starbase to defend against 2 Krellan destroyers EXPLORATION: Scout and Map unexplored quadrants of the region Strategic course plotting improved with fixed locations of celestial bodies and starbases  Monitor enemy movements through enhanced long range sensor networks Every time cycle triggers comprehensive Long Range Sensors (LRS) scans from all capable objects, with results transmitted directly to your command console through operational communication channels. Cataclysmic Bite is a story driven dark fantasy RPG that blends horror, mystery, and emotional character storytelling in a cursed world overrun by demon cats. A strange supernatural bite spreads across the land, transforming ordinary villagers into monstrous beings and plunging once peaceful regions into fear and chaos. A small group of survivors must uncover the truth behind the curse before it consumes everything. The game is structured into narrative driven chapters, each introducing new locations, enemies, puzzles, and story developments. Players will explore forests, abbeys, clock towers, and ruined settlements, slowly piecing together the history of the world and the forces responsible for its downfall. The story places a strong focus on character interaction and growth, allowing party members to develop naturally through shared experiences, victories, and losses. Combat is turn based and strategic, designed to emphasize tension and decision making rather than simple grinding. Encounters range from standard battles to large scale boss fights with unique mechanics, dangerous abilities, and cinematic presentation. Some enemies are intentionally overwhelming early on, encouraging players to explore, prepare, and return stronger. Boss encounters are designed to feel imposing and memorable, with distinct patterns that require careful planning to overcome. Exploration is a core part of the experience. Players will solve environmental puzzles, navigate maze areas, avoid threats through stealth focused segments, and uncover optional paths that reward curiosity. Certain sections limit combat entirely, creating moments of vulnerability that heighten suspense and reinforce the horror elements of the world. Hidden lore, optional challenges, and secrets are scattered throughout each area for players willing to take their time. Character progression allows party members to learn new abilities, strengthen their roles in combat, and adapt to increasingly dangerous situations. Growth is tied closely to story progression, ensuring that gameplay and narrative evolve together rather than feeling disconnected. Each character brings a distinct personality and playstyle to the party, contributing to both combat strategy and story dynamics. Cataclysmic Bite features an original soundtrack that blends haunting ambience, emotional themes, and intense battle music to match the tone of each scene. Voice lines are used selectively during combat and key moments to enhance immersion while maintaining a deliberate, atmospheric pacing. Dialogue is intentionally unskippable during delivery, encouraging players to slow down and fully absorb the world and its characters. Designed as a complete, self experience, Cataclysmic Bite offers several hours of handcrafted content with a strong emphasis on atmosphere, storytelling, and meaningful challenge.

Key Features ► Tour of Duty Simulation (12-Month Cycle) Every soldier serves a 12-month tour, with optional extensions up to 3 tours — if morale allows it. Soldiers constantly: – arrive – rotate out – get wounded – recover – die – change roles – or extend their service You must maintain a deployable platoon at all costs. ► Morale System That Truly Matters Every decision affects morale: – medals – rest – casualties – promotions – injuries – deployments Low morale collapses the entire unit. High morale boosts survival — but nobody is bulletproof. ► Injuries and Consequences – Three wounds = automatic discharge – Severe wounds = permanent removal from duty – Every death lowers morale and adds pressure on you ► Promotions & Qualifications Wartime cares nothing for protocol. If a leader is needed, even a fresh replacement may be promoted instantly. The machine must keep turning. ► Paper-Based Presentation The entire game takes place inside the administrative reality of the platoon: – dossiers – reports – assignment boards – personnel files – wounded and casualty logs No combat. No cinematics. Just the quiet horror of paperwork in war. ► A System Built on Chain Reactions Every choice ripples outward: → bad choises → more injuries → morale collapse → an undeployable unit → you are relieved from duty Every campaign is different: – different timings – different casualties – different outcomes Infinite replayability — with a finite number of men. ► You Can Send Them Out — But You Can’t Bring Them Back The game offers: no reload no undo no alternate saves Every choice is final. This Is Not…  Not an action game  Not a shooter  Not a power fantasy This is a responsibility–morale–decision simulator, depicting the most invisible yet most brutal side of war: the administrative burden of keeping a unit alive. The game does not depict: – civilian casualties – graphic violence – real historical tragedies – war crimes Everything occurs within fictionalized military structures. Content Warning Themes include: – war and military loss – stress and moral decline – administrative pressure – failure and monotony No blood or graphic violence. Flashing effects can be disabled. About the Developer 12 Months: Vietnam was created by a solo indie developer with a background in law enforcement. Your Mission – Serve your Tour of Duty – Keep the platoon alive – And try to keep your conscience intact

Supported languages: BIG HOPS is a 3D platformer, action-adventure with deep movement, fresh frog-tongue gameplay, where you can grow veggies to build paths forward! You'll play as Hop, a young frog who's been kidnapped from home by a trickster spirit called Diss. He has a mysterious, important mission and needs your help, but you just want to get back to your family... After a bit of searching, a wiry old Raccoon offers to build you a way home if you can find a few Airship Parts. To build your Airship, you'll need to: Infiltrate the Gulley Gang's Hideout at the edge of a vast Red Desert. Become a Bucko and save DrillCO's Rigs Workers out on the Open Ocean. Sneak past Haven cultists by spelunking under a Shattered Mountain . Each World offers a self contained story. You'll meet a huge cast of characters, learn the conflicts of each world, and hopefully find some way to help. Will that help be altruistic or is it all selfish to get those sweet, sweet Airship Parts? Why did Diss really kidnap you? What's the purpose behind the Dark Drips he keeps asking you to collect? And if you collect them all, will Diss really let you go home? You'll need to play for yourself to answer all these questions, so consider backing to help us finish BIG HOPS strong! Next let's talk about gameplay. Character designs by Steven Sugar (background designer for Steven Universe & Owl House) Movement is king in BIG HOPS and our kit goes deep. You can roll, dive, crouch jump, wall run, free climb, swim, belly slide, walk tightropes, pole swing, grind rails, ride minecarts and more. Everyone knows a great platformer starts with a great player controller and Hops' stacks up against the best-of-the-best. You'll feel inspiration from Mario , Sonic Adventure , Zelda: Breath of the Wild, Hat in Time, and more. And that's all just Hop's basic moveset- from there we've added a ton of froggy flavor and ways to build your own paths forward. The core-mechanic in BIG HOPS is Hop's versatile frog tongue! It's cute, goofy, and adds a surprising amount of freshness to this action-puzzle-platformer Your tongue is how you interact . Use your tongue to pull items to your hands, hookshot up walls, and tongue-swing your way to ridiculous speeds. Doors, switches, corks, plungers, flowers, flingers, levers, and lick-picking are all quick work thanks to Hop's tongue. You'll keep finding novel, goofy tongue interactions even 10+ hours into your playthrough. Deep movement and tongue-gameplay give BIG HOPS legs and a fresh flavor, but the real magic is using powerful Veggies to build your own paths through levels You'll find new types of Veggies as you explore and each has a unique effect when you throw it down in the world . Let's look at some examples: Mushrooms become bounce pads to help clear hard jumps. Acorns can grow vines around walls and ceilings to help you climb farther. Balloons make temporary platforms and can stack to get serious height. Oil Balls create hookshot points you can bounce off without losing speed. Apples let you place your own tongue swinging points anywhere. Cacti launch tightropes you can use to cross big gaps. Since you can only hold one item at a time, Hop has a handy Backpack! As you play, you'll discover new Veggies and unlock more Backpack Slots to store them. You can open the Backpack any time, and using it in a stressful moment will slow down time so you can plan your next moves. Collectibles are a genre staple and there are lots in BIG HOPS! We've worked hard to give them all gameplay uses, so you never feel like you're just checking off boxes Earn Dark Drips to help with Diss' mysterious mission and unlock secrets. Collect Dark Bits to earn gameplay modifying Trinkets for your backpack. Buy Veggies + upgrade your Backpack , Wallet , and more at Drilson's Depot . Buy Outfits , Hats , & Dyes to customize Hop's look at Odette's Outfitters . Find and Identify real Bugs to fill your collection in Bugsy's Conservatory. Uncover Blueprints to build totally normal and not-at-all busted Gadgets . Find Mixtapes to play on in-game on your Boombox or Hop-man . Equipping Trinkets means decorating your Backpack! That's a weird bug... Something we're proud of is how many different areas there are in BIG HOPS. As you explore the 4 main Worlds (Forest, Desert, Ocean, and Mountain), expect a lot of surprising offshoots like the Boneyard, Bucko Cove, Hydro Plant, and Gulley Gang HQ. All these different places to explore really make it feel like you're on a grand adventure! Hi, Chris here! I started BIG HOPS in 2019 (6 years ago!!!) with a single goal of modernizing the 3D platformer genre. The design trend at the time of giving players real freedom and creativity in games like Zelda: Breath of the Wild , Spelunky , and Rimworld was so inspiring. Selfishly and jealously, I wanted to see emergent gameplay in my favorite genre. Since then, BIG HOPS has become a maximalist game and taken on many more ideas and inspirations. Its mechanics, story, vibes, and humor draw on so many games and TV shows stretching back 40 years. Mario (64, Odyssey, Sunshine, and Galaxy) and Zelda (BOTW, Wind Waker, and Ocarina of Time) have both been huge influences. We also spend a lot of time talking about Sonic Adventure , Spelunky , Kingdom Hearts , Psychonauts , Avatar: The Last Airbender , Spongebob , and Steven Universe .  I founded Luckshot Games in 2015 to make innovative, high quality games filled to the brim with character and charm. We funded our first game Sausage Sports Club on Kickstarter way back then and released it on Switch and Steam in 2018. We've aimed higher with BIG HOPS and the team is bigger than just Luckshot Games, so I want to give everyone a quick shout:

Name: Draconis 8
Supported languages: Unique Decks • Tactical Duels • Compact Strategy What is Draconis 8? With iron, heart, scales, deadly breath weapons, and unmatched intelligence, dragons reign supreme. But when disputes arise between these mighty rulers, they are not settled by armies… but by the  Draconis 8 . Each dragon gathers a warband — themselves and  seven legendary champions  — to battle another dragon’s team. These duels decide the fate of empires, played through a fast-paced, deeply strategic card game. 8-Card Decks Every duel begins with a lean but powerful force:  one mighty Dragon ,  seven Champions , and a  neutral Terrain card  that sets the stage. This compact design means there's no wasted space — every card has weight, and every decision matters. Your Dragon is your ace, boasting multiple abilities and devastating stats, but the Champions you surround it with will determine how battles unfold. Your deck might pair a fearsome Red Dragon with orc warriors, elven archers, and a sly goblin trickster — each one contributing a unique way to score or disrupt. Simultaneous Play Unlike most card games where players alternate turns, some parts of Draconis 8  is played in real-time mind games . Both players draw, then secretly choose a card to play. When revealed, the card with higher initiative earns a point and resolves first. This keeps the pace brisk and tense: you're always thinking ahead, bluffing, and trying to predict your rival's next move. Will your opponent commit their Dragon early for raw power, or hold it back for a decisive late strike? Do you counter with a solid Champion… or risk everything on a bold play? Tactical Positioning Cards don't just hit the table —  where you place them is just as important as what you play . Each card you add connects to the growing battlefield, scoring when adjacent to foes. Initiative determines first placement, but positioning unlocks deep tactical layers: block off scoring lines, rotate enemies, or create chains of allies that amplify one another's abilities. Your Champion of Fear rotates an enemy Paladin just enough that their strong side no longer scores points — swinging the round in your favor. Unique Abilities Every card carries a special ability that warps the rules in your favor or sabotages your foe. Dragons often wield multiple powers, but even humble Champions can deliver game-changing effects. Some bend the battlefield (rotating, swapping, shielding), others manipulate scoring (stealing, multiplying, or redirecting points). Combined, they create endless tactical puzzles — and no two decks play the same. A stealthy Rogue Champion lets you sneak victory beads from one card to another, while your Dragon unleashes a devastating ability that clears a row of enemies. Victory in 7 Rounds The battle is short, sharp, and conclusive: after  seven rounds of simultaneous duels , the player with the most victory points claims the match. No endless grind, no drawn-out stalemates — just pure, focused strategy packed into 15–30 minutes. You're tied in points after round six. In the final round, your Dragon enters the field and tips the balance, claiming the decisive victory. Glory is yours. Why Draconis 8 Over Other Games? Board Game & TCG in One Play right out of the box, or customize decks like a trading card game. Physical & Digital Integration Scan your terrain card to unlock your exact deck in the  Draconis 8 app . Instant Digital Play Battle the AI, join global matchmaking, and compete in tournaments. Endless Replayability Every card is algorithmically generated with  millions of possible combinations . They are also mathematically balanced, with no rare cards to chase. Every Pack is Tournament Legal No wasted pulls — all cards are balanced.

Name: 我的文字修仙世界
Supported languages: Game Introduction This is the first commercial game co-created by the author (planner) and another partner (programmer). It includes in-app purchases, but no items that affect game balance are sold. Our original intention is to create a cultivation game that supports idle gameplay, free trading, unrestricted learning and matching of techniques, and free attribute point allocation. Due to limited resources, the game has not undergone professional testing and may contain bugs and other shortcomings. We hope for your understanding. For players who provide optimization suggestions or report bugs, we will offer generous resource rewards. We look forward to working together to make this game even better. Friendly Reminder: This is a multiplayer online text-based game, not a single-player game! The game focuses on idle cultivation while you work. During your free time, you can challenge bosses, and obtain various resources such as equipment and magic artifacts through trials, exploring secret realms, and other methods. It also supports free chat (all pornographic, vulgar, and similar remarks are prohibited; violators will be muted or banned). Players can list and sell their loot freely. Official Group: 764923005 We welcome you to leave valuable opinions. We will add interesting gameplay and fix discovered bugs in a timely manner. We hope to improve this game together with you! Gameplay & Features Joining a Sect There are four major sects in the game. Each sect gives a unique sect heart method as a starting gift (effects listed below). In other aspects such as skill cultivation and equipment development, there is no difference between the four sects. The sect only provides a clear initial cultivation direction for players. Wenjian Mountain: Enhances critical strike rate and critical damage. Chixiao Gate: Boosts fire and thunder elemental attributes and resistance. Liuyun Pavilion: Improves water and earth elemental attributes and resistance. Lingbao Hall: Enhances magic artifact attribute effects. Sect Main Hall Donate resources to the Law Enforcement Elder to upgrade the sect level and earn personal contributions. You can also promote your status in the sect, starting from a handyman disciple and gradually advancing to a core disciple. Complete sect tasks at the Assessment Elder to gain personal contributions. Participate in sect competitions, choosing events like Outer Sect Tournament, Inner Sect Tournament, or Elite Tournament based on your status. Defeat other players to achieve better rankings and win rewards. Sect Treasure Workshop Use personal contributions to exchange for various entry-level mental methods, techniques, medicinal materials, pills, and more. Use premium currency (Xianyu) to purchase functional items, fashion costumes, and other accessories. Sect Alchemy Room Refine needed pills here, which can be used to increase attributes, cultivate cultivation base, and break through realm bottlenecks. Alchemy requires reaching the corresponding alchemy level, unlocking specific pill recipes, and having essential alchemy materials. Sect Cave Mansion This is the core area for players to practice in idle mode. Upgrade the cave mansion level to gain faster cultivation speed (subject to corresponding sect position requirements). For players with limited time, the game offers a 10x Secret Realm function for rapid cultivation. Activating it consumes Sect Secret Realm Tokens, which can be collected for free daily based on your sect position. Sect Trial Area Unlocked when your cultivation reaches a specified realm. Explore by flipping grids to discover resources such as spirit stones, equipment fragments, magic artifact fragments, celestial materials, and medicinal herbs. Encounter monsters during exploration and choose to defeat them for equipment and items. Friendly Reminder: Each trial area has 6 floors; you must clear all monsters on the current floor to enter the next. Sect Spiritual Plantation Each sect disciple initially has 10 spiritual fields (the number unlocks gradually with your sect status). Each field can be upgraded; higher-level fields allow planting higher-grade spiritual herbs. Equipment Gameplay Equipment is divided into 10 stages, with one stage corresponding to each major cultivation realm. Each stage has 16 pieces of equipment, including 6 weapons and 12 pieces of armor. Each item has four quality levels: Low Grade, Medium Grade, High Grade, and Profound Grade. Equipment includes main attributes and sub-stat affixes. Main attributes can be enhanced, and sub-stat affixes can be refined. Players can choose equipment and affixes entirely based on their cultivation direction. For example: Players focusing on earth-element techniques are better off choosing shield weapons, as earth-element damage is calculated based on their own defense. Higher defense deals more damage to enemies, and affixes can be refined to increase health, physical defense, or magical defense. Players learning sword-based techniques can choose swords, broadswords, spears, etc. All choices depend on the player’s cultivation path—there are no in-game restrictions. Magic Artifact Gameplay Magic artifacts follow a similar setup to equipment, with 10 stages and 4 quality levels, supporting enhancement and refinement. The difference is that magic artifacts can only be unlocked at specific cultivation realms and are limited by cultivation base and true essence when used. They are divided into Attack Artifacts and Defense Artifacts: Attack Artifacts consume true essence to actively attack enemies at regular intervals. Defense Artifacts provide players with shield protection. When your Attack Artifact is powerful enough, it can defeat enemies for you without manual combat. Similarly, a strong Defense Artifact may make enemies unable to break your shield. Technique Gameplay The game offers dozens of mental methods and techniques, divided into 5 levels—higher levels provide better effects. Players can learn any technique or mental method without restrictions, allowing full customization. Note: Mental methods are passive and take effect immediately after learning. Techniques need to be equipped to be used in combat; each player can equip up to 6 techniques. Techniques are categorized by attribute: Sword (Physical Damage) Fire (Magical Damage) Thunder (Control) Earth (Defense) Water (Healing & Support) Coordinate with teammates in team mode for strategic battles. All techniques are obtained through in-game systems, while rare techniques drop randomly from world bosses. Market Gameplay All players can buy or sell materials and items in the Auction House, supporting unrestricted free trading and player farming. If you’re lucky enough to obtain rare items (e.g., Profound Grade equipment/artifacts, Heavenly/Godly Grade techniques) from boss fights or secret realm bosses, you can sell them to other players in the Auction House for a large amount of Spirit Crystals—an in-game currency that can be freely traded. Special Note: To protect player interests and maintain a healthy trading environment, any player using studio accounts for large-scale profit will be permanently banned. Other Gameplay Additional features include chat, duel, popularity, charm, titles, fashion, leaderboards, and spirit wheel systems. We won’t detail them all here—welcome to explore freely in the game!

Beans is a humble farmer striving to fulfill the dream his parents couldn’t achieve in their lifetime. He has discovered an incredibly cheap method of producing canned corn, and his goal is to bring it to those who need it most. But just when everything starts going well, one night, while he sleeps, a strange ship lands in his fields. When he wakes up, he realizes someone is destroying his crops and ruining his dream. Without a second thought, Beans heads to the site and discovers the culprits: strange and powerful reptilian beings. While investigating his bean field, he makes a crucial discovery: these creatures are vulnerable to them! Wasting no time, John rushes back home for his hat, because now he’ll need your help to grab his revolver and some explosives. Together, you’ll face the reptilians and uncover the hidden truth behind this invasion. Beyond the beach lies Nothmere , a remote town nestled deep within an inescapable ring of jagged mountains. No one leaves. No one ever has. Every soul who arrives does so the same way you did — broken, memoryless, and stranded between life and death. Despite this, the town endures. Nothmere is protected by powerful magical wards embedded into its stone walls, holding back the void creatures that stalk the surrounding wilderness. These defenses are maintained by the town’s Mage guild, the Arcane Codex , while order and survival are enforced by the Warrior guild, the Crimson Shield . Thieves lurk in the shadows, secrets whisper through alleyways, and every citizen carries gaps in their past they cannot explain. As you explore the town and its outskirts, you’ll uncover fragments of truth — about Nothmere’s origins, the nature of the wards, the monsters beyond the walls, and the terrible cost that keeps the town standing. What begins as a search for escape becomes something far more unsettling: the realization that Nothmere exists for a reason — and you may be part of it. Your choices will determine how the story ends. Will you preserve the fragile balance that keeps the town safe? Will you uncover a way to break the cycle? Or will you doom Nothmere — and everyone within it — forever? In Nothmere, memory is a weapon, sacrifice is inevitable, and some truths are buried for a reason . Name: Profaner of Death
Supported languages: 💀 Game Overview Profaner of Death is a deck-building roguelike × turn-based RPG that puts absolute focus on battle tempo and the thrill of growth . To rescue her sister, kidnapped by a necromancer who commands the dead, a silver-haired knight descends into the depths of sewers reeking of blood and decay. Use your cards wisely, defeat your enemies, and strengthen your deck after every battle as you push deeper underground. Which card you play, and which enemy you strike first— that single decision can mean life or death. ⚔️ Features 🔥 Card Battles Designed for Maximum Tempo In many deck-building roguelikes, managing HP as a permanent resource often turns minor fights into tedious exercises in avoiding damage. Profaner of Death rethinks this structure. Your HP fully recovers after every battle . In exchange, enemies are relentless. Every fight is tuned to be a desperate, edge-of-your-seat struggle . Additionally: Shield cards are mostly single-use You cannot rely on defense indefinitely As the run progresses, guarding becomes harder, but your deck cycles faster , enabling aggressive, fast-paced combat that never drags on. This is not about endurance— it’s about constantly asking: “How do I finish this fight this turn ?” 📈 Clear, Tangible Growth Through Combat Each time you defeat an enemy, your attack power increases at random . As battles stack up, your damage skyrockets, providing growth you can clearly feel through the numbers . Despite being a roguelike, the game delivers the catharsis of an RPG-style power curve . Across multiple runs, how far you can push your final damage output becomes a goal in itself. ※ A challenge run with no attack power upgrades is also possible. ☠️ Deep Build Choices from a Single Character You control only one character. While she is fundamentally a power-based knight , she also has access to poison-based tactics . Poison ignores enemy armor, making it strong and stable early on, but it does not benefit from attack growth , forcing hard decisions for the late game. Commit fully to poison? Push physical damage to its limits? Choosing how to conquer the depths creates a system that is simple, yet deeply strategic. 🌑 Dark Fantasy World Rendered in a semi-realistic anime style, the underground world is both quiet and grotesque. Surrounded by blood, rot, death, and curses, the knight stands alone— her sword the only thing she can rely on. ⏱️ Designed for Replayability 30–90 minutes per run Different cards and rewards every time High difficulty × High replay value Learn from defeat. Sharpen your builds and decisions. 🕯️ Story A knight descends into a sewer tainted by death and filth, seeking the sister taken from her. At the end of the rotting path awaits a necromancer who defiles souls themselves. She fights— to reclaim her life, her pride, and the one she loves. 🎥 Streaming & Content Creation Profaner of Death welcomes gameplay videos, livestreams, and review content from both individuals and organizations. Monetization on YouTube / Twitch: Allowed Content violating public morals or intended for harassment: Not allowed We sincerely welcome anyone who helps share this game with others.

Take up stargazing, astrophotography and discover cosmic wonders; all with a warm beverage at hand. Your study may be small, but through your telescope, a whole new cosmos is now within reach. Explore space at your own pace from the comfort of your snug study room. ✨ Map out magical constellations in star-mapping puzzles 📸 Use your star chart to find and photograph a variety of charming planets ☄️ Keep tabs on the latest cosmic news - who knows what cosmic wonders you'll find? 📒 Print your photos and fill up your stargazer’s scrapbook with all your discoveries 🌌 Experience a quiet but personal  heartfelt narrative that unfolds as you play Astronook is probably the game for you if you: Have any interest in stargazing, space or astronomy 🔭 Enjoy the vibes and aesthetics of stargazing, stars and space 🌙 Want a relaxing experience to unwind from a long day ☕

Name: Key Your Debt
Supported languages: This game uses the number keypad to play (or equivalent keys if no number keypad is available). Tap the number keys to spawn dollars and earn cash. Tap the enter key to open and close the shop at any point. while in the shop, use the number keys to view upgrades, then the plus key to purchase upgrades. Tap the period key to pause the game and view settings, stats, and a Beans button. Familiarize yourself with the number keypad and the upgrades to succeed in paying your debt. The recommended controller How to play This is Boh use the number keypad (not required, but preferred) a micro game experience speed running/typing upgrades Beans Button (display an image of 'Can Of Beans', the cat) somewhat inspired by someone who loved pimento cheese sandwiches no mouse controls

Name: Cage City
Supported languages: 《Cage City》 is a top-down shooter game set in a post-apocalyptic world teeming with zombies and monsters. Combining exploration, survival, and intense combat. You will play as an amnesiac soldier navigating perilous environments, exploring unknown areas, gathering resources, searching for clues, and engaging in life-and-death battles with various creatures. Open-World Exploration Dive into a sprawling open-world city, scavenging for supplies to survive while contending with threats from zombies and monsters lurking throughout. Each step of your exploration presents new challenges and unknown dangers, keeping every moment unpredictable and thrilling. Diverse Weaponry Choose from a wide range of weapons, including classic guns like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and grenade launchers, as well as advanced weapons like flamethrowers and electromagnetic guns. Customize your weapons to match your fighting style and handle different threats effectively. Skills and Progression System Improve your abilities through a skill tree by finding mysterious items and trading currency with statues. Defeat tough enemies to unlock powerful permanent passive skills. As you explore more of the city, your combat skills will grow, making the gameplay more enjoyable. Trading and Resource Management Trade collected junk for money or buy essential supplies from vending machines. Manage your resources wisely to handle the changing survival challenges of Cage City and stay alive in this dangerous environment. Dungeon Adventures Enter dangerous dungeons filled with hordes of zombies and monsters. Conquer these tough areas to obtain vital resources and discover mysterious items guarded by extremely dangerous creatures. Each dungeon offers unique challenges and rewards, testing your skills to the limit. Engaging Storyline Uncover the truth behind the disaster as you explore the city. Face terrifying entities and solve the mystery of Cage City, revealing the secrets that led to the world's downfall and your forgotten past.
Average playtime forever: Violence and Gore.

Name: Clean My Feet
Supported languages: Step Into a World of Soothing Satisfaction in Clean My Feet After a long, demanding day, ladies' feet can get a little dirty. From sandy toes after a beach stroll, to mud-caked arches from gardening, or sweaty soles after an intense workout – that's where you come in. Clean My Feet puts you in the role of a meticulous foot specialist, transforming tired and dirty feet into sparkling perfection. Featuring fully 3D characters and environments, you can dive in close as you rotate around their feet to clean them from every angle. But be careful - their feet are both sensitive and ticklish! Get their feet clean enough and you’ll unlock more ladies, locations, and tools. Caravan of Characters Featuring 12 different ladies with dirty feet, you're going to have your work cut out for you. Tools of the Trade You have a selection of different cleaning tools to work with, each with its own unique twist. Softer brushes are safer and less likely to hurt or tickle the ladies, but they take longer to clean. Heavier brushes will get the job done more quickly, but go slow, or you’ll wind up hurting their delicate soles. Serene Settings The ladies of Clean My Feet spend their days working out, tending to their greenhouse, or sunbathing at the beach, and after a long day their feet can get quite dirty. That’s where you come in. Mix and match the ladies and locations in any way you’d like, but be careful not to hurt or tickle their feet! Clean My Feet is coming soon - Wishlist it today!
Average playtime forever: Most characters wear revealing attire (i.e. bathing suits). There is also a bathtub sequence, though no nudity is shown.

Name: Duet Night Abyss
Supported languages: In the long and repetitive dream, Quicksand constantly pours down. The compass of destiny starts to tick. The two wake up and embark on their separate journeys. On this shore, you emerged from a perilous situation but were exiled to the harsh North Border, struggling to survive. On the other shore, you found yourself in a maelstrom of power, striving to escape from a cage woven with conspiracies. No need to bid farewell. As time perpetually flows forward, As the two shores will eventually meet, You will meet each other one day. Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom developed by Hero Games' Pan Studio. The game features 'Multiple Weapon Loadouts x 3D Combat' at its core, and tells the story of 'Demons' from dual perspectives. [Craft your own lineup] Freely farm character fragments and forging materials to unlock your favorite characters and weapons at your own pace. No forced progression, no rigid templates—just the joy of free cultivation and strategic experimentation. Focus on strengthening your core squad or exploring endless tactical possibilities. [Destinies intertwine — Meet demons of a hundred faces in the DNA] You will step into a land where magic and machinery coexist, playing as two protagonists with vastly different backgrounds. Encounter a variety of demonic beings with their own perspectives as you engage in constant battles and exploration to uncover the truth behind a thorny fate, ultimately bringing an end to the spiral of suffering. [Swap between melee & ranged weapons — Freely create multi‑dimensional weapon combos] In battles, you can freely switch between melee and ranged weapons, allowing characters to break free from the limitations of a single weapon class. Choose from a variety of cool melee weapons such as whipblades, crossbows, and even heavy firepower like sniper rifles, grenade launchers, and high-tech hover guns to create your unique weapon loadouts. [Exhilarating hack‑and‑slash battles — Master agile moves and mow down hordes] Engage in fast-paced combat against waves of relentless enemies with the freedom to utilize both close and long-range attacks, as well as aerial assaults and ground takedowns. Bask in unexpected and thrilling battle experiences through diverse combat gameplay including tracking, reconnaissance, and rescue missions. [Customize your look with dyes — Mix & match—colour weapons & outfits freely] Dye and switch at will—take full control of your weapon and character aesthetics. Swap color schemes on the fly to match your combat style with your personal flair. Combine a wealth of accessories—from elegant headpieces to lively waist ornaments—whether for refined beauty or playful fun, the choice is yours.
Genres: Multi-player,Co-op,Online Co-op,Full controller support,In-App Purchases,Keyboard Only Option,Playable without Timed Input,Save Anytime

Name: Observa
Supported languages: Observa is a quiet space-photography game set on a small floating island suspended in endless darkness. You’re alone out here, with nothing but your telescope, a printer, and a silent sky full of things that shouldn’t always be there. Point your telescope into the void. Search for planets, stars, drifting nebulae, and stranger objects that don’t have names yet. Capture what you find. Print your photos. Build up a gallery of discoveries that feel beautiful at first… and then start to feel like they’re watching back. This world doesn’t tell you much. There’s no comforting voice guiding you, no busy city nearby, no hint of where “home” even is. Just quiet machinery, distant starlight, and the uneasy feeling that something out there knows exactly where you are. Somewhere in the darkness, something is moving. Something is coming. And you’re the only one who can see it getting closer. Sell your photos, slowly improve your observatory, and expand what you can reach with your telescope. Not for power, not for glory, but because you need to understand what’s out there… and whether you have time left to escape. Build your own gallery, fill it with proof of the universe around you, and decide whether your photos are comforting, or evidence of something you were never meant to witness. Features Capture astrophotography shots of stars, planets, nebulae, and unsettling cosmic phenomena Explore a procedurally generated sky that feels vast, uncaring, and sometimes hostile Build and curate your own gallery of discoveries Sell prints to fund further exploration of the unknown Atmospheric, lonely gameplay focused on discovery, unease, and the beauty of space
Genres: Single-player,Custom Volume Controls,Adjustable Difficulty,Save Anytime,Family Sharing

Name: Dime Nebula
Supported languages: Space, the not-so-final frontier. A great place to get away from everything and everyone. That is, until a sadistic, maniacal artificial intelligence, named Daglos, chances upon you and abducts you for it's pleasure. Forced into the arenas filled with danger, you have to fight your way through a hundred levels to escape.  In this mouse-driven 2D game , you will control your ship, moving it around an arena that mimics the non-gravity feel of space as you fight and outwit several types of enemies and obstacles. Free-floating asteroids and gun-turrets are just two examples of what you will face. Shoot lasers at them or outmaneuver them. Sometimes, though, you'll have to figure out puzzles that Daglos places before you. All is not always what they seem.  You'll need to complete a hundred levels before you can escape from Daglos. A fun, arcade-style game that balances retro action with not-too-challenging puzzles. How will you fare? You'll need your wits about you as each time a new enemy is introduced, Daglos gives only a minimal description of it and you'll have to figure out how to deal with it using your own ingenuity! Will you make it through all hundred levels and escape Daglos? Or will you give up and cry in the emptiness of space?

Name: The NOexistenceN of Morphean Paradox : The Forest of Silver Shallots
Supported languages: This is the unfinished story between you and her—this is the journey that belongs to YOU… Awakening within the Forest of Silver Shallots, you set forth on a path to uncover the secrets of the “Morphean Paradox.” Across the land, the schemes of great factions ripple across the surface, while beneath, dark mist stirs in hidden currents. Forge bonds or sow hatred, and bear witness to the fate of you, your companions, and the Silver Shallot Forest itself. Guild Adventures Every adventurer needs trusted companions. You will take the role of a guild leader, guiding your allies and planning journeys into the Forest of Silver Shallots, where together you will write your own chapter of dreams. Schedule Management Adventurer, what shall we do today? Will you train alongside your companions, venture into the depths of the labyrinth, or accept a clandestine request from the black-market merchant? Decision-Driven Narrative Every choice you make may have the power to reshape the fate of this world. But tell me—do you truly have the strength to bear the weight of your decisions? Personalized Growth & Management Each character possesses six core attributes, along with a unique skill set and branching paths. You can influence every character’s progression and equipment, ultimately leading a squad of elite adventurers shaped by your own personal style. Strategy & Combat Bolins, goblins, assassin vines… the Forest of Silver Shallots is filled with peril. Choose your skills, build your party, and lead them into battle against dozens of different foes. A mysterious beauty from the Forest of Silver Shallots, Lilith is a swordswoman with a touch of magical skill. She claims her goal is to slay the Demon Lord and bask in the people’s applause—though her most pressing concern at the moment is snatching up discounted bread. “My name is Lilith, a Magic Swordswoman—good folks like you are rare in Golden Chalice Town.” Though she casually says “what a coincidence,” it almost feels as if she has been waiting for you in this vast forest all along… Yet phrased that way, it might sound a little self-absorbed—maybe it really was just a coincidence. Before blowing out the candles on her fifteenth birthday, Kallen was without doubt the happiest girl in the world—blessed with loving parents, a vast bedroom in her castle, and a kingdom full of loyal subjects. But on that fateful day, she made a single wish: to leave the castle. Following a butterfly into the forest, she returned only to find her kingdom shrouded in black mist, transformed into a living hell. There was no time to grieve—an inferno soon devoured everything she had once called home. From that day onward, Kallen’s smile vanished. In its place remained a sharpened scythe… and a heart consumed by vengeance. “Pray for your own safety—I won’t save you twice.” Turning away, she disappeared into the darkness—her only purpose now to hunt down the mysterious figure she glimpsed within the flames that day, even if it means severing her own emotions. For Fouco, life as the Demon Lord was nothing but endless drudgery—24 hours of routine: meetings on “advancing the modernization of the Demon Army under the New Era,” evaluations of destructive operations, and bureaucratic oversight of her underlings. She grew weary of it all. Abandoning her throne, she thought she could finally live a carefree life as a wanderer. Yet her successor, Rahabe, plunged the land into a reign of darkness—forcing Fouco into deep regret for her choice. Now, to atone for her mistakes and to end this unending war, she must fight as the former Demon Lord… against the Demon Lord herself. “I see… one step after another, a thousand miles in the making… Hero, you’ve truly thought this through.” Naturally, Fouco found her destined Hero—for she had already glimpsed countless futures where this Hero defeats Rahabe. Raised since childhood under the admiration of others as the so-called Bridge of Truth, Sartre’s life seemed destined to be smooth sailing. Yet such precocious brilliance soon drew suspicion and envy from her superiors—the old scholars at the institute dismissed her work as little more than castles in the air. Their endless jeers and criticisms weighed heavily on her, dragging down the pace of her research. Unwilling to waste her life in petty quarrels with mediocrity, Sartre severed her ties and abandoned her post at the Ninth Research Institute. What she needed was vast, uninterrupted time—time to calculate, to simulate, until she could complete the ultimate Genesis Grand Magic. “You’ve caught my attention. From now on, you’ll be my research subject!” …And yet, some new curiosity always seems to steal her gaze. The road to her great magic remains ever long. 'Defeat the Demon Lord and become a hero' was Green's dream since childhood. At the age of 8, when he first witnessed General Satyr's brave figure at the imperial palace's military parade, Green quietly set the goal to join the Silver Griffin. As the youngest agent in the Griffin Intelligence and Countermeasure Department, Green Roland became a highly anticipated rising star. However, during a mission, an 'accident' left him severely wounded, and when he regained consciousness, he received notice that he had been dismissed from the military. No one knows exactly what happened that day. Green Roland still roams the streets as usual, but today he has a new identity and a new goal. 'I am Green, a hunter living in this forest.' Since that day, Green has decided to walk down this thorny path. This Is Your Story with the Forest of Silver Shallots The Forest of Silver Shallots—a world that whispers with magic. Creatures reveal their bizarre and wondrous forms, while conspiracies weave their webs in the shadows. Here, you will encounter love, embark on journeys, and face choices left hanging in the balance. And of course, this is also OUR story— a tale that belongs to us alone… (*Please note that the game is currently in development and localized content is subject to change.)

Name: Blightstone
Supported languages: Save the Crystal. Save the World. Here in the world of the Blightstone you’ll find deep strategy, blended seamlessly with roguelike progression. Your mission? To protect the Earthglass Crystal, and deliver it to the Infernal Rift. Only by doing this will you be able to destroy the demon overlord Korghul, and shatter the Blightstone itself. Die, die, and die again. Cunning and keen wit (though looking at our options even a solitary spark of wit will have to suffice) are key to saving this realm. Use the environment to your advantage with objects, enemies and even the weather itself providing strategic opportunities and challenges. Each failure provides invaluable opportunity to learn and collect new skills to help your next adventure. Hold the Line — Use Every Skill, Trap, and Tactic to Protect the Crystal A Dynamic Battlefield Enjoy free movement, without grid-based systems, allowing you to move into strategic cover. Just remember, enemies aren’t restricted by grids either, and there’s always an angle. The Environment Is Yours to Command:  Hide in long grass or burn it to stop enemies using it for cover. Gather enemies in water to amplify electric attacks. Use every advantage you can get to shatter the Blightstone. Harness the Weather to Your Advantage:  Dynamic weather will have an impact on Adventurer’s strategies. Dense fog obscures the battlefield, rain will amplify electric attacks and strong winds will affect accuracy. It can bring as many benefits as it does drawbacks, as long as you pay attention. Recruit your heroes Find new heroes and companions to help you along your journey. Chose from Brawler, Hunter, Arcanist, Druid and Priest classes, each with their own unique abilities and companions.  Master a vast skillset:  Unlock a wide range of active and passive combat skills for our troop of adventurers and for the Earthglass crystal itself. Mater melee, ranged, area of effect and grappling skills, and combine them for heavy-hitting combos. Status effects that sting:  Bleeding, poison, binding, stun or burn, dozens of combat conditions can swing the course of each battle. Just remember it won’t always swing your way! Strategy that doesn’t stop when the sun goes down. Adventurers must stay sharp from dawn to dusk, as your party sets up camp each night. Scavenge resources within battles to ensure you have enough to heal and avoid the Blight after the sun falls. Procedural generation means that each journey is different from the last. As the journey progresses, you will also unravel the story behind the infernal rift, the Earthglass, the Blightstone, and the enemies that you face along the way.

Name: Smashing My Phone: Broken-Screen Diaries
Supported languages: 👉 Play the free demo — a short and funny phone-sim adventure in 9 languages! Make calls, chat with friends, and order food through the cracks of a broken screen. Oh no! Dropped your phone again? 💥 Nice job. 👍 But how far can you go? Before you finally give up. 📱 Smashing My Phone™ is a story-driven campus comedy where using everyday apps becomes a small disaster you have to outsmart. Friendship, team projects, and romance—handled through apps that don’t care about your broken screen. So you improvise, retry, and make it work, because freshman year wasn’t chaotic enough. • Use everyday apps, even with half the screen dead. • Tap around dead zones. Unlock PIN screens. Solve phone-style puzzles. By the end, become a true Modern Survivalist . This isn’t just a game. This is our life. ☁️ Smashing My Phone™ is a phone-sim puzzle adventure about surviving another day with a shattered screen. Use a smartphone filled with everyday apps and find clever ways to complete your daily tasks despite the cracks. 📱 Phone-sim puzzles: Operate familiar apps like calls, chats, food delivery, and banking to handle the small yet chaotic routines of everyday life. 💥 Cracked-screen challenges: Some parts of the screen don’t respond—find your own ways to work around the damage. 😅 Light humor: Enjoy small jokes and relatable moments across messages, notifications, and daily apps. 📖 Story bits: Follow a college freshman clinging to his cracked phone, surviving modern life one swipe at a time.

Name: Grime&Gold
Supported languages: Grime and Gold  is a small game where you play as a street alchemist, crafting potions by stacking and mixing cards . Your goal is to discover new recipes, manage scarce resources, and race against time to serve demanding clients. The game blends strategy and time management in a gritty, tense atmosphere, where every decision could lead to success or disaster. Grime&Gold is an intense stacking game focused on management and survival. a 1-2 hour experience. featuring 96 unique cards with 9 different boosters type and 25 recipes to discover.  What Grime&Gold is NOT Not a deckbuilder. Not a roguelike. Discover many cards and recipes   Want some ingredients for your potions ? Manage your ressources and go to dungeons to find rare ones. If you manage well, you'll complete quests and get rewarded ! If you don't, be prepared. By progressing toward the holy grail, you'll discover more recipes, and more places to learn from... or to die from. Make potions and serve clients A good alchemist should always thrive in discovering new weird brews. Use your ingredients in the right way with your trusty cauldron to make potions and whatever the clients need, because in here, the client is king, and a bloody one... You can also hire gobelins to work for you and keep yourself safe from those clients. Find new recipes Open your grimoire and find how to make everything that the clients need, and maybe find new potions to make ! You can also check some hints and scribbles that Calis put there just in case... and collect all the cards !
Average playtime forever: Depicts stylized card-based violence, mild alcohol and syringe references, and optional blood and insect imagery tied to a psychological horror theme.

Name: SEX THERAPY
Supported languages: The main character is Lisa, a successful sex therapist whose life is full of other people's stories about sex, but who herself has been living alone for years, without a single touch. Her office is a quiet island of revelations, where patients share their most intimate secrets. But one evening, Nick walks through the door—a young man who has come for help with his loss of confidence after a breakup. His words about his fear of intimacy echo in her own emptiness. At first, it's therapy: conversations, trust exercises, visualizations. But their gazes linger longer than they should, the air grows heavy with unspoken words, and their professional distance melts away with each session. What began as help turns into a game where Lisa, for the first time in a long time, allows herself to feel not like an expert, but like a woman — desirous, vulnerable, ready to break all the rules. Now they have to decide: stop while they can still maintain control, or give free rein to what has flared up in this room, where the walls have heard thousands of stories of passion, but never their own. In this session, it is no longer possible to lie to themselves. Game features: • A deep erotic story unfolding in the cozy office of a sexologist. • Tense dynamics between professionalism and forbidden desire. • An atmosphere of intimacy, trust, and the gradual breaking down of barriers. • Colorful characters with internal conflicts, loneliness, and awakening passion. • Cinematic presentation that creates a sense of closeness, tension, and complete immersion in each scene.

Name: Death's Web
Supported languages: A brutal rogue-lite platformer where curses define your destiny. Each curse adds a unique challenge, forcing you to adapt or die. Risk everything for power in a world that punishes and rewards you. Features: Collector of Souls : You posess the ability to steal enemies souls after they die. you can secure the souls through soul spheres and use them after death to permanently increase your stats and upgrade spells. Embrace powerful curses that twist your journey. Some will blind you, summon spikes from below, or rain down freezing hail, but survive them , and you can exchange them for game-changing blessings . Curses are double-edged. Risk devastating effects for greater rewards.   Blessings can heal , shield , or grant new abilities that dramatically shift your playstyle. Dynamic Combat: Traverse diverse biomes teeming with unique, formidable enemies. They may seem insurmountable at first, but with every death, you gain the experience needed to overcome them. Cities: Discover cities where you can delve into the lore of the world, learn about spells, and enhance your weapons and stats through temporary upgrades available in local stores. You can also dive deep into the story of the blessed lands and learn about it's people and history. Interact with mysterious NPCs, some may offer help, others need yours. Your choices matter but who you help is entirely up to you...

Name: Strategos
Supported languages: Simulate Historical Battles Simulate large scale warfare with the armies of antiquity in Strategos . With thousands of men on screen, you can recreate real or speculative historical battles between the major and minor powers of the ancient Mediterranean. Manage Complex Mechanics Strategos is an ancients wargame with large scale formation movements and disorder, unordered charges, pursuing, evading, routing and morale shocks, fog of war, terrain effects, flanking and command and control simulations that bring a hardcore tabletop feel to digital, real-time wargaming. Command the Armies of Classical Antiquity The armies of Strategos span nearly a thousand years of the classical period, from the Hoplites and Immortals of the Persian Wars, to the rise of the Sasanian Empire against Imperial Rome. Master Advanced Command and Control An advanced command and control simulation encourages the player to think about the positioning and use of their generals, and when to commit them in order to balance giving orders, sending couriers, providing morale support, and fighting in direct combat. Select From a Huge Number of Units and Factions The game contains over 250 unique units and nearly 120 unique factions, including the various Hellenic Empires, The Achaemenid Persian Empire, Rome and Carthage across different eras, Gallic, Germanic and Iberian tribes, Umbrians, Samnites and other native Italians, the major city states of ancient Greece, the Thracians, and more. Customize Battles Custom battle options include selection of army lists, allies, units, army sizes, era, map, deployment distance and sides, difficulty, AI type/aggression, whether to use AI at all (alternative is hotseat), and optional randomization of army lists with options to filter random armies by era, importance, and whether they are steppe armies. Historical Campaigns and Reenactments Current historical battles include Issos, Trebia, Ilipa, Magnesia, Zama, Adamclisi, Bibracte, Carrhae, and Raphia, with more to come. The text-based campaigns currently include the battles of Alexander, Hannibal, the Wars of the Diadochi, and the battles of Early Rome and the Peloponnesian War, with more to come as well. Name: Attrax
Supported languages: Welcome to the Attrax technological institute Opposites attract, and likes repel. Dive into the mysterious Attrax institute, solving intricate logic puzzles based on the principles of attraction and repulsion, with each puzzle bringing you closer to the origins of the institute. In this captivating single-player experience, enjoy hours of gameplay that will challenge your mind and redefine your understanding of physics and logic. Attraction and Repulsion Each puzzle room will test your knowledge of attraction and repulsion. Manipulate charged field generators, charged particles, charged cubes, and other activators in different testing environments in order to solve these puzzles. The Charge Gun Take the power of attraction and repulsion into your hands. Name: Elengard: Ascension
Supported languages: This is a Real-Time-with-Pause RPG, in the style of Dragon Age Origins and Neverwinter Nights, but more focused on combat and with some elements of action RPGs. It is neither a “Hack and Slash” nor a Soulslike. Combat has two modes: Automatic: you order the attack and the character attacks on its own, just like in the classic CRPGs mentioned above. Manual: you need to click for each attack and press a button to defend, which is similar to an action RPG, albeit with significant differences. Basic features: Combat: Real-Time-with-Pause Dialogues: multiple choice dialogues Quests: main quests and side quests Character customization: appearance customization (including gender) and equipment. Possibility to equip various items, which appear visually (only clothing/armor and weapons, jewelry does not appear, for now) Trade: buying and selling items Item crafting Item enchanting Main features: Ability/Skill Tree : massive ability tree, with no level restrictions and no class restrictions, allowing for the creation of various builds and combos, and unique play styles. Ability configuration : configure several features of abilities (especially spells), such as power, range, radius, and more. Ability actions : some abilities have actions that can be performed while using the ability, for example, when creating an Electric Orb, it is possible to use the Shock action or the Cast action. Choose how you fight : strategically choose which combat actions, modes and stances to use depending on the situation. Would you prefer to defend yourself by blocking, spending little stamina but running the risk of being staggered by the impact of the blow? Or would you rather spend more stamina dodging? Are you going to use area attacks against a group of enemies, at the cost of reducing the chance of a hit, or are you going to kill them one by one? Will you use swing attacks, causing more impact, or would you rather use straight (thrust) attacks, taking a greater risk of missing, but causing greater potential damage? Will you wield the weapon with one hand or two? Will you attack faster or stronger? Will you be more aggressive or more defensive? In short, there are many possible strategic choices. Ascend in power : become stronger and stronger, to the point of becoming an epic character, comparable to a demi-god. There is no character level limit, although the XP is finite in the Early Access version. Explore : explore a beautiful semi-open world, highlighting the contrast of light and darkness, with an appearance inspired by The Lord of the Rings and Dragon Age: Origins. Archetypes System : archetypes are like classes in other RPGs, but you don't choose an archetype in order to choose abilities. Instead, you are free to choose any ability, but some abilities are associated with archetypes. Acquiring archetype abilities can increase the archetype level, which can provide some bonuses. Archetypes inspired in D&D classes : the archetypes are inspired by the classical D&D classes, but built in a different way. To date, the game features the following archetypes: Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Priest, and Druid. Visual elements responsive to mechanics : animations are strongly interconnected with combat mechanics (i.e., if you dodge an attack, the animation shows a dodge, if you block, the animation shows a block). Visual effects will also be coherent to the spell behavior (e.g., effect increases with spell power). Single player x Multiplayer : the development is aiming on singleplayer, with a strong intention to extend it to multiplayer in the future. Initial historical context: You start out living a peaceful life in a simple village, in a beautiful place in harmony with nature. But something feels wrong. You are only a shadow of yourself in this place. You feel that there is something out there in the world that will make you find your true self and fulfill your purpose. Soon, you discover that you are the bearer of a curse, capable of killing you and the people around you. They say it's a punishment from the gods for sinners. But you are not a sinner. Is it really a curse? As you set out on a quest to find a cure, you discover a darkness that grows in the land and corrupts everything it touches. You feel drawn to it, almost as if it were your responsibility to fix it. But why? And how can you fix the world without fixing yourself? Dark forces arise and pursue you. All this leads you on an epic adventure full of challenges and mysteries, fighting for survival and in search of power and answers about yourself and the world.

Almost all of the levels and spaces in The Empty Halls are based around the online community wikis for the Backrooms. I used these different wikis for reference images and descriptions of what each level looks like and what it contains. In The Empty Halls, you are given a custom-built VHS camera, specially designed and supplied by the mysterious higher-ups at the Backrooms Exploration Company. Your task is to step through the threshold and explore the unknown. The higher-ups want you to record and document various anomalies and levels. The specifics of what they’re looking for are given to you as missions, delivered through a custom VCR setup. This VCR setup allows you to play back your recordings and will tell you if you’ve completed the assigned mission. If you have, a new mission will be assigned. There is lots to explore and I am really excited to share my creation with all of you!

Supported languages: Synopsis Year 2045. Everything is moving too fast and you feel like you can’t catch up with the world. You play as a young adult disillusioned with society, and who has lost all motivation to keep going… until an unexpected meeting makes them reconsider the course of their life. Stay tuned to meet the full cast in future episodes. But this only proved that such a dream wasn’t doable on a large scale. The project was called off and the city was divided into three sectors: the Center, a technological utopia for the elites; the Traditional Districts, meant to be a copy of other parts of the world; and the Periphery, the city’s economic engine where everything is up for sale. So in the end, Verona stopped being an experiment to save humanity and turned into an extreme reflection of its contradictions. Your adventure will start here!   Features Male or female lead: Choose your own protagonist and get ready to meet various girls who you’ll be able to date. Name: Loopweavers: Dimensional Alliances
Supported languages: Loopweavers: Dimensional Alliances “Loopweavers: Dimensional Alliances” is a competitive multiplayer strategy game where two players—known as Quantum Weavers—clash in tactical skirmishes across the Astralis System. Each turn, they collapse probability waves to manifest entangled creatures from the 5th Dimension onto the battlefield. A Quantum Weaver , also called an Entangler , masters extreme quantum entanglement—a technology that grants access to the 5th Dimension , an energetic plane where the essences of all conscious beings ever existed are stored. This game features 🪐 A deep lore spanning the Astralis System and its cosmic mysteries. ⚔️ Competitive multiplayer battles between Quantum Weavers. 🎮 Local training mode to refine strategies and deck builds. 👥 Direct play with friends via private matches. 🃏 A full deckbuilder with 1,000+ cards in Episode 1. 🧠 25+ unique Heroes , each with their own traits and playstyles. 🔮 1,000+ abilities and triggered effects to explore. 🌀 40+ Status conditions to master and manipulate. 🔧 Resource and Scrap systems that power your tactics. 🌍 Vital gas storage systems that change depending on the planet. 💎 All cards are earned through gameplay — no purchases or random packs for real money. 🃏 True TCG randomness : shuffled decks, random starting hands, and coin toss to decide who plays first — just like real card duels. Build your deck Forge decks that transcend the limits of reality. Start with guided decks and learn the arts of dimensional weaving—or craft your own strategy. If you're reading this, you're already a Quantum Weaver. As you learned in your early studies, in the 5th Dimension , every soul exists in a state of quantum superposition—preserved as pure informational energy within the currents of Dark Energy . Each essence retains all genetic memory and experience from every material incarnation it has lived. Episode 1: Children of the Same Star We were never meant to be friends, yet today the silence of the stars gave birth to fear. And fear begot distrust… and then war. We are no longer explorers — now, we are warriors. We no longer live under the shelter and warmth of our star — no, not anymore. Life is harsher out here, but we have helped… and betrayed each other. When all seems lost, another humanoid’s hand rises to pull us to safety. It has been this way for over 10,000 years, and it will remain so for all eternity, no matter how different we are. Some of us are older and wiser, others are younger and bolder — running so fast they are already by our side. As for those in between, no one can tell if they are ahead or behind. Episode 1 unveils the Astralis System and the civilizations that inhabit it, exploring their millennia-long conflicts and fragile alliances. It focuses on worldbuilding—its technology, metaphysics, customs, and planetary environments. Every world, from asteroids to stations, is essential for understanding Astralis. Each Episode will add at least 1,000 new cards and will be released approximately every two years , weaving together new mechanics, story, and strategy. The complete card set of Episode 1 is included in the base release, forming the foundation of Astralis. Between Episodes, we’ll continue adding new cards, Heroes, modes, and additional content to keep the game evolving steadily without overwhelming players. Training at the Dimensional Academy The New Atlantis University maintains advanced simulators so its Quantum Weavers don’t get crushed in their first real skirmish. Have you uncovered the Entanglement Trace of a powerful creature? Or discovered a new combo with your Protocols ? Test your tactics here before facing players across Astralis.

Name: Watch Grass Grow Simulator
Supported languages: Watch Grass Grow Simulator is a game about watching grass grow. That’s the whole thing. You load into a quiet space with a clear view and a patch of grass in front of you. No rush. Over the course of about eight real-world weeks , it changes, slowly enough that you’ll often wonder if it changed at all. You start checking it more than you meant to. Just to be sure. There’s nothing to manage and nothing you can do wrong. You just sit with it. Watch it. Notice how certain blades start to stand a little taller. How the patch looks fuller than it did before, even if you can’t quite say when that happened. Once you notice it, it’s hard to stop noticing. It’s calm and quiet and honestly a little difficult to explain to someone who hasn’t spent time with it. The game doesn’t demand attention, but it rewards patience in a very specific way. The longer you stay, the more certain you become that yes, it is different now. If you see it through to the end, the result is unmistakable. You’ll remember what it looked like at the beginning. You’ll know how long you waited. I don’t think there was another way this could have worked.

Name: Somnolence
Supported languages: You were part of the Somnolence Research Project — a clinical program exploring the boundaries of dream-based therapy and cognitive mapping. During the procedure, an unauthorized surgical intervention was performed without your consent. You awoke inside the system — a simulated dream environment where no one was ever meant to regain consciousness. From that moment, reality and simulation began to blur. The walls shift, the clocks hesitate, and voices you don’t remember begin to call your name. Through distorted frequencies, someone — or something — tries to reach you. A doctor’s voice speaks from beyond the static, piecing together what remains of the experiment. Their words blur between guidance and warning. Hidden voices guide and deceive. In the silence between loops, something observes — an intelligence born within the system itself, shaped by countless dreaming minds. It wants connection . Or control . Explore liminal rooms, flickering memories, and corridors that stretch between consciousness and code. Somnolence is not about survival — it’s about understanding why you keep waking up. Explore surreal and liminal environments that reshape with every awakening. Navigate dreamlike spaces, interact with objects, and uncover hidden recordings. Experience a fully voice-narrated story through environmental storytelling. Uncover fragments of memory, scientific logs, and dream-induced hallucinations. Atmospheric sound design and AI-assisted visuals crafted for immersion. A self-contained narrative experience — no combat, no puzzles, only consciousness.

Lead Concept Artist: Seth Redd. Written by Aaron Redd. Audio Director: 2 Mello.  Featuring music by 2 Mello, crisp, DV-I, Skybridge. -=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- Director's Note/About SantaCorps Way back in 2017 (I think?) I wondered why there were so many Christmas movies to watch during the holiday season, but so few games to play to get you into the Christmas spirit. I fondly remembered my 2 brothers and I huddling around a single keyboard together and playing the SRB2 (it's a fan game) time-limited Christmas mode every year, and decided to jam out the very first SantaCorps game in about 3 days. Ever since then, I've tried to make it a tradition to set time aside each year to make a joyful game for free/cheap, both for us to practice new skills and techniques, and to simply have fun with the process of making something purely out of our love for video games.  Later in 2021, Seth and I set out to make the game that sits in front of you now, but due to the scope we had in mind and us just having too much on our plates at the time, we couldn't swing it back then. It's bugged me ever since, and mentioning SantaCorps 4 to tick me off became something of an in-joke within the team. Fast forward to now: we spun back, started over from scratch with our newfound experience and tooling, and set out to make the biggest, baddest, most off-the-wall SantaCorps yet. It turned out even better than I hoped when I first designed it, and I'm super grateful to my brothers and my team for not only humoring me, but giving it their all. I hope this game brightens your day, and reminds you of the magic in your own heart. Enjoy :)

Everything that exists in the world — items, NPCs, locations, enemies — is generated by the AI in real time , but persistent : If you meet an NPC, discover a dungeon, or find an item, you can encounter it again later because it is generated and stored .
