Every campaign becomes your unique universe. ⚔️ Tactical + Narrative Hybrid Combat A fluid narrative system combined with a tick-based turn structure where initiative, gear, and timing truly matter. 🎨 Integrated Multimedia Generation The AI doesn’t just narrate: Creates character and NPC portraits Selects ambient music Chooses sound effects Select visuals based on context Nothing is pre-written or pre-scripted. The experience adapts dynamically to your story. 🌐 Player-Chosen Language The AI automatically translates both interface and story into the language you select. A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER Hi, I’m ABAFE . I’m not a big corporation. I don’t have hundreds of employees. I’m a self-taught programmer and a long-time RPG lover who spent countless hours (and many sleepless nights), assisted by AI tools, to bring this project to life. RoleMIAster is a showcase of what is possible today: a bridge between the nostalgia of classic tabletop role-playing and the future of generative artificial intelligence. This project is in Early Access : it may have bugs, but it also has enormous potential and is constantly evolving. By purchasing this game, you’re not only getting a tool for infinite adventures… you’re directly supporting an independent creator on this journey. Are you ready to roll for initiative?...

Supported languages: How many times have you used resurrection in an RPG? A party member falls in combat. You open the menu and use a spell, an item, or an ability. Name: Highguard
Supported languages: An All-New PvP Raid Shooter Highguard is a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent. Team up, secure your base, then ride out across vast uncharted lands to loot, harvest resources, and upgrade your arsenal as you face off against a rival Warden crew looking to claim your territory as their own. Battle for possession of the legendary Shieldbreaker in the open field; fight to carry it to the enemy base to bring down their shields—then raid to destroy their base before they can destroy yours. Assemble Your Crew Pick from an ever-growing roster of Wardens, and form up in teams of three. Wardens wield guns and raid tools, in combination with rare magical abilities leftover from a dwindling age of magic, now returned. Every Warden ability is designed to add depth to the game’s unique loop and mechanics, like raid combat and destruction; siege stealth and infiltration; base repair and defense; harvesting and loot gathering; open-world combat, and much, much more. Secure Your Stronghold Choose from an array of unique strongholds to call in as your base of operations in large, open maps. Each base has different layouts, advantages, and vulnerabilities. Pick the base best-suited for your team composition, play style, and map type. Once you’ve called in a base, take some time to reinforce walls and customize your loadout before heading out into the field. Mount Up, Ride Out Mount up with your team and ride across the vast mythical landscapes of Highguard in search of loot, resources, and gear to strengthen your arsenal. You can find upgraded guns, armor, and other equipment, like better saddles and magical amulets imbued with perks. Be on the lookout, as the enemy team will be doing the same. Fight them off to secure the best loot for your team. Battle For the Shieldbreaker Strange magical storms periodically ravage the continent of Highguard. Everytime one appears, an ancient magical sword, called the Shieldbreaker, forms at its heart. This sword is the crucial key for breaking through the outer shields of the enemy base so that you can raid. When one of these storms forms in the sky, ride with your team to its location and battle the enemy team for possession of the Shieldbreaker forming beneath it. Intercept in the Open Field Once you have the Shieldbreaker, battle across the open field, on mount or on foot, as you attempt to carry the sword to the enemy base. But stay vigilant—if the enemy team eliminates you while carrying the Shieldbreaker, they can pick it up and ride to raid your base instead. Summon a Siege Tower Once you’ve successfully reached the enemy base with the Shieldbreaker, plunge the blade into the base’s outer superstructure to weaken its shields, then summon in a Siege Tower to finish the job. When those shields go down, it’s time to raid. The Raid With the base shields gone, you’ll need to push in to destroy the base by planting bombs on the base’s generators. But in order to get inside a well-fortified base, you’ll need to use every weapon, raid tool, and arcane ability at your disposal to shoot, sneak, or smash your way inside. Once inside, plant bombs and hold the objective while defenders try to flush you out. Chip away at a base’s strength by taking out multiple generators, or go straight for their anchor stone to destroy the base in one fell swoop. And if you’re defending, protect your generators and repel attackers until the energy of the Siege Tower is depleted and your outer shields repair. Fight For Control If multiple generators or the anchor stone is destroyed, the enemy base is destroyed and the attackers secure the territory. But most of the time, victory doesn’t come with a single raid. When that happens, the enemy base shields repair, the siege tower dissipates, and the fight escalates as loot, gear, and weapons all upgrade in the field, and a new Shieldbreaker forms in a different location in the world. From there the fight for control continues—until only one base is left standing. An Ever-Evolving Fantasy Universe Each new Episode will bring an array of new core content every month, including new maps, bases, modes, wardens, weapons, mounts, raid tools, loot items, and many more surprises we can’t wait to share. And all of this core content is completely free for all players.

Name: Adaptory
Supported languages: After crash-landing on a deserted planetoid deep in uncharted space, your job is to keep your crew of four distinct explorers alive long enough to figure a way back home. Adaptory combines deep physics-based simulation with base building and discovery. As your team digs below the surface, relationships develop, challenges appear, and rebuilding the ship might eventually take a backseat to unraveling the mysteries of this seemingly dead rock. Each crew member is a distinct individual, generated procedurally at the start of each game. Your goal is to keep them alive: breathing, fed, warm, healthy, and happy. Each explorer has their own set of skills, traits, and opinions they will not hesitate to share with other crew members. Their conversations and diaries are an integral part of the story and the gameplay, helping you figure out how to best utilize their skills in a challenging environment. The crashed ship provides shelter and will keep your crew alive for a time. But to survive, you'll have to build a proper base and form a resilient community capable of facing any dangers. Your crew needs somewhere to sleep, eat, wash, heal, and hang out to keep morale up. Manage temperature, connections, plumbing - and that’s just the beginning. Complexity grows over time. Eventually, you’ll have to automate the base, because while it grows, and so does your list of tasks, your crew size does not. Adaptory runs on sophisticated physics and chemistry systems, simulating gravity, temperature, density, viscosity, and even phase transitions with nearly fifty different materials to learn about and experiment with. Leverage them for your benefit. Need power? Set up a solar panel array to capture sunlight. Or power generators by boiling water with molten rock to generate steam or funnel natural gases to a turbine. But remember: each game is a completely new, procedurally generated experience with unique challenges. Every game comes with unexpected twists and turns. Random meteor showers, solar flares, earthquakes can damage your base - but also provide unexpected opportunities in the form of rare materials or uncovering new veins and artifacts, if your explorers survive them. Even if your base weathers it without a problem, it might push one of your crew members to the breaking point or sever a relationship. How will you adapt and survive? Will you? Adaptory is a self-contained story set in a much larger universe. You will be able to take a peek at it through the crew's diary entries, artefacts you might find deep within the planetoid, system logs, and even random conversations. From the history of your crew's home planet and their deep-space mission to the mystery of what actually happened, piece together a gripping science-fiction tale crafted by award-winning writer Cassandra Tse. Adaptory is an ambitious game combining base-building, realistic simulations, emergent gameplay, character development, and randomly-generated events, and is being actively developed with regular updates as we approach version 1.0. We will be introducing new systems and mechanics based on your feedback, so please join the Adaptory Discord to get access to early builds and join the community!

Name: Every Step Counts
Supported languages: Hi! I’m a solo developer, and I built Every Step Counts because I wanted to prove that 'educational' games don’t have to be boring. My goal was simple: create a place where you can relax, solve some math problems, and accidentally get sharper at math and logic while you're at it. The game is currently a collection of three distinct mini-games. I’m launching in Early Access because I want to add more modes later, but the core experience is ready for you to play right now. Here is what you can expect: Ouroboros: Every Step Counts The first game is Ouroboros , a calm but tricky puzzle starring a snake with terrible eyesight. You are the designated navigator. Armed with a calculator, your job is to guide your snake friend’s every step to eat the apple, grow longer, and eventually capture the whole grid. You’ll need to add, subtract, multiply, and divide to reach the target. The riskier the operation, the higher your score reward. It’s not about doing complex calculus; it’s about looking ahead and planning the perfect path. It starts easy, but you might find yourself staring at the screen for a good minute trying to figure out the only way to win. Brainy Cashier: Every Change Counts If you want something faster, I made a mode that puts you behind a cash register. The premise is simple: all the store's calculators are broken, so you the mathematician have been drafted to save the sales day. The line moves fast, and you need to calculate totals and hand out exact change before the customers get annoyed. If you take too long, they get angry and your score tanks. It’s a rush, and it really tests how well you can handle mental math under pressure. Code the Math: From Formula to Function This is for the thinkers. Instead of just answering questions, you build the solution. You are given inputs and a goal, and you have to code the logic to create a function that solves the equation. Often, a single line of code is all you need to solve the problem, if you can find the right one. There are currently over 20+ levels included, each designed to test your ability to translate pure mathematics into working code. One Score for Everything I connected them all with a system called Knowledge Points (KP) . Whether you are solving a slow logic puzzle or rushing through the cashier mode, everything you do earns you KP. This score is tracked on a global leaderboard, so you can see how you stack up against other players. It’s just a fun way to track your progress as you get better. I’m working on this game alone, so your feedback really matters. If you have ideas for new math mini-games or features, let me know in the community forums or Discord Server! Thanks for checking out my game.

Name: LOOP THE LOOP The Mansion of Gluttony
Supported languages: A closed-circle mystery you solve in your head. Twelve people wake up in an impossible mansion—and the only way out is the truth. Overview The Mansion of Gluttony is a closed-circle mystery kinetic visual novel. Twelve people wake up inside a Western-style mansion with no visible entrance or exit—and when murders begin, they must uncover who is killing them and what the “Mansion” truly is. You experience the story through the protagonist Remi’s conversations and inner monologue, piecing together the truth as events unfold. Format: Linear / no choices (read to a single ending) Demo: Free demo available (Prologue + Chapter 1, ~1–2 hours) Story Endless, dull days. “I wish I could escape from this world.” Remi, a second-year high school student, carries a quiet wish like that. One day, he opens his eyes—and finds himself in another world. A strange, dreamlike Mansion where “you can have anything you want.” Welcomed by eleven others who were brought there the same way, Remi spends his days in carefree happiness. “Maybe I really can live here as a new version of myself.” It feels like those peaceful days will last forever. But one day, that illusion ends abruptly— Gameplay / System This is a text-focused mystery / suspense visual novel. Estimated reading time: ~8–12 hours (depends on reading speed) No choices / no branching routes: you simply read to the end Save / Load: available almost anytime; auto-saves at each chapter transition Extras: after clearing the game, Sound Test and CG List unlock No voice acting: designed for players who enjoy text and music You don’t solve puzzles— you solve the mystery in your head , by following the characters’ words and actions and connecting the dots yourself. English-only feature: an in-game Culture Note explains Japanese terms (honorifics, food, customs, etc.) so the setting stays clear without breaking the flow. Even without choices, the fun is in watching what people say and do—and connecting the dots yourself. No voice acting: this is for players who enjoy taking their time with text and music. Characters Twelve people with very different personalities are gathered together in the Mansion. Remi – A book-loving second-year high school boy and the protagonist of the story. Quiet, observant, and easily swept along by others. Saeki – CEO of a well-known start-up company. The first person to arrive at the Mansion. Carin – A freelance web designer. Bright, considerate, and the natural mood-maker of the group. Takuto – A self-proclaimed ordinary office worker. Always joking around and goofing off, but sharp when it counts. Kaede – The daughter of a traditional tea ceremony family. Calm and composed, trying her best to act like the mature voice of reason. Yuki – A 19-year-old woman with a mild, laid-back personality. Enjoys crochet and baking sweets. Kai – A young man who works at his family’s greengrocer. A reliable big-brother type who looks after everyone. Luca – A first-year high school boy. Serious and intelligent; he quickly becomes the person Remi can talk to most easily. Aki – A gifted artist who mostly shuts himself in his room, drawing. Speaks very little and remains shrouded in mystery. Erika – A third-year middle school girl. Cheerful, competitive, and bursting with energy. Jay – A guitarist. Acts tough and foul-mouthed, but is more kind-hearted than he lets on. Aya – A first-year university student. Quiet and distant at first glance, she keeps others at arm’s length while hiding her true interests. Supported Languages Japanese English You can switch languages from the title screen at any time. Whether you want to enjoy the original Japanese text or read the story in English, you can play the same content in either language. Content Warning This game contains the following kinds of content: Depictions of character death, murder, and blood Scenes implying torture or abuse References to suicide/self-harm and suicidal ideation References to drug use and addiction Horror elements and scenes with strong psychological tension The demo is relatively mild, but the intensity of violent content increases in the later part of the full game and in episode 0, which unlocks after completion. There is no sexual content, but some violence and injury descriptions may be disturbing for some players. Support & Bug Reports If you encounter any issues or notice typos in the English text, please let us know via the Steam Community Discussions for this game. We actively monitor reports and will address them as quickly as possible. Background & Recognition In Japan, LOOP THE LOOP - The Mansion of Gluttony was originally released as a mobile visual novel and became a long-running hit, with the series surpassing 200,000 downloads. The feature phone version won “App of the Year special award” on the Japanese mobile app portal AppliGet, and the story was later adapted into a two-volume novel and a three-volume manga published by Futabasha. This Steam release is the first official English-supported version of the game, with the English script adapted under the direct supervision of the original writer to preserve the characters’ voices and tone.

Name: Whisper of the Swallows
Supported languages: The gods have abandoned this world, leaving it to the mercy of relentless storms and the unearthly shrieks of the Black Wailers that hunt in the dark. In this vast, procedurally generated wilderness, every night is a test of survival, and every dawn is a victory earned. Playable solo or with up to 6 players in online co-op, Whisper of the Swallows is a brutal survival experience where your goal is not just to endure the chaos, but to tame it. Survive a World That Wants You Dead The environment itself is your greatest enemy. The biting cold will sap your strength, and raging blizzards can appear without warning, turning a simple expedition into a desperate fight for shelter. You must learn to read the world, respect its power, and use your creativity to find refuge where there is none. When the wind howls, a single flame becomes a promise of survival. Harness the Wilderness Every tree, rock, and creature is a resource waiting to be claimed. Hunt wildlife for sustenance, gather materials from the ancient forests, and delve into forgotten caves for rare minerals. Through a deep crafting system, you will turn the raw gifts of this savage land into the tools, weapons, and armor you need to push deeper into the unknown and face the nightmares that await. Build Your Sanctuary Master a detailed, piece-by-piece building system to construct your refuge from the chaos. Whether it's a tiny, desperate shelter to survive a blizzard, or a sprawling, multi-story lodge for your entire party, your creativity is your greatest defense. Huddle around the campfire with friends, listen as the storm rages against the walls you built together, and find a moment of peace in a world that offers none. Master an Unforgiving World Success is earned, not given. Hone your prowess through skill-based combat where a well-timed dodge is the difference between life and death. Your ultimate purpose is to banish the darkness that seals each region. Explore the world, uncover its secrets, and perform the final ritual to permanently transform the land. Your actions are not temporary - you will leave a lasting mark on the world, turning a hellscape into a place of hope. Your Journey Awaits Influence a harsh, procedurally generated world , ensuring no two journeys are ever the same. Endure extreme, dynamic weather events that demand careful planning and respect. Unite with up to 8 players in a co-op experience where teamwork is a lifeline. Build intricate shelters and structures with a detailed piece-by-piece system. Progress your skills organically based on your actions and playstyle. Discover a deep crafting system to create and upgrade the gear you need to survive. Engage in skill-based combat where timing and strategy are your greatest weapons. The darkness is listening. Will you answer?

Connect, and connect again— This frantic spread will not be halted. Until the world is dismantled, reconstructed, and utterly swallowed by you. All living things are nutrients; YOU are the only predator. Cards are not tools, But the fragments and extensions of your will; Paths are not choices, but corridors the world is compelled to surrender. At the cost of every irrevocable bond, Emerging from the dim-lit woods, traversing swamp and snow, Usurping even upon the realms of mankind. Once the darkness is fully seized, you shall no longer require understanding. Cross paths with 'humans' burdened by their own secrets. As their superior, command their fates. Name: Nova Antarctica
Supported languages: Welcome to the harshest and most majestic place on Earth: Antarctica. STORY This story takes place in the distant future: AD 2900. Earth has been ravaged by a number of disasters. Lethal viruses, food shortages, extreme weather, and unending wars have all but completely decimated the population. Survivors find themselves without homes, and this once lush planet has been transformed into a desolate star. Amidst this chaos, a mysterious signal is suddenly sent out to all countries on Earth. Its source? The South Pole. It indicates the possible existence of abundant resources. A ray of hope in dark times. And so, the protagonist—a young child, comes to be the bearer of humanity's last hope. This child heads to Antarctica, an environment that has seen the most extreme levels of pollution. Your goal is to find the truth: just who was it that sent out the signal, and why? And what fate awaits the future of humanity? GAME SYSTEM The threats that obstruct your path. With an ancient map as your guide, traverse each area and make your way to your final destination: the South Pole. Hold your own against the harsh and unpredictable Antarctic environment. Manage your stamina, and use your wits and ingenuity to survive. - Blizzards The merciless, violent blizzards that sweep across the land will threaten your life with the hazardous materials they pick up. Use obstacles such as walls to help you endure the terrifying winds. - Sub-Zero Temperatures At times, temperatures in Antarctica can fall as far as below -30°C. Long-lasting cold will rapidly decrease your stamina, so be cautious. - Radiation Hazards Past wars have left Antarctica polluted by radiation. Take care that your hazmat suit doesn't start malfunctioning... - Viral Infection The pollution of Antarctica is made worse by the deadly viruses that lurk within. Activate Disinfection Devices and clean up polluted areas as you journey forward. Craft and Build System The key to surviving the dangers of Antarctica are the remnants of advanced technologies from before this era of ruin: 'Craft' and 'Build' Collect resources such as stone and wood, or even scrap parts of Lost Technology. Use these to make important items for your journey. 1. Collect Materials Craft various items out of the resources you find while exploring. Your survival will be determined by your management of materials and stamina. Keep an eye on your stamina as you secure resources. 2. Craft (and Restore Lost Technology) When you discover an item that looks useful, scan it using a high-spec 3D printer and register it to your Craft List. It may be possible to create large-scale devices by combining crafted items. 3. Build (on the Spot) Crafted items can be built on the spot, depending on the circumstances. You are in the most extreme environment known to man, so be strategic as you explore. This will ensure your survival. Make sure to craft items beforehand, so that they are ready to be built during an emergency.

Name: Ropeat
Supported languages: Play locally or via remote play with 2 to 10 players and battle it out in this twin-stick shooter. Collect the most coins to win. The twist: In a fixed loop, copies of you appear that replicate exactly what you did. Plan to let them provide suppressive fire and be careful not to shoot your past- or future-self in the back. Curious? Try our Demo with up to 2 players and up to 2 bot-players! All actions you take are repeated exactly by your copies. These copies spawn at the same time for all players in loops of a fixed duration. This means you eventually have an army of your past selves that repeat everything you did. This makes things tricky: If you forget what you did, your copies can end up shooting you in the back. However, you can also use them to your advantage! Lay down suppressive fire and then engage your opponent. Your copy will support you by repeating the same spray at where you predicted your opponent to be. All collectibles respawn at the same time as you. Collect a coin and your copy will collect the same coin. Shoot a copy of another player and every copy of you will shoot every copy of them in the same way. That is, unless they come back to prevent their supply of copies being lost. Your copies also serve as your respawn points. When you are destroyed, you change to your oldest copy that is still alive. You then rewrite what your copies do from that point onward. If all your copies are destroyed you have to respawn at your base, so take care to protect them. One way to do this is by using the shield powerup. Gain the upper hand by using rockets and shields to improve your map control. Your followers do the same - unless someone steals the powerup first and alters the past. We offer two game modes: one balanced for casual fun and the other for deeper strategic thinking.  In the casual gamemode, you can quickly start a match with new players and dive into the chaos. Coins are collected instantly and your stats are balances for couch-versus chaos. In the strategic mode, coins need to be carried back to your base. You can pass coins to future or past selves. Outwit your opponents and establish an automated chain of copies to collect the most coins. You can play with 2 to 10 players locally. The map scales dynamically to match the number of players. Play against one friend with your keyboard or host a game night with up to 10 people on a big screen. No need for a ton of controllers: the game supports two players per controller/keyboard . Supports Steam Remote-Play, so buy one copy and play with your friends online. Players can even join and leave during a match, making this a perfect game to start when some friends are running late. We are a four person hobbyist team consisting of a creative musician and three developers with an average of eight years experience in coding games. We are excited about our game and want to continue working on it after release. Being completely independent with no publisher, we develop with only the players’ interest in mind and are open to your input and feedback. We plan to add more maps (!), more powerups, teams, and other things that we think are fun. What do you think we should add? Feel free to reach out or write a review.

Name: Automatic Kingdom
Supported languages: You are the leader of a new Kingdom, starting from nothing and hoping to reach the highest levels of Prosperity. Each turn, play Cards to add Citizens, Constructions, Animals, and Soldiers to your Kingdom, building a city that can produce vast amounts of resources and protect itself from disease, invaders, and other challenges. Automatic Kingdom is all about trying to create synergies, placing Citizens near each other to generate resources and activate abilities. As your city grows, you will need to rearrange things and decide what must be kept, and what must be removed to make way for new additions. Do you keep your Cobbler near the Farmers to increase your Food, or is it time to shift it over to boosting the Miners for Labor? Or perhaps we could remove the Cobbler and put in a Cook instead? Challenges will emerge from nature, hostile nations, and the fabric of magic itself. While you are trying to grow your Kingdom, you must also find ways to protect it from disease, criminals, invaders, and more. New challenges are always emerging, and always growing stronger— so your Kingdom must always be growing stronger as well. Most of your resources reset every turn. This means that if you can't afford to build a Construction you want, you can't just sit around and wait— you need to figure out what must change in your Kingdom to reach the levels of resources required. Reach new levels of production by carefully arranging Citizens to activate synergies. As you ascend through the Tiers of Prosperity, you will be continually unlocking new Cards to add to your Kingdom, discovering new resources, abilities, and synergies. Will the older Citizens be valuable building blocks to combine with your newer members, or should some of them be removed to make way for new abilities? At higher Tiers, unlock new mechanics to provide for your Kingdom. Launch Invasions to secure more resources, craft Laws to reshape your Kingdom, and manage a Court of Councilors with shifting loyalties. After your victories, you will unlock new ways to play. Chaos Modifiers reshape the entire fabric of the game, changing the way your Kingdom will be built on future playthroughs. Alt Cards let you flip cards between two different versions, giving you more flexibility to try new strategies.

After a sudden accident separates them, the young girl embarks on a long journey to find her brother. Gameplay Introduction In Chapter 1, the girl arrives at the great tree where she promised to meet her brother. Delayed along the way, she finds only a letter left behind. Having waited so long, her brother feared the worst and set out for the city to search for her. Chapter 1 serves as an introduction to familiarize players with basic controls and mechanics. Players begin with the first skill: Capture Skill , which can capture single or multiple zombies of the same level. Captured zombies can be issued three commands: Attack , Follow , and Standby . The chapter contains five distinct areas, each with unique terrain and visual style. Players then unlock the second skill: Control Skill . This allows precise commands for captured zombies to move or attack designated targets. Players can also upgrade skills to enhance captured zombies' stats. In Chapter 2, players follow the girl into the city. Light rain falls from the gloomy sky, hinting at an oppressive, ominous atmosphere. Players will encounter new and higher-level zombie types, while watching for enemies lurking in the shadows. This chapter features four areas in a more open, expansive map with significantly increased difficulty. Chapter 2 brings the first boss battle and introduces a summoning mechanic to call more zombies for assistance. Players can also briefly capture Summoners—when captured, they temporarily convert all nearby low-level zombies into friendly units, allowing players to issue commands and turn the tide of battle. In Chapter 3, players will search for clues about their brother inside a hospital. This chapter features five floors, plus eight illusory environments of varying difficulty levels. Chapter 3 unlocks the third skill—Assimilation. This ability allows players to temporarily blend into hordes of equal-level zombies without being attacked, significantly boosting health and defense while also enabling them to sense hidden zombies. Players must solve floor-specific puzzles to find keys hidden across multiple rooms. Unlocking too many rooms triggers hallucinations, teleporting players to isolated illusory spaces. The more rooms unlocked, the more frequent the hallucinations become, and the more complex the puzzles within these spaces will be. There's even more exciting content awaiting your discovery! Supported languages: Game Description This is a minimalist calculation puzzle game that reinterprets the tactile feel and retro texture of old calculators in a modern way. Basic Rules At the start of the game, a random integer of up to 12 digits is given. Players refine the number using the following three operations: • Add 1 • Subtract 1 • Divide by 3 Timing your division while keeping the value as an integer is the key. If you end with 1 and divide it by 3, you achieve 0.33333333333 and clear the stage. Game Over Conditions If the player attempts to divide a number that is not a multiple of 3, a BURST occurs. One battery cell is lost, and accumulating three mistakes ends the game. If you fail to create 0.33333333333 within the given time, TOO LATE triggers and the battery decreases. When three mistakes accumulate and the battery is fully depleted, the game ends with the DEAD BATTERY screen. Score System DIGIT naturally increases based on your operation flow. As DIGIT grows, so does the score you earn. Reaching the answer with minimal operations grants a COMBO bonus. The more combos you stack, the higher the score. Challenge yourself and aim for your best score! Achievements A total of 7 achievements await you—from simple ones that occur naturally to more difficult challenges. Try collecting them all! Game Concept This game captures the feel of calculator screens, button presses, and the focused flow that comes from tidying up numbers. With only three simple rules, far more strategies emerge than expected. Build your own calculation routine and enjoy the process!

With single player and multiplayer gameplay modes, varied objectives, advanced avionics/instrumentation, and versatile combat systems, Arvoch Alliance SE provides a feature-packed and immersive space combat experience. • 3 Single Player Gameplay Modes - Campaign, Custom Campaign, and Instant Action. The Campaign features 30 missions of diverse objectives including escorting, spying, planet surface strikes and recovery, rescuing, capturing, mining, and building. The Custom Campaign mode lets players load missions they design using the mission editor. The Instant Action mode creates a randomly generated combat mission. • 4 Multiplayer Gameplay Modes - Cooperative Campaign, Dogfight, Squadrons, and Strike. The Cooperative Campaign mode lets players join together to complete the game's built-in campaign. The Dogfight mode is a battle for survival with all players hostile to each other. The Squadrons mode is a team-vs-team battle that lets players choose which side they will fight for and provides stations for each team for repairing and rearming. The Strike mode is also a team-vs-team battle, but it adds a command ship for each team to defend. The first team to destroy the opposing team's command ship wins. The host can define a kill limit or a time limit for the latter 3 modes and can add AI controlled ships to fill in empty player slots. The multiplayer mode also lets players quickly set up battle scenarios to play on their own using the mission options available to the host. • Advanced Order/Command System - Lead your squadron(s) by issuing commands to specific groups or individual ships using the mouse driven command interface (optional key and button bindings are also available). Give orders to attack, defend, join formation, hold at a particular location you select, or reload, repair, and refuel. Giving the right orders at the right time may often be critical to victory. Your ability to plan and lead can be just as important as your skill in combat. • Player Controlled Ship Selection And Configuration - Your command authority puts you in charge of which ships your flight group will use during most missions as well as what weapon and equipment configuration your ship will have. A simple drag-n-drop interface lets you quickly select ships and a loadout configuration prior to each mission. • Diverse and Interactive Environments - Descend into planets from space, travel through dense nebula clouds, fight the powerful winds of a gas giant, balance the pull of a high gravity star, navigate clusters of asteroids, and battle it out in the no-excuses realm of open space. Arvoch Alliance SE features several environments that can impact ship performance, fuel use, weapon availability, visibility, sensor range, and more. • Extensive Target Selection and Tracking Systems - Monitor the conditions of the battle with the Tactical Console and select ships for orders or targeting right from the console menu. Select targets by mouse clicking on them or use the proximity, gunsight, and list selection options. Track a target's missile count, particle and beam weapon types, speed, shield status, hull and subsystem damage, and even its trajectory with motion ladders. • Wide Array of Space Combat Systems and Options - Control and manage a range of elements related to space combat including heat signature management, shield array management, energy management, weapon selection spanning three classes, automatic and manual aiming factors, 2D and 3D radar modes, full three rotation axis and three direction axis Newtonian style physics, detailed instrumentation (including six velocity gauges, flight path markers, compass, and pitch ladder), multiple counter measure options, and target specification/status scanning. • Realistic Newtonian Style Physics Model - Utilize the flight tactics available with the inertial physics system that lets you drift freely and perform maneuvers such as high speed strafe passes and flipping around to fire at a target while flying backwards. Use the afterburner for quick speed and course changes while manually controlling the hull thrusters for additional adjustments. An optional Inertial Dampening System (IDS) is available to help keep flight control easier to manage. • Detailed 3D Cockpit and Instrumentation - The first person perspective pilot view offers an in-scene 3D cockpit that moves and responds to control input and impacts for a realistic sense of being in the ship itself. A helmet visor based Heads-Up-Display (HUD) renders important information that matches the pilot's view and is center focused. As much information as feasible is displayed on the central HUD gunsight and directly on the target being tracked for quick information gathering and situational awareness. Players who prefer an unobstructed view can optionally turn off the 3D cockpit, leaving only the HUD and displays. • New Graphics Engine and Effects - The new Vulkan based graphics engine provides several new special effects. • Event and Time Driven Missions - The new mission structure allows for in-game dialogues, ship departures, ambushes, and other timed events to occur. Players can even design their own dynamic campaigns in branching mission structures (where victory or defeat determines the next course of the campaign) using the optional mission editor. • New Music and Sound Effects - Dynamic music system (with music by Rich Douglas). The music changes with the level of hostility around you. • Diverse and Flexible Control Options - Supports keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and joystick flight control. Use the control device you prefer to play the game. The game supports up to 10 simultaneous control devices with up to 40 buttons each. • Full Support for TrackIR - Natural Point's TrackIR 3D head control system lets the player manage the viewpoint from the cockpit with all six degrees of movement.

Name: Slime Factory
Supported languages: About This Game In this game, players bounce continuously generated slimes and control their movement to achieve the highest possible score. When two slimes of the same type come into contact, they merge and evolve into a higher-tier slime with a greater base score value . Because the number of times slimes can be generated is limited, careful management is essential. Players must aim to evolve slimes efficiently, using as few generations as possible to create higher-ranked slimes. Scoring is not determined solely by slime evolution. Once a slime is dropped into a point zone , the final score is calculated based on the slime’s base score multiplied by the multiplier assigned to that specific zone . This means that even the same type of slime can result in vastly different final scores depending on where and when it is dropped. Proper timing and placement are therefore critical elements of high-scoring play. Players are required to consider multiple factors simultaneously: how to bounce slimes efficiently , how to guide them into contact with identical slimes to trigger evolution, and when to intentionally drop them into high-multiplier zones. Since careless bouncing can waste valuable slime generations, strategic control and planning are vital. The challenge lies in balancing slime growth with scoring opportunities while minimizing unnecessary generation usage. The game also incorporates mechanics inspired by crane games , introducing physics-based movement and a degree of unpredictability. Slimes may bounce in unexpected ways depending on timing, angle, and momentum, forcing players to adapt their strategy in real time. Mastering this physics-driven behavior is key to controlling slime placement and maximizing score potential. By combining thoughtful resource management, precise bouncing control, and well-timed scoring decisions, players can steadily improve their performance and aim for increasingly higher scores. Efficient play rewards foresight, adaptability, and a strong understanding of the game’s unique mechanics. Key Features Slimes evolve into a higher-tier form with increased base score when two identical slimes come into contact Final score points vary depending on the score zone multiplier, even for the same type of slime Certain slimes are generated automatically, but the total number of generations is limited Includes crane game–like mechanics

Name: Kotoba Dash
Supported languages: Kotoba Dash is a Japanese vocabulary review game designed for learners who already know the basics and want a more engaging way to test and reinforce what they have studied. Instead of clicking buttons or flipping flashcards, you control a character and physically run toward the correct answer. Movement adds time pressure and decision making, turning vocabulary review into something active rather than passive. This is not a complete learning course. Kotoba Dash is best used as a supplementary tool for review, practice, and self-testing. Who is this for? Kotoba Dash is designed for Japanese language learners from N5 to N1 . You should already: ˗          Know hiragana and katakana ˗          Be familiar with basic vocabulary The game is ideal if you: Want a game to review and test existing knowledge , not a sole learning resource Have been studying for a while and do not want to start from zero Find traditional flashcards boring or hard to stay consistent with Want a short, engaging daily game to maintain your studies Core Gameplay Kotoba Dash is a vocabulary quiz game focused on translation and reading recognition . Words are presented using kanji, kana, and English , with multiple question types such as: Kanji to English English to Kanji Kanji to Kana Kana to Kanji Optional furigana support is available and can be toggled on or off. All questions are multiple choice , but instead of selecting answers with a mouse, players move a character toward the answer . This introduces time pressure and makes recall more active and engaging. Input Keyboard focused Partial controller support exists for character movement Full UI navigation is keyboard based Game Modes Kotoba Dash includes multiple modes designed for different review styles. Testing Grounds An arcade, stage-based mode where difficulty increases over time. Shorter answer timers More answer options per question Focus on speed, accuracy, and survival Play for high scores and long runs A full run lasts approximately six to seven minutes Mastery Mode A structured, level-based progression system. Focuses on fixed sets of 10 words Levels take roughly 30 to 60 seconds Accuracy requirements must be met to unlock new levels Levels change on replay and are intended to be repeated to strengthen retention Exploration A fully customizable review mode. Choose JLPT levels, parts of speech, and question types Timer can be enabled or disabled No failure state Sessions can be short, long, or infinite Progress and Tracking Kotoba Dash tracks detailed performance metrics, including: Word accuracy Average accuracy Average answer speed Category-based performance All progress, runs, and statistics are saved and can be reviewed in a dedicated stats area called Inari’s Shrine . Players can freely switch between modes and unlock achievements over time. What Kotoba Dash Does Not Do Kotoba Dash is intentionally focused and does not attempt to teach everything. It does not : Teach Japanese from the ground up Teach hiragana or katakana Explicitly teach pronunciation (reading practice reinforces pronunciation through recognition, not instruction) Teach grammar, particles, or conjugation Teach sentence reading or comprehension Aim to cover every word in the language The vocabulary is broad but curated , and the game is intended as a supplementary review and self-testing tool , not a replacement for textbooks or courses. Why Kotoba Dash Exists Learning a language can be life changing, but staying consistent is often the hardest part. Traditional flashcards can become repetitive and passive over time. Kotoba Dash was created to make vocabulary practice more engaging by turning review into a game that rewards attention, speed, and accuracy. By tying answers to movement and time pressure, the game encourages faster recognition and stronger recall , while allowing learners to jump in at their current level without replaying content they already know.

Sokoban, Japanese for “warehouse keeper,” is a grid-based puzzle game created by Hiroyuki Imabayashi in 1981 and first published commercially in Japan in 1982 by Thinking Rabbit . The player controls a character inside a warehouse, viewed from above, and must push boxes onto designated storage locations. Boxes can only be pushed, never pulled, and only one box can be moved at a time. This simple rule creates deep, often fiendishly clever puzzles where planning is essential, and a single wrong move can make a level unsolvable. The game’s minimalistic mechanics have made it one of the most influential puzzle formats in video game history, spawning thousands of clones and variants.

Name: Dopdop Online
Supported languages: The game is currently in development. This version represents an early stage of development, and some features and systems are still being refined. Dopdop Online is a free-to-play collectible card game set in a surreal cosmic universe. Inspired by absurd sci-fi aesthetics, the game focuses on fast, tactical battles built around constant player choice — with absolutely no pay-to-win mechanics. Key Features Dynamic Deck Building (25–35 Cards) Players can freely choose their deck size, ranging from 25 to 35 cards . Smaller decks provide consistency, while larger decks offer flexibility and long-term planning. Scrap System — Cards as a Resource Any card in your hand can be Scrapped and converted into a resource. Even an unplayable card always has value, allowing you to adapt, manage your economy, and recover from difficult situations. Always a Meaningful Hand At the end of each round, your hand is automatically refilled up to 5 cards . This ensures that every turn offers multiple tactical options and encourages creative combinations instead of empty turns. Four Core Heroes Each hero belongs to a specific race and is defined by a unique glowing core color. Your chosen hero influences deck synergies and how your Scrap economy functions. Short, Fast-Paced Matches Matches typically last 3–5 minutes , making the game ideal for quick sessions while retaining strategic depth. Cosmic Arena The current build features a single space-themed arena. Additional arenas and visual improvements are planned for future updates. Gameplay Turn-Based 1v1 Matches The main game mode uses automatic online matchmaking to search for a suitable opponent. If no live opponent is available, the match may start against an AI-controlled opponent. Tactical Depth Through Choice Flexible deck sizes, the Scrap system, and consistent card draw ensure that every decision matters. Victory comes from timing, synergy, and smart resource management — not luck alone. Helpful Tutorial An in-game tutorial introduces core mechanics, card interactions, and the Scrap system, helping new players get comfortable quickly. Progression & Monetization Free-to-Play The game is completely free to play, with no paywalls and no pay-to-win mechanics. Card Collection Cards and packs can be earned through gameplay. Optional purchases are designed to support progression without providing unfair advantages. Live Systems in Development Additional progression systems, events, and rewards are planned and will expand over time as development continues. Platforms & Development Current Availability The game is currently available on PC. Additional platforms and cross-platform features are planned for future development. Ongoing Development We are actively refining balance, expanding content, and improving systems based on development goals and player feedback. Ready to Play? Jump into Dopdop Online and experience fast, flexible card battles where every card matters — whether you play it, Scrap it, or save it for the perfect moment. The cosmic journey has just begun.

Name: WonderLang Mandarin Chinese
Supported languages: Welcome to WonderLang Mandarin Chinese , where mastering Chinese becomes an engaging RPG journey . Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable . This page is for the Chinese-learning version of WonderLang, focusing on standard Mandarin Chinese . Learn Chinese from the following base (starting) languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Dutch, Indonesian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, and Arabic. Other WonderLang versions are also available so you can learn French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese. English is coming in February 2026 . There is also a WonderLang Polyglot edition that gives you access to all languages, including future releases in a single purchase. WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and narrative. Get immersed in WonderLang as you Explore , Fight , Converse , and Investigate using your target language . Every quest and interaction becomes meaningful practice. More affordable , more engaging , and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app ! WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners , allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of Chinese. While the game does not aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually as you play. Key Features Immersive Chinese Learning Learn practical Mandarin Chinese through every conversation, quest, and puzzle. More than 45 hours of combined learning and gameplay. 3 Modes to adapt the difficulty for very beginners, HSK 1, and HSK 2  level learners. Skippable Pinyin Module and Smart Input Support Start with a dedicated pinyin module that teaches pronunciation, and tones step by step. You can play it at your own pace or skip it entirely if you already know pinyin. Choose between different input modes: type Chinese using pinyin input , or select characters directly for precise answers and exercises. Flexible Reading Modes and Pinyin Support Pick between three character learning modes: pinyin only (no hanzi), top 110 hanzi (learn the most common characters while keeping the rest in pinyin), or full hanzi. Enable an option to display pinyin above hanzi . Pinyin shows pronunciation and tones, making it easier to read and learn new words. Practice drawing hanzi directly on your screen to internalize stroke order and improve writing memory. Engaging Storyline Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn Chinese to lift a magical curse from their brother. Explore vibrant towns, uncover secrets, and build friendships by interacting with over 60 unique NPCs . Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic Solve puzzles and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues. Practice pronunciation and tones with speech recognition challenges . Use in-game tools such as a dictionary , tone hints , and contextual help to support your learning. Spaced Repetition Combat Challenges Engage in language-based combat to reinforce vocabulary, tones, and grammar through repeated exposure. Combat challenges are designed using the spaced repetition principle to boost long term retention and keep your skills sharp. Real World Context Practice Apply your Chinese skills in everyday scenarios such as ordering food, shopping, or making appointments. Experience practical vocabulary and grammar in real world inspired contexts to enhance your confidence and fluency. Customizable Learning Experience Customize your learning journey with difficulty settings that make the experience more relaxed or more challenging. Set daily goals and earn rewards for reaching them, helping you build a consistent learning routine. Rich Interactive World Explore diverse locations , each introducing specific Chinese vocabulary, tones, and grammar patterns. Participate in mini games like crosswords, memory games, tone challenges, and character puzzles to diversify your learning experience. WonderLang can be played with a mouse and keyboard, mouse only, or keyboard only. It also plays great on the Steam Deck with an official control layout.

Name: The Seafloor
Supported languages: 《The Seafloor》— An Interactive Narrative Journey About Depression, Listening, and Coexistence Game Introduction 《 The Seafloor 》 is an emotionally immersive interactive narrative game played from a first-person perspective. You will play as 'River', a young girl experiencing depression, and live through seven seemingly ordinary yet internally tumultuous days through her eyes and heart. Core Gameplay & Experience Immersive Storytelling: Dive deep into the sensory and thought world of depression through rich inner monologues, environmental details, and character dialogues. Crucial Choices: Your every small choice in daily life and social interactions—whether responding to a mother's concern or deciding to go outside—will influence the protagonist's emotional state and the story's direction. Emotion Value System: The game features a subtle 'Emotional State' mechanism. Your choices accumulate positive or negative emotional feedback, subtly influencing subsequent plot branches and the final outcome. Multiple Endings: Based on your choices and emotional accumulation during the seven-day journey, the game will lead to two different endings, authentically reflecting the fluctuations and diversity of the recovery path. Game Content & Features Authentic, Detailed Vignettes of Daily Life: Experience mornings where getting up feels impossible, the cautious care of family, the unintentionally hurtful words of a friend... These real and fragmented life scenes form the emotional foundation of the game. A Rich Cast of Interactive Characters: Encounter and interact with a mother who cares but is at a loss, a well-meaning but clumsy best friend Ali, a wise elderly woman in the park, a silently comforting Bernese Mountain Dog, a professional psychologist, and more. Integration of Psychological Knowledge: Basic psychological knowledge and listening techniques are naturally woven into the game's dialogue and scenario design, aiming to provide an experience of 'understanding' rather than 'instruction'. Audiovisual Atmosphere: Carefully crafted scenes that align with the story's progression create an immersive emotional atmosphere, drawing you closer to the protagonist's inner world. From the Developer: I am a psychological listener. By chance, I once made a video about depression and subsequently received many pleas for help. Then I wondered if there was a way to make this kind of support reach more people. So, I began teaching myself basic coding and, with the help of several friends, created this game, 《 The Seafloor 》. This is not a traditional 'healing' type of work. It is more like a long letter written to all those walking alone in the emotional night, and also an invitation for you to personally step into and touch those hard-to-describe feelings. I cannot teach you 'how to defeat it' in this game, but I hope to practice 'how to coexist with it' together with you—how to recognize those faint yet real glimmers of light in a world washed in grey. If you happen upon this work, may what you feel here not be instruction, but understanding; not an urging that you 'must get better,' but a reassurance that 'it's okay to pause.' Perhaps what we learn in our lifetime is not how to escape the deep sea, but how to believe that light will still find its way down, even when we have fallen into the depths.

Name: MENACE
Supported languages: Command a strike force of marines, mercenaries, and criminals in a distant system, cut off from the Core Worlds. At the lawless frontier, the Wayback system is controlled by pirate warlords, questionable corporations, and fractured planetary governments who struggle for a new order. Though you initially lead your strike force of marines from aboard the strike cruiser TCRN Impetus, you'll quickly need to unite the disparate locals under your leadership to defeat an unknown threat. Fielding tanks, walkers, and infantry squads with a massive selection of equipment to choose from, you’ll train your troops, plan out operations, and engage in deadly tactical battles. The developers of Battle Brothers take us to the far future in MENACE – a turn-based tactical RPG set in an isolated system where a strange new threat has begun to emerge. Your Republic Marine Corps strike force has made its way over to bring the frontier back into the fold, but what was supposed to be a simple pacification mission revealed a threat that puts the entire system at risk… Your approach is entirely yours to determine – as distress calls roll in, calling you from planet to planet, you can decide which to respond to, what resources to employ, and when to engage based on your readiness levels. Your choices will determine how the local factions feel about your presence, with a direct impact on your relations with them and what favors they may be willing to do for you. Will you prioritize relations with criminal elements that specialize in gathering intel, hacking enemy equipment, and securing the best deals from local dealers? Or will you ignore them and focus on the recovery and repair teams that keep your vehicles operational while supplying you with powerful advanced tech? With all communications cut off, you're at the top of the chain of command, and your team of marines, mercenaries, and criminals turn to you for answers. Any single operation is not limited to one battlefield, instead taking you on branching paths of multiple missions each, asking you to engage in a series of battles across entire worlds. Make strategic decisions as you progress through an operation, choosing between the missions available to you – will you first take out the enemy air defenses that keep you from landing tanks? Or will you press directly into the enemy to rescue a group of hostages and gain the trust of the locals? Proceed mission by mission to complete the operation, and ultimately, further your grand campaign, but beware – every decision has serious consequences, not just for the operation at hand, but the entire system itself. The strike cruiser TCRN Impetus acts as your base of operations, not only ferrying you between missions, but providing both orbital support and a place for much needed R&R. Invest in upgrading and customizing your mobile HQ to best synergize with your approach on the battlefield, seeking out opportunities among local allies to gain the upper hand for the task ahead of you. Without access to your standard issue naval arsenal, you'll have to rely on local black market dealers and the spoils of war to equip your squads. From the jury-rigged war machines of the pirate factions to the refined, high-end arms of the local mercenaries, each engagement isn't just an opportunity to bring the fractured system under control, but to acquire new equipment to help accomplish your mission. The threat of death is real as you find yourself pit against numerically, and at times technologically, superior enemy forces. Large engagements across diverse battlefields are subject to the effects of weather conditions across a multitude of biomes, and human foes are the least of your concern. In the recesses of the system, something alien has taken hold, and its methods are unpredictable and unrelenting. Battles in MENACE are deadly affairs – under the hail of bullets, plasma bolts, and missile fire, you will face off against enemies that are well prepared, and ruthless. Expect to permanently lose squad leaders and their squads, and prepare to adapt to constantly evolving situations on the battlefield. Pacifying an entire system doesn’t come without a few risks, and superior tactical prowess will determine the victor. Use flanking maneuvers to make your way around cover, or use heavy ordnance to flush enemies out from their firing positions. Rush from cover to cover as you plot pincer attacks, opening fire to suppress enemy squads and pin them in place while working to destroy cover they might run to. A tactical approach is essential to coming out on top but remember to stay on your toes – though you can plan around intel gathered for mission briefings, plans never survive first contact with the enemy. Keep an eye on your weapons' efficient ranges, their damage over distance, and whether they're best used against heavily or lightly armored enemies. Even beyond accurate ranges, every round fired causes some degree of suppression to the squad it lands next to – whether they were the intended target or not, and whether friend or foe. With heavy fire more likely to pin an enemy down than small arms, you’ll be able to adapt based on the tools at your disposal, but make sure to adjust your approach as needed. Study the enemy to assess if you should be sniping from a distance or aggressively closing the gap under the cover of suppressing fire. Arrive on the battlefield with a variety of vehicles - from troop carriers to MLRS to jury-rigged pickup trucks and more, each with their own strengths and weaknesses, and a variety of weapons systems to choose from. The firepower of a lumbering tank is immense, but the nimble walker is able to respond to fast-moving threats in an instant, rotating freely and quickly. Designated pilots are able to bring these vehicles to the battlefield, albeit at a high cost. Will you opt to bring in self-propelled artillery you’ve commandeered from the mercenaries at the cost of better equipment for your infantry? You might lose an entire squad, but the extra firepower might just be what secures your victory. Use limited supplies to kit your squads out before each mission and ensure you're equipped for the task ahead. Infantry squads can swap their armor to strike a balance between protection and utility with additional accessory slots, where accessories range from drones to grenades to target designators. Each squad can be equipped from a wide selection of weapons with different advantages and disadvantages, as well as particularly powerful specialist weapons – everything from flamethrowers to sniper rifles to EMP cannons. Pike is the model marine – loyal to the Republic, and a professional soldier, unwavering in the face of adversity. Rewa suffers from the trauma of past scars, a violent rage constantly boiling beneath the surface. Lim owes Pike for saving his home colony, and distrusts non-Marines – but he'll have to learn to meet them in the middle as the going gets rough. Every squad leader in MENACE has a history and personality, and as their commander, it's up to you to navigate the trouble that can bring. From the marines you flew in with to the locals you need to recruit, each squad leader carries their own expectations and aspirations. Their accomplishments and failures on the battlefield will influence their leadership – a mission with multiple confirmed kills might help bolster morale for the following engagements, but a squad leader that sees their entire team eliminated might perform worse for some time as they regain composure. Will you take on the liability of an underperforming squad just because you need the numbers, or will you put them on leave until they recover, potentially jeopardizing the current operation entirely? Squad leaders earn promotions and improve over time, giving you the option to customize them to your liking and improve their squad’s performance. Keep your squad leaders alive and choose perks from varied promotion trees, acquiring additional active and passive abilities to use against the enemy. Each playthrough features a selection of characters from a massive pool – learn how individual backstories are tied together and prepare to navigate the unique combinations of each run. Stories unfold in unexpected ways as your squad leaders push from engagement to engagement. Watch them crumble under pressure from a cataclysmic threat, and do your best to train them for the fight against the MENACE. With procedurally generated multi-mission operations and battle maps, alongside a big selection of characters and countless equipment options, every run of MENACE plays different from the last. Find yourself face to face with a seemingly insurmountable challenge that takes on multiple forms across playthroughs, and put your strategic and tactical prowess to the test in new ways each time.

Supported languages: A Fully Animated and Fully Voiced Light Novel Game! Set in Tokyo, a lonely android girl, Rin, meets Aoi and forms a deep friendship, gradually reclaiming her humanity. However, when Rin learns the secret of her origins, the story takes a dramatic turn. Story Overview 'Tokyo Girls Chronicle' is a story about two girls who meet and form a deep friendship in the city of Tokyo. On a cold, rainy day in Tokyo, an android girl named Rin sits alone in a park, feeling a sense of solitude. With no emotions or memories, she longs for a connection with someone. Then, a black-haired girl named Aoi appears, gently speaking to Rin and inviting her under her umbrella. As they gradually grow closer, Aoi accepts Rin for who she is and understands her loneliness. When the rain stops and a rainbow appears, Rin experiences emotions for the first time and realizes that meeting Aoi marks the beginning of a new life. As their bond deepens, Rin slowly regains her humanity. However, when Rin discovers the truth about her origins, the story takes a dramatic turn. Inspiration Behind the Game Until now, I hadn't been particularly interested in light novel games. This was because most of them consisted mainly of text and still images, resembling a picture book, which didn’t appeal to me. So, I asked myself—what if I were to create a light novel game? I thought that if it were fully animated, it might capture my interest. And if I could actually create it myself, it could be a truly exciting project. I wanted to keep the story simple, focusing on the bond between two girls. I chose Tokyo as the setting because I once lived there and have a deep admiration for the city. Exploration Feature In the middle of the story, players can enjoy an exploration game where Aoi searches for Rin. Use the hints within the visuals to find Rin and progress through the story. How to Play Press the Opening button to watch the opening movie. After the movie ends, press the Return to Title Screen button. The button for the next chapter will appear, allowing you to continue the story. Guidelines for Streaming Streaming of this game is permitted up to the chapter 'Emily’s Story.' Beyond that point, streaming is prohibited to prevent spoilers.

Name: The Run
Supported languages: Zanna Hendricks is a world-famous fitness influencer. To celebrate reaching another career milestone, she has come to a remote running trail in the picturesque mountains of Northern Italy. Zanna hides a traumatic past behind her steely façade & a couple of kilometres into her run, she is attacked by a group of masked killers. They relentlessly hunt Zanna across the landscape as her morning run becomes a run for her life. The player must consistently make decisions that determine Zanna's survival. The choices you make are worth life, death & beyond. This FMV horror-thriller game features: Choice-based mechanics including 20 unique deaths and 5 endings. Two game modes: - Timed Choices : A more immersive, pressured experience. - Paused Choices : For group play / audience participation during live streams. A graphic Story Map of all possible narrative branches. These branches unlock as the player progresses through the pool of 3 hours of filmed content. Renowned acting talent, including Roxanne McKee ( Game Of Thrones ), George Blagden ( Vikings ), Jamie Ward ( His Dark Materials ), as well as icons of Italian cinema Dario Argento (director of Suspiria ) and Franco Nero ( Django ). Paul Raschid - the writer-director, is one of the world's most prolific creatives in the FMV game format. His other titles include: The Complex , Hello Stranger , The Gallery and Five Dates . The Run is a Benacus Entertainment production in association with RNF Productions. Their feature film credits include Double Down South , St Agatha , Walden  &  Dead Money .
Average playtime forever: Fairly regular depictions of violence and gore throughout (dependent on decisions made).

Name: QUIZ GAME MUSEUM
Supported languages: ✦ Quiz Game Museum ✦ A history of games, built through play Quiz Game Museum is a quiz game that lets players naturally learn about the knowledge and history of video games through four-choice questions. Going beyond simple general trivia, the game is built on a vast database covering the entire game industry— from the history of console hardware by Nintendo, Sony, and Sega, to the Magnavox Odyssey, the starting point of both PC and console gaming, all the way to the latest hardware, the Nintendo Switch 2. Players can explore quizzes about legendary home consoles and handheld systems, PC hardware and the iconic games born from each platform, as well as the people who shaped and drove the game industry. The experience feels like walking through a full-scale exhibition of video game history. In addition, the game includes quiz sets focused on titles released in South Korea, allowing players to explore the evolution of Korean game culture as well. At launch, the game features a total of 44 quiz sets and 880 questions, with more quizzes planned to be added in future updates. If you love games, Quiz Game Museum invites you to play, learn, and take your game knowledge to the next level. 🔥 Recommended for players who… ✅ Want to remember games not just as entertainment, but as history 🏛️ Have always wanted to organize the timeline of console and PC gaming 🎮 Are curious about the differences and evolution of Nintendo, Sony, and Sega hardware 🕹️ Want to learn about the game industry from the Magnavox Odyssey to modern consoles 📚 Enjoy revisiting classic games and their historical significance through quizzes 🇰🇷 Are interested in games released in South Korea and the country’s gaming culture 🧠 Want to enjoy games as knowledge, not just as play experiences

Name: Cosmic Order Fleet
Supported languages: 1.Description Command massive planetary fleets in Star Command! An immersive real-time strategy epic. Utilize advanced physics engines to outsmart commanders worldwide in deep-space battlefronts. Conquer systems, upgrade fortresses, and turn the tide with 'Shield Bursts.' Featuring 1v1 Duels, 2v2Team Battle and 6-player Global Chaos. 2. About This Game [Restoring Order to the Galaxy] The galaxy has slumbered in the 'Great Silence' for three hundred years. As the last awakened Executor, you will carry the 'Genesis Key' across eight lost sectors. This is not merely a journey of conquest, but a tactical game concerning the renaissance of civilization. [Core Gameplay: Macro Tactics & Physical Micro-management] Galactic Conquest: Every planet is your arsenal. Rationally allocate population growth and fleet deployment to build a solid logistics network. Fleet Merging System: Units automatically cluster into powerful battle groups during hyperspace jumps, reducing chaos while greatly enhancing the visual impact of large-scale skirmishes. Shield Burst: Once the planetary shield is fully charged, you can unleash a devastating energy pulse, evaporating all enemies entering the orbital ring. Stellar Cataclysm: Capturing the central 'Stellar Core' triggers a supernova. This is a 'strategic nuke' capable of instantly wiping out all mobile units on the map—a gambit of high risk and high reward. 3. The Multiplayer Experience The soul of this game lies in its minimalist multiplayer system. Diverse Combat Modes: Ranked Duel (1v1): Climb the MMR ladder in a pure contest of intellect and reflexes, aiming for the 'God of War' rank. Dark Forest Brawl (6-Player FFA): A survival game filled with chains of suspicion. You can choose to lie low and grow, or scavenge for profit while your opponents destroy each other. Co-op Battle (2v2): Share intelligence with allies—one defends the fortress while the other flanks—to experience true interstellar collaboration. Player Experience: Zero-Wait Matchmaking: Smart matching protocols automatically recycle hosts based on player behavior, ensuring you connect to a valid signal within seconds. Real-Time Telemetry HUD: A holographic UI designed specifically for combat, displaying real-time K/D ratios, force balance bars, and territory control, giving you complete mastery over the battlefield's flow. Achievements & Glory: Every multiplayer victory earns you gold to unlock unique planet skins (such as 'Fortress' or 'Ancient Ruins') and ship appearances, making your fleet unique across the star map. Every precise maneuver you make is writing a new history for the galaxy. 4. Visuals & Tech Dynamic vignetting, bloom, and tone mapping create a cold, profound, and hardcore sci-fi atmosphere. Procedural Music: A 128-bit synthesis engine dynamically switches themes based on battlefield tension, transitioning smoothly from serene exploration to intense crossfire.

Name: Echoes of Vision
Supported languages: This is a turn-based strategy game. You'll assume the role of the Special Investigations Division Chief at the Bureau of Crisis Response (BCR), leading agents deep into Bleak Mountains City, a metropolis steeped in retro 1980s charm, to investigate and contain various supernatural “Visions”. The game blends mind-bending tactical gameplay with urban legends steeped in primal fear, delivering a uniquely immersive experience. Story Background Welcome to Bleak Mountains City: a retro metropolis that appears prosperous on the surface, yet simmers with hidden currents. Here, urban legends are not mere fiction. Endlessly looping rooms, stations that shouldn't exist, rain-soaked beings reeking of dampness... These supernatural “Visions” lurk in every corner of the city, threatening lives. As the newly appointed Special Investigations Chief of the Bureau of Crisis Response (BCR), a secret agency dedicated to handling such incidents, your duty is to delve into the heart of these bizarre events. Utilize your intellect, strategic prowess, and the unique abilities of your agents to uncover the truth and maintain the city's fragile peace. 🕵️ Dive into the labyrinth of urban legends as a rational investigator You face not traditional ghosts, but “Visions” defying logical explanation. The game's narrative employs a unique and intense “new weird” atmosphere. Like a true detective, you must investigate crime scenes, gather evidence, and analyze clues to gradually piece together the bizarre truths lurking beneath the city's neon lights. ⚙️ Master battlefield tactics in hardcore tactical combat Battles are contests of intellect. Command your agents across the map, using partial and full cover to evade damage while setting up alert zones for counterattacks. Each class has distinct roles, strategic class composition and positioning are key to victory. Mastering the Phase affinities and their counter-relationships will help you overcome formidable foes. 🎭 Meet extraordinary allies and assemble an exceptional investigation unit Your allies are equally extraordinary. They may be elite colleagues responding to incidents, fanatical researchers obsessed with their studies, or even anomalous entities themselves in urgent need of containment. Recruit these characters through story missions and bring them under your command. They wield special devices called “Packaged Items”, enabling them to harness the power of contained Visions, though this power comes with risks and costs. 🏙️ Immerse Yourself in Retro Urban Visuals The game meticulously crafts a unique 1980s retro aesthetic through its audiovisual design. From the green tourmaline desk lamps and vintage clocks in offices to retro posters lining the streets, every detail is carefully crafted. All main characters feature high-quality animations and full Chinese voice acting, enhancing the immersive narrative experience.
