Name: Faehnor Online
Supported languages: NOT AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH YET!   For the moment, the game server is located in France, so countries that are geographically distant may experience higher latency. Only the following countries are currently open: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Andorra, Monaco, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Greece, Canada, and the United States. Please hang tight a little longer… :)  FAEHNOR ONLINE IN A FEW WORDS This game was born from an unreasonable idea : creating a homemade MMORPG , without a big studio or a real budget — just stubborn passion and the desire to offer an adventure that truly feels handcrafted. In this open world, exploration isn’t guided by an omnipresent mini‑map or a magic navigation system . Study paper maps and learn to find your way like a real adventurer. Getting lost is part of the journey — finding your way back always carries a small taste of victory. ⚔️ A WORLD SHAPED FOR REFLEXES Here, monsters don’t drag their feet: they rush, bite, strike, and never wait for their turn. Attacks are fast, direct, and without warning. Every encounter forces you to decide in a second — dodge, strike, flee. “Hesitation is often the worst option.” 🧭 A WORLD THAT WILL NEVER HOLD YOUR HAND Here, nothing blinks to tell you where to go! No quest markers , no icons above NPCs, no arrow to put you back on the right path. If you get lost, no navigation system will bring you home. This is a world that lets you search , observe , ask questions… and sometimes wander in circles. But that’s also what makes every discovery truly yours. “Adventure begins where the arrows end.” 🌿 A WORLD WHERE YOU FIT INTO NO BOX Here, your progression follows no prefabricated model. At each level, you alone choose which direction to take . No imposed class, no predetermined path: only your choices define who you become. And even if the result sometimes feels a little uneven, that’s exactly what makes you unique. “Shape your strengths and embrace your weaknesses.” Otherwise, you’ll find the familiar codes of MMORPGs : combat, quests, crafting, exploration, encounters… but with the singular touch of a world shaped by a single pair of hands. 🚧 3 UPCOMING STEPS 🎬 Intro sequence and opening cinematic So you no longer drop into the world like you’ve been thrown in at random — your arrival deserves at least a bit of flair. ⚔️ Combat gameplay improvements – phase 2 (status effects / control / aggro / buffs) Because it’s time for everyone to do something other than run in circles screaming . [currently testing] 🔧 Switch to UE5 Because at some point, we have to accept it’s time to leave prehistory behind. ❓ FAQ. What about English? The English translation is well underway but not fully completed yet. English voice‑over will only be available at a later stage. How will the game be financed? A premium item shop ( non pay‑to‑win ) will be available soon. You’ll find cosmetic options and other practical items there. Tell us more about the team. This MMORPG began in 2019, first developed by two people, before becoming a project fully carried by a single creator since late 2022 . The world, the systems, the mechanics… everything has been built patiently, line by line, with occasional help from external artists for certain visual elements.   Do I need a third‑party account to play? Yes. The game is not yet linked to Steam accounts . You’ll need to create a separate account on the game’s official website . Registration only requires minimal information and takes just a few seconds. Do you use AI? As of today, no content in the game has been generated using AI.

Detailed Description: Vocab Clash completely redefines how vocabulary learning works: “Understand the scene first, then answer with your body.” There are no Chinese translations or English definitions in the game. Every word’s meaning is conveyed purely through visuals—images or short videos. It feels like playing a visual riddle: you observe the scene, grasp the concept it represents, and react quickly. Physical action and visual understanding merge in an instant, turning word meanings into intuitive reflexes. Core Features: Text-free visual association: Meaning is triggered entirely by images/videos, forcing the brain to bypass translation and build a direct link between concepts and English words. Motion-based answering mechanics: Choices are designed as sports actions like punching, throwing, and swinging—replacing mechanical clicks with embodied memory. Learning itself becomes a calorie-burning workout. Closed-loop learning flow: Observe (watch the scene) → Understand (infer meaning) → Act (choose through motion) → Feedback (correct/incorrect), all completed inside an immersive VR environment. Intelligent training system: Includes AI-based adaptive difficulty, targeted review for mistakes, and progress tracking to ensure learning effectiveness compounds over time.

Supported languages: The year is 2182.  High Command has dispatched the USS Almayer to the frontier. You are a member of the Falling Falcons  - 2nd Company, 2nd Battalion, 4th Brigade. Your orders are simple: Respond to an unknown distress signal, secure the colony, and neutralise any threats. But on the rim of known space, nothing is ever simple. BYOND: Build Your Own Net Dream Built on the ancient, accursed, yet still beloved BYOND platform, this isn’t regular SS13 ; it's a completely overhauled multiplayer roleplay tactical disaster simulator. It looks like a game from the 90s, plays like a milsim from the future, and breaks like a cheap lawnmower. Whether you are holding the FOB, performing open-heart surgery in a sand pit, or playing a xenonid trying to figure out how to open a door, your actions define the round. Every bullet must be accounted for, every wound requires surgical precision to treat, every host must be incubated, and every order must move down the chain of command. KEY FEATURES Massively Multiplayer:  Theoretically high player counts allow for full company-scale operations, meaning lots of people screaming over the radio at once or complaining that the Empress is micromanaging the hivemind. Complex Medical System: Health isn't just a bar. Treat broken bones, internal organ failure, and overdoses. If the xenonids don't kill you, the medic mixing up the labels on the pill bottle might. Destructible Environments: Blow open walls with C4, weld doors, or burn down the entire jungle because you saw a spider. Logistics & Command: The war isn't won by shooting alone. It’s won by the shipside support crew, including the Requisitions Officer, who orders the ammo for your rifle, and the Executive Officer, who really didn't mean to accidentally orbital bombard Delta Squad. Roleplay First: Immerse yourself in the hierarchy. Follow orders, shout tactical info over the radio, and engage in the unique 'culture' of the Falling Falcons. Emergent Storytelling: Will you hide in a locker for 45 minutes as a suvivor? Will you robust a xenonid with a toolbox? Or will you succumb to liver failure after finding the colony's vodka stash? Corporate Interests: Roleplay as a Liaison from a shadowy company that cares more about the quarterly profit margins than your survival. Hostile Third Parties: Sometimes it’s insurgents. Sometimes it’s high-tech hunters. Sometimes it’s just the Military Police arresting you for not wearing your helmet. ⚠️ WARNING: READ BEFORE ENLISTING ⚠️ 1. Ancient Technology:  This game runs on BYOND . When you click 'Play' on Steam, it will install the BYOND requirements for you. Yes, you sometimes will get an popup for Byond Premium when it boots up.  Lummox JR  has to eat somehow.  2. The Learning Cliff: The controls are not intuitive. You will accidentally shoot your foot. You will drop your gun in the middle of a firefight. You will struggle to open a bag of chips. The UI  looks like the cockpit of a 747-800. Take a moment to read the starter guide, call a Mentor (F1), or just ask the Marine standing next to you how to put your helmet on. We were all bald and confused once. 3. Roleplay Expectations:  aka Yes, you have to play as a Character.  This is a Medium Roleplay (MRP) environment. Names: Name your character something believable, not 'xx_Headshot_King_xx' or 'Obi-Wan Kenobi.' Behaviour: You are a Marine (or a giant bug). Act like one. If you run around griefing your teammates or screaming internet memes in the chat, you will probably hear the dreaded Bwoink . That is one of our volunteer Moderators coming to have a very polite conversation with you about your life choices. 4. The Rules: Read them. They exist to keep the chaos fun, not frustrating. If you break Marine Law, the MPs will arrest you. If you break Server Rules, the Admins will probably ban you without much fanfare.

Name: Amanecer
Supported languages: Amanecer is a 2D psychological horror game designed to deliver a brief yet intense experience. A young boy wakes up in a strange house, with no memory of who he is or how he got there. To uncover the truth, he must explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and collect letters and clues that piece together fragments of the story. Narrative exploration: Wander through eerie rooms filled with secrets and hidden details. Environmental puzzles: Unlock doors, activate mechanisms, and overcome logical challenges to progress. Item collection: Gather letters and symbolic objects that reconstruct the protagonist’s past. Character progression: Each discovery brings the boy closer to understanding why he is trapped and how to escape. Oppressive atmosphere: Minimalist pixel art and haunting silence reinforce the psychological tension. Amanecer invites players to embark on an emotional journey where every clue reveals a new piece of the mystery, and every step leads closer to the final revelation.
Genres: Single-player,Steam Achievements,Full controller support,Steam Cloud,Family Sharing

Name: 建てろ大神殿 どらどらんど
Supported languages: 'Build the Great Temple: Dora Dora Land' is a short roguelike simulator that combines deck building, resource management, and personnel management through multiplication. Construction You can purchase and expand buildings. The higher the level of the building, the more powerful its resource production and various enhancement effects. When building, you may also obtain special enhancement items called 'relics.' Relics When acquired, they provide special enhancement effects. Their effects are diverse, and strategic acquisition enhances their effectiveness. Action Phase Once you're ready, begin your day's actions. A deck is constructed based on the buildings you own, and each player carries out the action of the day. During the action phase, you can acquire strengthening effects, resources, and additional personnel. Master resource gathering and aim to build the Great Temple!

Name: Cheddar and Feta
Supported languages: Two Mice, One Mission Play as Cheddar and Feta, two brave mice trapped deep within a militarized fire ant colony. Work together with a friend online or locally. If one mouse falls, the other has just moments to stay alive! If both mice are downed, then it's game over. Online Co-op Adventure Connect with a friend over the internet using peer-to-peer WebRTC technology. Share your connection code and embark on this adventure together, no matter the distance! Kick, Throw, Survive Armed with nothing but their tiny paws, Cheddar and Feta can kick enemies to fend them off. But to truly thrive, you'll need to scavenge powerful items scattered throughout the tunnels: toothpicks to throw as deadly javelins, molotov cocktails to set the ants ablaze, and protective shields to reduce incoming damage. Cheese is Life Discover precious cheese wedges dropped by fallen foes. Eat cheese to heal your wounds. Face the Swarm Battle through an ever-dangerous horde of fire ants, fierce drones swooping from above, rumbling tanks, and toothpick-shooting agents. And finally, defeat the dreaded Queen: a fearsome multi-segmented bug that blocks your way to the surface. Ring the Bell, Open the Gate Strike mysterious bells hidden in the ant hill to clear the waves of enemies guarding locked gates. Only when the last foe falls will the path forward open! Climb to Freedom Ascend toward the light using ladders scattered throughout the ant hill. Navigate multiple interconnected levels as you find your way to the surface!

Name: Trust Me, I Nailed It
Supported languages: The world wasn’t saved by the hero’s blade, but by the editor’s mouse cursor. You are a dedicated video editor tasked with manipulating battle footage of a hopeless warrior who can’t clear a dungeon. Hired by a warrior with no skill but endless ego, you must produce flashy “clear videos” that make it look like a flawless victory. Analyze pre-battle intel that reveals enemy attack patterns, then place the warrior’s limited action clips on a timeline to write a scenario where victory is inevitable. Satisfy both the cheering townsfolk and the dopamine-addicted Demon Lord, complete a fake heroic legend in seven days, and save the world. Design the Win Before the Battle Begins In the video editor, enemy attack patterns and disruptive actions are provided as pre-recorded footage. Before the battle begins, players preview the timeline to identify exactly when attacks will occur and plan their countermeasures accordingly. Clip Editing Design the warrior's movements by placing 「Move」,「Melee Attack」,「Ranged Attack」, and 「Block」 clips onto an 8-tick timeline. Visual Effects (VFX) The highlight of editing is post-processing! Instantly transform a simple walk into a Teleport, or turn a weak jab into a Critical Hit to overwhelm your enemies. Running low on memory? Don’t worry! Meet optimization goals such as 'Fill All Timeline Slots,' 'Land 2+ Effective Hits,' or 'No Damage Taken' to increase your available memory capacity. A Story Told Through FAKE Clear Videos Enjoy the stark contrast between the warrior’s shameless request emails and the hero-worshipping news that pops up on your desktop. In reality, the so-called hero is always running away—but turning them into the savior of the world through a nerve-wracking con is entirely up to you.
Genres: Single-player,Steam Achievements,Custom Volume Controls,Adjustable Difficulty,Playable without Timed Input,Save Anytime,Steam Cloud

But something lurks in the shadows. Are you the one controlling the dice, or merely a pawn in their game? In this gamble with no way back, the only certainty is that every roll could be your last.

Name: Where We Echo
Supported languages: Where We Echo is a meditative screensaver and interactive art piece about fishing for meaning. Catch echoes of strangers’ lives left behind by 100+ people who visited before you. Release your own story into the pool, anonymously. Discover how we’re all shaped by moments of connection and hope, and maybe feel a little less alone. You are a fisher at a liminal pool near the edge of the sky, where echoes of human stories fall from the sky, unheard. Catch and witness these echoes of humanity. Release them back into the pool for others to discover. Here, fishing is an act of empathy. Screensaver integration is available on Windows only. This project is built around real stories from real (but anonymous) people. It proposes a different type of social online space: one that encourages us to seek out who each other really are again through our personal stories, making empathy, vulnerability, and personal reflection a daily habit. Thank you to everyone who took the time to share and allowed your stories to be a part of this project! 💛

Supported languages: A crew. A job. A plan. In Relooted , toss those ingredients together, and you’ve got yourself a classic heist — but with a few twists. Well, that’s up to you to create. Africanfutur-heist Near the end of the 21st century, the political powers that be brokered a Transatlantic Returns Treaty, promising the repatriation of African artifacts from museums. Good old fashioned diplomacy was working — until it wasn’t. An amendment switched up the terms and conditions of which objects were to be returned. Museums, now knowing that only publicly displayed artifacts would be given back, were slowly removing artifacts from public display. When life gives you lemons and museums pulling shady moves, it’s time to chuck the lemons back at life and try a new, stealthier form of diplomacy. You’ve got 70 of these artifacts to (re)loot, all of which exist in real-life and are of huge cultural, historical, and spiritual significance to the people they were taken from. Teamwork Makes The Heist Work It all starts with a troublesome little brother, who, yeah, gets you into all sorts of messes. But thankfully, as Nomali, you’ll meet more reliable crew members from different African countries. Recruit people from the classic hacker to… your prim and proper grandma? Don’t worry, grandma pulls her weight. Case the Joint Plan ahead to lay the groundwork for a beautiful masterpiece of an escape. Check the getaway route, fiddle with puzzles and obstacles, and find spots to recruit the help of the right teammates.  Get In. Get Out. Once you’ve set the stage carefully and the artifact is sitting all pretty — looking quite not-stolen, but no worries, you’re gonna fix that ASAP — this is the moment to perform. Plucking an artifact from its resting spot starts the countdown timer, and with Nomali’s flow-based parkour abilities, escape should feel like you’re in the fun, montage part of a heist movie. But if you slacked on the planning phase, you’re gonna pay for it! Key Features:  Pull off heists : Plan and prepare your escape route by solving puzzles and placing teammates in the right place. When you’re ready, take the artifact and escape with Nomali’s flow-based parkour abilities.  Recruit a crew : Meet and and gradually recruit different team members with their unique abilities. Instead of static enemy lists, each wave is generated using a weighted budget system—ensuring scaling challenge and variety without overwhelming the player unfairly. Medium Units – Heavier enemies, not so easy to kill or push away. Tanks – Slow, heavily armored units that soak up serious damage Ranged Attackers – Enemies that can shoot from a distance, with the ability to push you down off the cliff. Name: Rambler NTE
Supported languages: Rambler NTE (NTE = Noto Emoji) An emoji roguelike born from respect for “Rogue.” If dungeons were once drawn with ASCII, why not build them with emoji (Noto Emoji) today!? That curiosity is where this Mystery Dungeon–style, turn-based dungeon crawler began. The visuals are an homage, but the gameplay is rebuilt around exploration and decision-making. Step through a dungeon that changes every run, read enemies, items, and terrain, and try to reach and conquer the lowest floor. In every expedition you’ll choose whether to fight, avoid danger, or save resources—your choices shape the outcome. Rambler NTE is a turn-based, tile-based adventure where each action can change the situation. Enemies, items, and status effects are represented with emoji, letting you “read” the screen at a glance. Items are limited and often uncertain, so deciding what to pick up, when to use it, and what to save is the key to survival. Progression is centered on level-based balance. The difficulty is tuned around your level, and neither rushing downward nor lingering too long is always the right answer. There is no fixed “expected pace” to reach the final floor—the fastest clears are expected to come from a balanced playstyle that is both cautious and bold. The game is currently being tuned, especially the density of exploration and the feel of play. During Early Access, we will keep updating not only by adding content, but also by refining the core of the game. We are also designing additional areas meant for purpose-driven runs, such as boss hunting and item gathering, beyond simply clearing floors. Should the game become more complex and “deep,” or simpler and more “satisfying”? In pursuit of a truly fun dungeon exploration experience, we will continue improving the game while incorporating feedback from the community.

Clues will lead you to the truth Every crime scene contains clues: hair, fingerprints, blood, clothing... Who do the clues point to? The more clues you gather, the more you can narrow down who the culprit is. The rules Winning is simple: eliminate the opposing team! It's a life-or-death battle between the wolves and lambs. Who will reign supreme? The lambs, with numbers on their side, or the wolves, whose identities are unknown and can hide among the flock? However, the cleverest of lambs have another path to victory: escape. Can you flee the castle? All you must do is secure keys to the harbor gate and raise the anchors. Easy, right? But can you truly trust everyone working alongside you? Might makes right in the end! Show no mercy! Forget voting and finger-pointing. Once you've found the killer, it's time to fight. If you're strong or clever, you'll survive. If not? You're just another corpse in a hallway. Kill however you like An array of items are hidden in the castle: -Guns and melee weapons to give yourself a fighting chance -Traps and poisons perfect for murder -Armor and gas masks to protect oneself There's no one sure-fire strategy. Your path to victory is shaped by your playstyle. Focus Mode Sharpen your senses and feel your surroundings come alive. Focus Mode lets you detect a killer's footprints, bullet casings and glass fragments, or even sounds through walls. Immersive voice chat with 3D audio Want to talk in private? Step into a room and close the door. KILLER INN uses 3D audio voice chat that takes into account players' locations, distance between them, and the space around them. Not a fan of voice chat? You can also communicate using a wide range of emotes and stamps. Unique characters, endless strategies Who do you want to be? Reinvent yourself by adopting whichever persona you like. Each character has their own unique abilities. They can be silent movers, master sleuths, or even expert thieves. Use their skills to shape your strategy and turn the tide. Play solo, or in a duo, trio, or squad! Whether you roll solo or bring a crew, the ultimate game is waiting for you. Form a skilled squad of detectives, or become a cunning pack of wolves. You can stay in sync with your party members through voice chat even when they're not in close proximity. *This game is online-only, and gameplay may become unavailable if the game service is terminated in the future.

Name: Cover The Background
Supported languages: This game features over 100 levels with a wide range of mechanics and difficult puzzles. The levels start easier but they increase in difficulty as you get to higher levels. How to play: Pick up pieces and rotate them to fit them onto the background. Each level only has a limited number of pieces so you need to be careful. Nearly every level has multiple solutions, so if you don't have to worry about brute forcing for a solution. Each level is made up of black squares which is what you need to cover to win. There are also special squares that either hinder or help you solve the puzzle. Special squares: Red squares: Red squares stop you from placing a piece if any of your pieces squares are on it. Deletion squares:  Deletion squares delete the square of the piece placed on top of the deletion squares. Pressure plates: Pressure plates hide certain squares that cover the background. You need to place a piece on top to activate it. Some pieces may be different than others. Locked Pieces will appear in later levels. Locked Pieces: Just as the name implies, some pieces you will be locked and you cannot rotate them. While this can be helpful since you know it starts in its final rotation. It can be pretty frustrating when the last piece would fit perfectly, if only you could rotate it. Play Time: Since different players will find different levels easier/harder it is hard to judge how long it will take any one player to complete the game. Play testing has shown the whole game done in only ~5 hours. Where other play tests took over an hour per level on some of  the harder levels.

Name: 登咚登
Supported languages: A 2D top-down perspective maze adventure exploration game. It requires two players to cooperate and escape the maze in the unknown darkness, being as careful as possible of the monsters along the way, with the option to choose to fight or to evade. Game Story: Do ghosts exist in this world? Do you believe? I do, because I have seen them.My name is Bell, and I am an exorcist. My grandmother once said that ghosts are born from human thoughts, namely the three delusions: greed delusion, attachment delusion, and anger delusion. Greed delusion is like a bone-corroding blade, repeatedly pulling one back in the grip of unfulfilled desire; attachment delusion resembles an unsolvable maze, wandering through memories while clinging to what has passed; anger delusion is like lingering embers, burning every inch of space with unresolved resentment.   Now, my partner Lens and I form an exorcist duo, traveling around the world to return restless thoughts to peace.     Players control a duo:   -Bell, an exorcist girl from an ancient family heritage, always carries five bells at her waist. It is said that these five bells are the family's ancestral artifacts, each note containing unparalleled magical power. When the breath of the ghost quietly spreads, the ancient tune that transcends time will slowly begin to play. The melody seems to have a spirit, gently pulling the souls of the three delusions, leading them out of the fog of obsession and guiding them to a place of liberation.   - Lens doesn’t have any superpowers or magical artifacts; he is an ordinary person, or rather, a mortal. However, fortunately, he is precisely the most extraordinary type among ordinary people. He is a born tech enthusiast, and the flashlights he makes can reveal the ghostly figures that are originally shrouded in mist. The wick is wrapped with special electromagnetic coils, and when the switch is pressed, it releases a faint light that resonates with the frequency of obsessive thoughts. This light burns away the restless thoughts like the holy light of the divine in the Bible.   Main content: - Player 1 and Player 2 cooperate, with two distinct and characteristic protagonists. - Mysterious and dark labyrinth map. - 9 different forms of terrifying and eerie enemies that may scare you.

Name: Ragtag Heroes : CO-OP Deckbuilder
Supported languages: Ragtag Heroes is a co-op roguelike deckbuilder for up to 3 players. The realm's champion has been defeated. Now it's up to a team of ragtag heroes to save the world! Rally your party from a growing roster of diverse heroes, craft powerful decks, and control the flow of battle as you face corrupted worlds that change every run! With new synergies, challenges, and surprises each time, no two adventures are ever alike. ALTERNATE ACTS & CORRUPTED WORLDS No two journeys are the same. Each run randomizes the order of worlds, so one adventure might begin in the Forest while the next throws you straight into the Desert. Furthermore: The deeper you go, the more each world becomes twisted by Madrok’s growing corruption. Even better: there are more worlds than acts in a single run. You’ll never see everything at once - and every playthrough offers new challenges, enemies, and surprises waiting to be uncovered. CONTROL THE BATTLEFIELD Push attacking monsters away from weakened heroes and bring your melee attackers in close range to deliver deadly blows. Lock monsters in place or punish them for moving around - but watch out as they might do the same to you! CREATE SYNERGIES ACROSS DECKS Each hero has their own strengths and weaknesses and allows for a variety of strategies in building their deck. They also synergize differently with other heroes from the roster - so by switching team mates you can explore different team tactics each run. CONTROL THE TURNORDER Initiative determines the order of turns in combat. Strategically lowering your opponents' initiative allows your heroes to act sooner. You may even concentrate your efforts on reducing one enemy's initiative to zero to stun them, forcing them to skip a turn. MASTER YOUR ENERGY GAME Brave and Default add an extra layer to your strategy. “Brave” will grant you more energy (action points) for your current turn, but you will become stunned and will have to pass the next one. Or 'Default' your turn without performing any actions and you'll increase your hero’s energy (action points) by 1 for the remaining battle. LAUNCH CONTENT 7+ heroes with their own set of cards and relics 500+ different cards 100+ items to be found 4+ different worlds you encounter in different stages of corruption 300+ unique combat encounters 60+ mysterious story encounters co-op multiplayer both locally and online with up to 3 players

Name: HYPERVOX
Supported languages: HYPERVOX is a music video game where players perform the vocal melody of songs. The game uses 12 keys corresponding to each musical note (C through B), with each key having its own dedicated lane. When notes reach the judgement line, press the corresponding key to hit the note and recreate the vocal melody in real-time. Aim for the highest score possible by hitting each note with precise timing and accuracy. Controls The game uses 12 normal keys and 2 octave keys for gameplay. Each lane corresponds to one normal key, which are assigned by default to: Z, S, X, D, C, V, G, B, H, N, J, M. There are two octave keys in the game: octave up and octave down . By default, the octave up key is mapped to the Left Shift, and the octave down key is mapped to Spacebar. All keys can be freely customized or reset to defaults in the settings menu. MIDI keyboards are also supported. The 12 keys from C to B on your MIDI keyboard correspond to the 12 normal keys, regardless of which octave you play in. Tilting the pitch wheel up activates octave up , and tilting it down activates octave down . How to Play HYPERVOX features two types of notes: standard notes and octave notes. Standard notes work like long notes in typical rhythm games — simply press and hold the corresponding lane key with proper timing to play the note. These notes appear in white or blue depending on the lane. To play them: Press the corresponding lane key when the note reaches the start point. Hold the key through the note's duration, then release it when the note ends. Octave notes require a different technique. Unlike standard notes, you must first hold the octave key, then use the lane key to actually play the note. To play them: First, press and hold the octave key. Then, press the lane key when the note reaches the judgement line. Release the lane key when the note ends, matching the timing precisely. Octave up notes are displayed in red, while octave down notes are displayed in green. When Colorblind Mode is enabled, octave up notes will be displayed in magenta, and octave down notes will be displayed in cyan . Judgement System In HYPERVOX, your timing accuracy is evaluated with five different judgement levels. Each judgement reflects how close your button press or release was to the perfect timing. Precise The highest level of accuracy. You've hit the note with perfect timing, within ±50 milliseconds of the target. This judgement awards maximum points and maintains your combo. Great Excellent timing that's slightly off from perfect, within ±50-100 milliseconds. You'll receive high points and your combo continues. Fair Acceptable timing that's noticeably off but still within the rhythm, within ±100-150 milliseconds. You'll earn moderate points and maintain your combo, though with reduced scoring. Close Your timing is significantly off, within ±150-300 milliseconds of the target. This results in minimal points but still maintains your combo streak. Break You've either missed the note entirely or your timing was too far off (beyond ±300 milliseconds). This judgement breaks your combo, resetting it to zero, and awards no points. Speed Control If you feel the notes pass too fast or too slow, you can adjust their scroll speed using F1 to decrease speed and F2 to increase speed by default. This only changes the visual speed of the notes — the actual timing for hitting notes remains unchanged. The speed control keys can also be customized in the settings menu. Creating Song Data To create a track data for HYPERVOX, follow these steps in the CREATE menu: 1 . First, select the vocal and instrumental audio files. The recommended audio format is 44.1kHz/16bit WAV. Both audio files must have matching sampling frequencies for proper playback. 2 . Select a MIDI file containing a single vocal track that matches the vocal audio. Harmonies are not supported. If you don't have a MIDI file, you can use AI to convert the vocal audio to MIDI. However, this is an experimental feature and conversion quality may decrease with longer songs (1m30s or longer). When using AI-generated MIDI files, some long notes may be split into multiple segments. In this case, apply the option to merge consecutive notes of the same pitch. 3 . Finally, enter the chart information. For proper playback, you must input all information including accurate BPM. Album cover and background video are optional. If including a video, MP4 is recommended for Windows, while WebM with VP8 codec is recommended for other platforms. Once the chart is successfully created, you can check it in the game's TRACKS menu.

Name: Goose Evolution
Supported languages: 🎮 Game Introduction Goose Evolution is a lighthearted, tower-defense-style game where geese battle geese. You will lead a brave flock, starting from the Stone Age and progressing through the Farm Era, Spartan Era, Renaissance, Modern Age, all the way to the Space Age! But that’s not the end—the game also includes a parallel universe mechanic ! You can jump into 16 distinct parallel worlds , including Egypt, the Three Kingdoms, Wild West, Barbarian, Viking, and Robot eras, experiencing 108 unique civilizations and unit types . Love strategy, history, or time travel? This is a civilization journey led by geese—and you’re in command. ✨ Core Features 🌍 Era Evolution + Parallel World Travel Advance from primitive societies all the way to futuristic space—each era introduces unique enemies and challenges. Unlock 16 parallel worlds , each with its own civilization and exclusive units: Egyptian chariots, Three Kingdoms generals, cowboys, Viking warriors, and more. ⚔️ Rich Unit System Each civilization features three unit types: 🛡️ Melee Units – A solid frontline, adept at blocking enemy advances. 🏹 Ranged Units – Core damage dealers, striking safely from a distance. ⚡ Super Units – The ultimate force of each civilization, possessing powerful abilities that can turn the tide of battle. 🏰 Base Building & Resource Management Deploying units consumes Food —increasing food production is essential. Strengthen your base’s HP to withstand enemy assaults and buy more time for your flock to grow. 🃏 Card Collection System Defeat enemies in battle to earn Diamonds , used to draw ability cards. Collect cards inspired by history and fantasy: Leonardo da Vinci, Aristotle, Alexander the Great, Napoleon, Einstein… even Mammoths and Tyrannosaurus Rex ! ⚡ Skill & Talent System Skills : Equip up to 3 active skills per battle—use them wisely to reverse the tide. Talents : Defeated enemies have a chance to drop Talent Potions , which are used to unlock nodes in the talent tree and permanently enhance your geese. 🕹️ Gameplay Loop Deploy Your Flock – Train melee, ranged, and super units, and position them strategically. Manage Resources – Boost food output and fortify your base for long-term survival. Control the Battle – Use skills, draw cards, and activate talents to handle waves of enemies. Evolve & Travel – After conquering an era, advance to a new civilization or jump to another timeline! 🕶️ Perfect for You If… ✅ You enjoy tower defense + light strategy and love planning and progression. ✅ You’re fascinated by multiple civilizations, historical settings, and fantasy themes . ✅ You prefer casual, lighthearted games with cute art styles . ✅ You like replayability, collection, and experimenting with different builds . 🚀 Final Words Goose Evolution is more than a tower defense game—it’s an epic journey of geese civilization across time and space. Here, you can lead your flock from stone spears to laser beams, from grasslands to the stars, from history into legend. 16 parallel worlds, 108 civilizations— Your command will decide how far these geese can go. Goose Evolution—Your Era Awaits. Name: Radiance of Souls
Supported languages: The death of her parents was only the beginning of the nightmare. Elena arrives at the remote island station “AURA” on her yacht. In her bag are death certificates, and in her heart is the hope of finding support from the only person close to her, her brother Ilya. But the island greets her only with the hum of generators and an icy wind. Ilya is somewhere here. He hears her. He leaves her notes. But with each new discovery, his explanations become stranger and stranger, and the reasons why he cannot come out into the light become more and more frightening. You will: Follow a trail of paper letters: Ilya leads you deeper into the station, finding new excuses not to show himself. Explore the station at night: Walk through rusty laboratories and living quarters, where every creak makes you turn around. Uncover the secret of AURA: What caused the staff to rush out of their posts, and why is your brother so afraid to touch the door handle? He's very close. He sees everything. But are you ready to see what he has become? The game is waiting for you A large number of interesting riddles exciting story. You will not fully know what is happening in the game and only the ending will give you accurate answers. Only at the end will all the pieces of the plot come together into one whole Move away objects that you can hit or fall on, because the game contains very clever jump scares that will scare you so that your chair will fall out from under you
Average playtime forever: There is no critical violence in the game. All that is related to this is blood and models of dead creatures.

Name: United by a Fairy Tale
Supported languages: Once upon a time, a princess was imprisoned in the highest tower by her evil stepmother, waiting to be rescued by her prince. But instead, an elf appears! The girls decide to escape the tower together, and you must help them! Features: Clear 50 frantic, time-limited levels that will put your reflexes, two-handed dexterity, and speed to the test in this 2D action game with dual controls and vertically scrolling stages. Start each level, control one character with each hand, prove your skill by overcoming different obstacles simultaneously within a time limit, and climb the tower to escape it. More mechanics will be added over time, making each level even more frantic. Do you have what it takes to rescue the princess? Dynamic difficulty. Not up to the challenge? Poor thing. Don’t worry—play on “Easy” and there will be no time limit. Get used to the game and go at your own pace; after all, it’s about enjoying it. Or, if you’re truly looking for a real challenge, play on “Hard.” One single mistake and you’ll be sent back to level 1. I haven’t even beaten it on this difficulty myself! Sexual content. Rescue the princess and you’ll enjoy a well-crafted, unhurried epilogue that delves into the girls’ relationship, along with narrated sex illustrations drawn by a great artist. The perfect climax for the story. In more than one sense—if you know what I mean...
Average playtime forever: The sexual content is located at the end of the game, after completing all levels, and consists of a series of narrated sexual scenes accompanied by illustrations drawn by an artist.

Name: Riches In the Deep
Supported languages: Riches in the Deep is an addictive 2D clicker game that takes you on an exciting journey of gold mining and wealth-building. As a mine operator, your task is simple: dig for gold, earn money, and grow your fortune. From a small shop to massive enterprises, you can establish a variety of businesses to multiply your wealth. As you progress, use the money you earn to unlock new opportunities and expand your empire by creating more businesses. Make strategic decisions to complete missions and reach the end of the game. The combination of gold mining, entrepreneurship, and strategic growth creates an incredibly satisfying and addictive gameplay loop. Will you succeed on your path to riches? The adventure awaits!

Name: Road Less Traveled
Supported languages: True Survival Horror – No Second Chances Your objective is simple: survive long enough to reach the end of the road and escape the forest alive. To do that, you must move from campsite to campsite, pushing deeper into increasingly dangerous territory while managing hunger, sleep, fuel, sanity, and resources. Every day is a calculated risk: explore new regions for better loot, or play it safe and conserve supplies. At night, visibility drops, monsters roam, and the Maintenance Man forces you forward — you can’t return to old camps, and you can’t outrun him forever. One wrong turn off a cliff, one poorly timed fight, one mismanaged resource, and your entire run is gone. You cannot turn back — the road only goes forward. Every stop is temporary. Every night is a test. Every decision determines whether your run continues or ends permanently. Features Looting & Crafting System  –Scavenge abandoned camps, broken vehicles, and forgotten trails for materials to craft essential survival gear. Build weapons to defend yourself, reinforce armor to withstand attacks, and assemble camping equipment like tents, traps, and portable light sources. Every item crafted could mean the difference between surviving the night… or becoming part of the forest. Open-World RV Exploration – Your RV is your only sanctuary. Drive freely across the vast forest, discover new regions, and use it as mobile storage and a temporary safe haven. Upgrade storage capacity, reinforce defenses, and customize it to support your survival strategy. But remember — safety is never permanent. Dynamic Weather + Day/Night Cycle – Extremely Limited daylight offers a small window to gather supplies, hunt, and prepare. When darkness falls, visibility drops, creatures grow bolder, and paranoia sets in. The forest changes at night — new threats emerge, and familiar paths become deadly. Permadeath with Persistence – Save during your run, but death resets everything. Lose your gear, your progress, and the path you carved through the forest. However, knowledge carries forward — each attempt reveals more about the world, its patterns, and the horrors stalking you. Secrets of the Forest –Explore deep woods, hidden camps, cryptid lairs, and abandoned structures scattered across the map. Uncover environmental storytelling, disturbing clues, and the truth behind the man who stalks you through the night. Some secrets reward you. Others should never be found.

We've once again taken the iconic memes of that era—the very ones that have endured for years and still evoke a smile of recognition—and brought them to life in a claymation style. All the same volumetric, textured, warm magic. The main feature remains the same: all the images are pure plasticine, no pixels or compressed JPGs from the past. Characters and scenes from our childhood/youth are now three-dimensional, cozy, and incredibly lifelike. WHAT AWAITS YOU IN THIS PART: Unique visuals 2.0: even richer, more detailed plasticine graphics—every meme has become funnier and more heartfelt. Pro-level nostalgia questions: from ancient viral videos on a slipper to phrases we yelled during recess, in the smoking room, and on ICQ at 3 AM. Discover your true level: the ranking system will mercilessly reveal whether you're still a Noob who only discovered the internet yesterday, or already a Legend who personally witnessed the birth of Zhdun and Upyachka. That same atmosphere: minimalist game interface design, sounds from the past, and not a drop of modern fluff. Just tried-and-true classics: the kind of humor we truly grew up with. This second installment is another ticket back to a time when the internet was slow but sincere, the grass was greener, and the best jokes lived forever. Let's go revel in nostalgia again? Name: Edgar Allan Poe's Interactive Horror: 1995 Edition
Supported languages: Edgar Allan Poe’s Interactive Horror: 1995 Edition is the faithful restoration of the cult classic originally known as The Dark Eye. Developed by the legendary multimedia studio Inscape , this surreal first-person point-and-click horror adventure broke new ground in 1995 with its nightmare-fuel combination of stop-motion animation , video collage , and psychologically disturbing storytelling . Step into the fragmented minds of both victims and perpetrators as you relive Poe's most twisted tales: The Tell-Tale Heart , The Cask of Amontillado , and Berenice . Featuring narration by the iconic Beat writer William S. Burroughs and an uncanny visual aesthetic, the game explores madness, obsession, and guilt in a way few titles have dared to since. Gameplay in Interactive Horror revolves around narrative-driven exploration , environmental interaction , and perspective-shifting storylines . You’ll click through surreal environments , examine symbolic objects , and trigger cutscenes and monologues that reveal each character’s descent into madness. Some sequences require solving light contextual puzzles , but the true horror lies in the psychological unraveling, not in combat or traditional challenge. Now available again for the first time in decades, this re-release preserves the authentic original experience , optimized for modern systems. Key Features Three Classic Tales: Fully interactive adaptations of The Tell-Tale Heart , The Cask of Amontillado , and Berenice , woven together by an original framing narrative. The Original 1995 Experience: This is an authentic re-release of the CD-ROM classic, preserving the original aspect ratio, distinct 'multimedia' interface, and unpolished, raw aesthetic. Dual Perspectives: Play through the stories as both the murderer and the victim to uncover the full scope of the tragedy. Star-Studded Audio: Featuring the haunting voice of William S. Burroughs and an atmospheric score by Thomas Dolby . Surreal Visuals: A disturbing mix of claymation (puppetry), live-action video, and architectural renders that defined the experimental era of 90s gaming.

Name: Jump To Success
Supported languages: In Jump To Success, you’ll tackle handcrafted levels across multiple planets, each featuring distinct gravity, momentum, and physics rules. Your mission is simple: reach the goal using timing, precision, and adaptability. With no enemies to fight, the entire challenge comes from mastering movement in constantly changing worlds.

Name: Hungry Chicks - Battle Farm
Supported languages: Welcome to Hungry Chicks – Battle Farm ! The peace on your farm is over – hungry enemies are after your food! But your chicks won’t give up without a fight: starting from the barn, they charge into battle, wave after wave, pushing forward until they reach the enemy’s farm. Your barn is your only tower – and everything depends on how cleverly you choose, upgrade, and support your units. Face ever-stronger enemies and their generals in thrilling boss battles. With every victory your chicks gain experience, level up, and unlock new abilities. Healing items, power-ups, and clever upgrades will help you hold the line – until your army becomes unstoppable and no foe can resist. Hungry Chicks – Battle Farm combines elements of tower defense, action, and strategy into a unique gameplay experience: assemble your troops, use their special abilities, and lead your chicks to victory over the enemy’s base. Fight with unique chicken units: Stable Guard: Defends your barn and hurls explosive egg bombs. Ninja: Fast melee fighters with swords who push the front line forward. Grenadier: Ranged fighters with multi-shot eggs, keeping enemies at a distance. Knight: Tough shield bearers that protect your troops from heavy attacks. Balloon: Bombards enemies from above and drops healing eggs to refresh your army. Sorcerer: Unleashes firestorms and makes defeated enemies explode spectacularly. Dive into a unique world: Send your chicks from the barn and conquer the enemy’s base. Experience lovingly drawn comic-style graphics full of details and funny animations. Don’t be fooled by the rural idyll of mountains, windmills, and straw bales – the enemy knows no mercy! Fight through numerous levels with ever-new challenges. Features: 🎮 6 unique classes with their own skills and abilities. 🐔 Dynamic units : your chicks rush forward on their own – no static placement! 🌟 Cartoon graphics with explosions, talking chickens, and charming effects. 🛡️ Strategic gameplay : choose your troops, upgrade them, and adapt to your opponent. 🔥 Boss battles against enemy generals. ⚡ Physics-based combat with moving units and objects. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly – suitable for all ages, yet challenging to master. 🇩🇪 Made in Germany – fun, strategy, and humor in one package.

Name: Dystopian Pet Simulator
Supported languages: You are a terminal operator working in a grim, dystopian industrial wasteland where mutated creatures are worth more alive than dead. Your job is simple and dirty: track the target, throw a net, and deliver the capture to your personal terminal. Every creature generates passive income and experience . The rarer the creature, the faster your economy grows. You don’t kill creatures - you exploit them . Captured mutants become assets that power your terminal, unlock new upgrades, and open the path to advanced evolutions. Combine pets, experiment with mutations, and increase their market value. The deeper you go, the more valuable the capture… Enter the zone solo or team up with up to 4 players in co-op . Work together, split the risks - or compete for the most valuable captures. Terminal upgrades expand your capabilities: Increased storage capacity and efficiency Enhanced mobility and jump upgrades Faster and stronger passive economy growth The stronger your terminal becomes, the more control you gain over the zone. KEY FEATURES Co-op for up to 4 players  with lobbies and quick start Rarity-based economy  - rarer creatures mean higher profit Upgrades and evolutions  - combine pets to unlock new forms and increase value

Name: Backrooms: Poolrooms
Supported languages: Backrooms: Poolrooms ...  The Poolrooms hold secrets that should never be uncovered...   Strange deaths are plaguing the Poolrooms, and now it's your turn to investigate the horrifying mystery. Bodies have been found floating in the endless, dimly lit pools, their faces twisted in terror. The Poolrooms are no ordinary place - something dark and deadly has taken root, and it's not alone.    Strange entities have infiltrated the area, stalking you through the water-soaked halls. But they are not like any creature you’ve ever encountered. These entities are invisible, only detectable by the faintest splash they leave behind. As you search for the required things scattered throughout this nightmarish maze, you must be careful, as every step could reveal your position. But it’s not just the entities you need to watch out for. The waters are teeming with fish, their movements sending ripples through the pool and alerting nearby horrors to your presence. Every splash could be the last sound you ever hear. If you’re too careless, your position will be compromised, and the deadly entities will be upon you. Key Features: Investigate the Poolrooms: Explore an eerie, endless labyrinth of pools, flooded hallways, and chilling environments filled with mystery and danger. Invisible Entities: The creatures haunting the Poolrooms are invisible to the naked eye. Track them by their splashes and keep a careful watch on your surroundings. Dangerous Fish: Watch out for fish lurking in the water - their splashes will give away your position, making you vulnerable to the entities hunting you. Tension-filled Atmosphere: A nerve-wracking sound design keeps you on edge, amplifying every footstep, splash, and movement in the darkness. Can you survive the horrors lurking in the Poolrooms, or will you become another lost soul drifting beneath the surface? Time is running out... and the waters are rising.

Name: Orders, Captain!
Supported languages: DISCLAIMER : the game may feature some 'tomfoolery'... Waiting for your orders, Captain! Orders, Captain! is a voice-controlled game about yelling at six barely competent crew members while enemy ships close in from every side. As the captain of a tiny cannon ship, your only hope is your microphone: call your crew by name, bark orders to load and fire the cannons, and try to keep your nerves as the sea turns into chaos. Call your crew : Call your crew members by their names, they are at your service at all times. After all, you are the captain... Command your crew: Once you’ve called their names, your crew members wait for your next words. Tell them to load the cannon, fire it or to cancel the order — just remember: an unloaded cannon is a useless cannon. Take down enemy ships:  Command your crew carefully to blast incoming ships before they tear your hull apart. Miss your shots or panic at the wrong time, and you’ll be the one sinking. the game features a singleplayer PVE mode where you try to survive as much as you can and a multiplayer PVP up to 4 player free-for-all battle royale where each player has its own ship and crew to command. there's online matchmaking so you can join random lobbies or you can also create private matches and invite your friends, remember: a good captain sinks with his ship! also there's rum and dynamite and dry biscuits

Name: Lightsaver
Supported languages: Lightsaver is a free-to-play, single-player 2D physics puzzle game about guiding a beam of light to its destination. Rotate your launcher, read the angles, and shape the path with placeable optical objects—then watch the beam split, bend, and bounce its way to the glowing door. Each level is a compact challenge built around satisfying “aha!” moments: a clean shot that becomes possible only after one perfect refraction through water, one precise bend through glass, or one last reflection off a mirror. Key Features Rotate and aim the light launcher to set your initial trajectory Place optical objects like water cubes/balls, glass cubes/balls, and mirrors Rotate and resize objects to fine-tune angles and beam paths Refraction + reflection-driven puzzles that reward experimentation and precision Handcrafted progression that gradually teaches new interactions and harder setups

Name: SEWERCIDE
Supported languages: You wake up trapped inside an isolated bunker connected to an old sewer system. Something lurks in the darkness something that hungers for you. You only have a few days to gather supplies, solve small environmental puzzles, and find a way out before it discovers your location. Explore the abandoned tunnels, search every room, and uncover the truth about what happened beneath the surface. Every step makes noise, every loud sound can alert the creature, and every mistake brings it closer. Search every room, gather what you can, and solve environmental puzzles while avoiding the creature hunting through the sewer. Noise attracts the creature. Dropping objects could reveal exactly where you are. Every sound echoes through the tunnels. Every careless move brings “it” closer. Once it knows your location, you won’t have long. Stay calm. Think ahead. Silence is your only protection. It's always listening. always searching. It hungers for you. It WANT you. A noise, a single wrong move that’s all it needs to turn composure into fear. You WILL see it coming. You can hear it. croaking, in the dark. Scraping claws against concrete… Chasing you relentlessly until It gets you. Hide. Hold your breath if you must. Features: First-person survival horror experience Time-limited escape system: survive for several days while searching for key items Inventory-based interaction: pick up, drop, and throw objects Atmospheric sewer environment with tension-focused gameplay A lurking creature that reacts to your actions Explore interconnected areas beneath the surface Different outcomes await those who survive Uncover what happened down here... piece by piece Will you escape the bunker, or be dragged into the darkness?

Name: MeltyFlow: A Cozy Desktop Lava Lamp
Supported languages: MeltyFlow. Your Personal Lava Lamp MeltyFlow places a softly glowing lava lamp on your desktop. Warm liquid drifts upward, stretches, and slowly settles again. The motion feels unhurried. The light feels warm and steady. A small corner of your screen becomes a quiet, living space. You are not just watching it. You can reach in and touch the flow. Push the glowing blobs aside. Watch them bend, merge, and slowly find their balance again. It feels playful and grounding. Like a calm, tactile fidget made of light. It is not a tool or a toy. It is a personal object. A small moment of calm that stays with you. Make It Yours MeltyFlow includes 19 unique lamp designs and over 40 unlockable, carefully crafted presets . Each one carries its own mood and atmosphere. Some feel familiar and warm. Others feel unusual and dreamlike. From there, everything opens up. Shift the colors. Soften or intensify the glow. Change the lamp shape and the wax style. Shape something cozy and nostalgic, or something strange and magical. Save your creations. Build a growing collection of lamps that feel unmistakably yours. Some designs deserve an audience. Share your favorite lamps with friends . Show off the glow you dialed in just right. Trade ideas, moods, and styles, and see how the same lamp can feel different in another space. A Companion for Quiet Moments MeltyFlow settles naturally into your day. It glows beside you while you work. It keeps you company late at night. It rests on a second screen, quietly moving. It gives your hands something gentle to interact with when your thoughts need a pause. Sometimes you let it flow on its own. Sometimes you give it a small nudge and watch it slowly settle again. Calm by Design MeltyFlow runs smoothly and quietly. Nothing competes for your attention. Nothing pushes or rushes you. It is there when you notice it - and peaceful when you do not. When you need a little structure Use the built-in timer with intervals of 20, 10, 5, or 2 minutes to guide focus sessions or short breaks. Keep small notes and reminders in the integrated to-do list, so your tasks stay close without pulling you out of the calm. Let It Melt. Let It Flow. Create your lamp. Shape the glow. Make it yours.

Supported languages: Balls vs. Tombs is a dark fantasy action-survival game built around a single, haunting purpose: to reclaim stolen souls and restore peace to a desecrated graveyard. Once, the cemetery was a place of rest. A sacred ground where spirits slept quietly beneath stone and soil. That balance was shattered when four colossal abominations emerged from the depths, corrupting the land and absorbing every soul bound to the graves. As the spirits were torn from their resting places, the monsters grew stronger, warping the cemetery into a battlefield of rage, decay, and despair. You are one of the few who can fight back. CORE GAMEPLAY At its heart, Balls vs. Tombs is a fast-paced combat experience where precision, positioning, and elemental mastery matter. You fight by launching powerful orbs—your primary weapons against waves of enraged spirits and corrupted entities. The core loop is simple but deep: Defeat corrupted enemies Recover their trapped souls Return souls to restored graves Expand and cleanse the cemetery Unlock new characters, powers, and combinations Each reclaimed grave brings the world closer to balance—and brings you closer to confronting the true source of the corruption. ELEMENTAL CHARACTERS & ORBS Beyond the basic orb, the game features four unlockable characters, each bound to a unique elemental sphere: Water Orb – fluid control, slowing enemies and shaping the battlefield Air Orb – speed, mobility, and precision strikes Poison Orb – damage over time, area corruption, and attrition Fire Orb – raw power, explosive impact, and aggressive play Each character fundamentally changes how the game feels, encouraging experimentation and mastery. FUSION SYSTEM – THE HEART OF POWER What truly sets Balls vs. Tombs apart is its Orb Fusion System. Every elemental orb can be fused with every other orb. Water + Fire Air + Poison Fire + Air Poison + Water …and every possible combination in between. Each fusion creates a new, more powerful hybrid orb with unique behaviors, visuals, and combat effects. Some fusions focus on crowd control, others on burst damage, chain reactions, or battlefield dominance. This system turns combat into a strategic sandbox, rewarding creativity and experimentation. The more you understand the elements, the more devastating your builds become. THE CEMETERY AS PROGRESSION There is no traditional level select. The graveyard itself is your progression system. As you rescue souls and rebuild graves: New cemetery zones unlock Stronger enemy types begin to appear New characters and orb types become available The world visually transforms from corruption to sanctified ground What feels like an open, evolving environment is actually a carefully structured progression arc—a living level system disguised as world restoration. BOSSES & NARRATIVE The four great monsters are not random enemies. Each represents a twisted force that feeds on unrest and unfinished souls. As they absorb spirits, they grow in size, power, and presence—something reflected both in gameplay and cinematic moments. THE GOAL This is not just about surviving waves. It’s about bringing peace back to the dead. Every soul you recover matters. Every grave you restore reshapes the world. Every fusion you master brings you closer to ending the corruption. Welcome to Balls vs. Tombs. The dead are waiting.

Supported languages: Welcome to a retro-styled, arcade-inspired 2.5D helicopter game! The base was managed by a SUPERCOMPUTER, but it too has malfunctioned. That’s where you come in - manual intervention is now the only option. You recover cyber-miners and harness their processing power to reclaim the Supercomputer’s resources. Step by step, you regain control over CPU, RAM, and HDD. But something feels off. It almost seems like the Supercomputer itself is obstructing your rescue mission. You’ll have to deal with that — before it restores its full capacity and locks you out completely. To make matters worse, secondary explosions from damaged reactors are expected in 407 minutes . You’ll need more than flying skills. Sometimes you’ll have to experiment and locate the right trigger to access specific areas. By hacking the Supercomputer, you can make navigation easier, slowing down or disabling malfunctioning machinery. This is a two-layer challenge: strategically allocate CPU, RAM, and HDD resources, and demonstrate precision piloting to survive the chaos. Time is limited. The system is unstable. Act fast. PICKING UP PEOPLE IS JUST THE BEGINNING Once you’ve picked up your passengers, the real challenge begins. You’ll need to navigate carefully and deliver them safely to the heliport. Treat ‘em like people, not produce! Only after successfully landing will your score increase, allowing you to make progress toward your goal.  BEWARE OF OBSTACLES Test your skills by navigating through increasingly tricky obstacles. With limited fuel, you’ll need to think fast and act even faster to avoid crashing and reach your destination in time! FLIGHT SAFELY Air acrobatics might seem fun, but don’t forget your passengers are not strapped in! Too much wild maneuvering could send them flying out of the helicopter. Also, remember that landing softly is just as important as flying—crashing to the ground might not only endanger the passengers but could lead to serious injuries or even death. SIMPLE RULES, CHALLENGING FUN Navigate the helicopter with precision. Search for and collect people who are waiting for transport. Safely bring them to the heliport. Avoid reckless flying—passengers aren’t strapped in and could fall out. Steer clear of hard landings—rough touchdowns can cause concussions and injuries to your passengers. Be quick and efficient—your fuel is limited! Puzels included - use designated spots to unlock access to closed areas.  FLIGHT DECK  IS YOUR TRUSTY COMPANION The flight deck consists of five gauges, all of which play a crucial role in the game. While you’ll need to split your focus between navigation and monitoring the gauges, that’s just part of the gameplay! 1st Gauge: Altimeter This shows how high you can go without losing drift. For nerds only: The upper number displays the helicopter’s airspeed. The lower number shows the vertical airspeed. 2nd Gauge: X-RAY Level  removed in demo v 2.0 X-RAY ability allows you to see the helicopter's silhouette - as well as people and fuel barrels - through obstacles. Activation is automatic and ther is no limit for use of X-RAY (no need to recharge). 2rd Gauge: Level Indicator This gauge helps you navigate in a TOP view mode; no need to use it in SIDE view mode. For nerds: The upper number is a See Level Altimeter  The lower nuber is Above Ground Level (AGL) altimeter 3th Gauge: Total mass  Your mass increases as you pick up more passengers or take on more fuel. So keep that in mind since you mass affects your movement in the air. The lighter you are, the faster you go! If you are too heavy, simply leave passengers on the ground - you will return to them after a while. Also, consider not taking every pass e nger at once; maybe two rounds are a better idea? 4th Gauge: Fuel Level Indicator Your remaining fuel is displayed on-screen, and the helicopter itself turns red when fuel is low - along with the corresponding HUD label. For nerds only: The number at the top shows the current fuel consumption. The number at the bottom shows the helicopter's weight. RADAR - yet another Gauge at top, right screen White dots – Heliports Velvet dots – People waiting to be rescued Blue dots – Fuel barrels The number in the center shows how many people are nearby waiting for rescue. Since this is a 2.5D game , the radar works as follows: Your helicopter is always at the center. Dots above you represent objects at a higher altitude. Dots to the right indicate objects positioned to your right, and so on. PUZZLES IN THE GAME + PHYSICS SIMULATION = Retro with a Modern Twist You'll encounter special buttons that move parts of the environment-essentially opening restricted areas, much like doors in real life. You can drop people off and pick them up again later. If you do this on a designated spot, doors to an otherwise inaccessible location will open. This mechanic allows you to gather more people - all while managing the pressure of burning fuel. You'll have to act fast and think strategically - a mix of arcade gameplay and puzzles that you’re bound to enjoy! This is what we mean by 'retro with a modern twist'. OBSTACLES, SHADOWS, AND SPOTLIGHT! Watch your altitude—flying too high will cause your helicopter to lose lift and descend rapidly. Be on the lookout for obstacles that might appear out of nowhere—some are hidden in the dark, so keep your spotlight on to spot them in time! Certain obstacles require you to rely on your helicopter's subtle leaning indications for safe navigation. It might initially feel confusing, but don’t worry—you’ll get the hang of it. If not you, then who else? LEVELS ARE NOT WHAT THEY SEEM Don’t get too comfortable with your memory! Although levels might seem similar initially, they can change subtly or dramatically. So even if you think you know where the passengers are, you might be in for a surprise. Always stay alert and adapt! NO SHOOTING, BUT PLENTY OF ADRENALINE While this game doesn’t feature any shooting or combat, the tension is real. The abstract environment, crazy perspectives, shifting obstacles, and ever-present shadows create a thrilling atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat. SPEED RUN GAMEPLAY - INCLUDED! You can switch to SPEED RUN mode and challenge yourself to beat the best level time. Thanks to this, you can turn the game into a race, competing with friends and challenging each other at any level! DEMO restriction: you can play SPEED RUN mode only on two levels. MY LITTLE HELP FOR GAMERS ;-) In case of an  out-of-fuel situation - you can PAUSE the game and move to MAIN MENU - you will not ruin your scores. Then you can restart the level without losing points. You can also do this in any other situation ;-) FULL GAME VERSION, NOT A DEMO The demo is already quite big – if you want to try it before buying, you definitely should! After all, it’s not a small purchase. ;-) In TIME TRIAL mode, I especially recommend RESCUE10 and RESCUE2 – tons of fun with friends! The full version will include a LEADERBOARD , so you can compare your scores with players from all over the world! But if you're drawn to the adventures in this abstract world, the full game has even more fast-paced levels for SPEEDRUN mode, more challenges requiring precise navigation, and new gameplay mechanics constantly being added—like wind effects, helicopter damage, and more hidden/interconnected spaces through portals . You'll also be able to earn ACHIEVEMENTS to show off to your friends! ;-) Plus, new helicopters will be available for you to unlock using the stars you collect from each level. So don’t just go for the minimum number of rescued people— the more, the better for you! Your stars will be your currency (I hate microtransactions!), which you can exchange for new helicopter models. Is it worth waiting for the full version? Absolutely!

Supported languages: Experience three stories that each examine unique concepts and themes through different game-play mediums. Sato is a classic turn-based Role-Playing-Game that explores the concepts of temperance, beliefs, and spirituality. & is a Virtual-Novel  that explores how connections and relationships interlink, building bridges to new worlds and realities. These stories connect and create a larger overarching meditation on life. Experience the various different ways of expression, communication and story telling possible through art.  'The history of games dates to the ancient human past. Games are an integral part of all cultures and are one of the oldest forms of human social interaction. Games are formalized expressions of play which allow people to go beyond immediate imagination and direct physical activity. Common features of games include uncertainty of outcome, agreed upon rules, competition, separate place and time, elements of fiction, elements of chance, prescribed goals and personal enjoyment. Games capture the ideas and worldviews of their cultures and pass them on to the future generation. Games were important as cultural and social bonding events, as teaching tools and as markers of social status. As pastimes of royalty and the elite, some games became common features of court culture and were also given as gifts. Games such as Senet and the Mesoamerican ball game were often imbued with mythic and ritual religious significance. Games like Gyan chauper and The Mansion of Happiness were used to teach spiritual and ethical lessons while Shatranj and Wéiqí (Go) were seen as a way to develop strategic thinking and mental skill by the political and military elite. In his 1938 book, Homo Ludens, Dutch cultural historian Johan Huizinga argued that games were a primary condition of the generation of human cultures. Huizinga saw the playing of games as something that 'is older than culture, for culture, however inadequately defined, always presupposes human society, and animals have not waited for man to teach them their playing'. Huizinga saw games as a starting point for complex human activities such as language, law, war, philosophy and art. '

Name: SCP – Containment Breach
Supported languages: SCP - Containment Breach is a free survival horror game written in Blitz3D. The events of the game take place in a containment site of The SCP Foundation, a secret organization dedicated to containing and researching anomalous artifacts and entities that threaten the normality of the world. You're thrown into the boots of a Class D test subject, one of the Foundation's disposable human guinea pigs. Not long after receiving your first assignment, the facility undergoes a massive containment breach, leaving you alone in the darkness with the escaped entities roaming around the facility. Your goal is to make it out alive. You can also search the facility for documents and other clues to figure out what led to the breach, and even attempt to do your part in fixing the situation. The main antagonist of the game is SCP-173, an animate concrete sculpture that kills all living things on sight, moving toward its victims at a speed of several feet in one blink of an eye and snapping their necks with irresistible strength and lethal precision. Fortunately, SCP-173 has one key weakness: it is frozen in place as long as someone is looking at it. To make things more interesting, SCP - Containment Breach has a blinking mechanic that forces the character to blink regularly (which often has fatal consequences in the vicinity of SCP-173). One of the key elements of the game is the procedurally generated map - no playthrough is the same, and you can never know for sure what is going to happen next. There are plenty of obstacles to make the way out of the facility less pleasant. Decontamination gas that makes you blink faster, locked doors that require a key card with a sufficient security clearance or a specific access code to open, timer switch controlled doors, and of course, several escaped SCPs. Escape the SCP Foundation as a Class D in this free survival horror. Outrun SCP-173—a killer statue that strikes when you blink. Every run is unpredictable. Survive or die trying. Made with ❤️ by a group of dedicated fans, this release is filled to the brim with community-created fixes, quality of life improvements and extensive Steam integration. Support for DirectX 9 allows the game to run smoothly on modern systems and screen resolutions, while the dedicated modding & workshop support makes it easier than ever to create, share and play community-created modifications. To this end, the fan-favorite open-source Containment Breach Room Editor Extended (CBRE-EX) is bundled, making room creation an enjoyable experience! This is the definite way to enjoy this horror classic!

Name: Ethics Empire
Supported languages: Ethics Empire is a business management simulator where you grow a business empire from nothing using different properties to make money and keep your ethical standards high. Some ways of playing are safe but slow while others are risky but fast. It is up to you if you want to play by the rules or break them to make a quick profit. The game has three main property types and each one does something different. Business properties give passive income every second but they can close which stops your money. You can also use Corner Cuts on them to make more profit but this increases the chance of being sued or the business closing because it is unethical. Investment properties do not give passive income. Instead their sell value goes up over time and can give you a big payout after a long wait. Investment properties are mostly safe. Perk properties are different and each one gives a unique bonus like regenerating Ethical Points, reducing lawsuit chances, or lowering emissions. You can only place a few perks so each one is important. Ethical Points are important and affect how much money your empire makes. You can see them in the My Empire menu. Doing bad things lowers them and doing good things raises them. Businesses that create pollution can also lower Ethical Points and some perks can help reduce that. Every 100 points above or below the starting 1000 changes your income by 10 percent and there is no limit. Lawsuits come in different severities and each business has its own risk. Minor and major lawsuits can cost money, Ethical Points, or even your properties. When you get sued you can see what the penalties are and then decide if you want to settle or fight. Settling gives a set penalty but fighting costs money and you might get no penalty, a normal penalty, or a bigger penalty. You have to make the decision fast because there is a timer. The game has a save system that autosaves every 30 seconds and lets you make, name, and delete multiple save files. The Build Menu shows up when you click an empty property tile so you can place new properties. The Property Menu lets you look at and change properties you already placed. Placing a property has a small animation to make it feel alive.

In this VR experience, you do not merely observe the world. Again and again, you are placed into different bodies. When inhabiting human bodies, you sense time, place, allegiance, position, and causality as lived conditions rather than abstract ideas. When entering non-human bodies, perception shifts—life and death blur, time and space lose their familiar structure, and existence is reshaped through the corporeality of other beings. Samsara invites you to discover through the body itself : what we call progress may be nothing more than a distorted Möbius strip. What can truly change is not the world, but the way you perceive and exist within it. 《Samsara》｜Selected International Awards 2021 Venice International Film Festival - Official Selection 2021 Cannes XR - Best VR Story 2021 SXSW Virtual Cinema - Jury Award 2021 Prix Ars Electronica -  Honorary Mention 2022 Animafest Zagreb Best VR Project 2022 Annecy International Animated Film Festival - Official Selection
